jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Turkey - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Dubai, UAE

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Digital Natives team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

Regional Focus: Tukey

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Language Skills: Fluency in both English and Turkish (written and spoken).

• 8+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel up to 50% to engage with key customers and internal teams.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, South Africa - Digital Natives
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Dubai, UAE

About the Role

We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Account Executive to join our Digital Natives team in Dubai. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).

As an Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives.

Regional Focus: South Africa

Responsibilities

• Strategic Revenue Generation: Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.

• Expert Pipeline & Forecasting: Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.

• Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding: Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.

• Multi-Engagement Leadership: Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.

• Virtual Team Leadership: Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.

• Digital Transformation Authority: Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.

• Compelling Value Creation: Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.

• Advanced Negotiation & Closure: Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.

• Trusted Advisor & Coach: Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.

• Organizational Impact & Leadership: Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Fluency in both English (written and spoken).

• 8+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).

• Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.

• Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.

• Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).

• Advanced negotiation skills with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.

• Expert-level sales acumen: unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.

• Authority on digital transformation trends and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.

• Strong coaching and mentorship abilities, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.

• Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.

• Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).

• Bachelor's degree required, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.

• Ability to travel up to 50% to engage with key customers and internal teams.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Title of Job: Principal Product Acceleration Specialist - Auth0
Reports to: Director, Product Acceleration

As a Principal Product Acceleration Specialist for Auth0, you will play a critical role in driving customer success, deep product adoption, and long-term retention across Okta’s most complex and strategic enterprise accounts, specifically targeting the top end of the Global 2000 (G2K). In this highly technical, developer-centric leadership role, you will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise engineering, architecture, security, and application teams, as well as key System Integrator (SI) partners, helping them architect and deploy complex, low-friction, massive-scale Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions on the Auth0 platform.

Using your deep Auth0 expertise, you will guide enterprise deployments by defining architecture, optimizing platform usage, and resolving complex escalations. Operating at the intersection of post-sales support, developer enablement, and product innovation, you will deploy modern front-end frameworks and validate New Product Introductions (NPIs)—serving as the essential feedback bridge between top-tier G2K engineering teams and Auth0 Product Management.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Strategic Architectural Advisory & Troubleshooting: Partner directly with the top end of G2K Enterprise Customers to define enterprise-wide implementation patterns, navigate critical architectural decisions, and resolve the most complex configuration challenges to maximize platform capabilities.

• Pre-Sales & NPI Launch Support: Partner with Sales Engineering and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams during the rollout of New Product Introductions (NPIs). Develop high-impact Proof of Concepts (PoCs), early-adopter demonstrations, and technical enablement assets to help secure technical wins and drive initial pipeline for emerging Auth0 capabilities within G2K accounts.

• Strategic Architectural Advisory & Troubleshooting: Partner directly with the top end of G2K Enterprise Customers to define enterprise-wide implementation patterns, navigate critical architectural decisions, and resolve the most complex configuration challenges to maximize platform capabilities.

• System Integrator (SI) Collaboration: Partner deeply with global System Integrators (SIs) and strategic delivery partners to design scalable deployment blueprints, ensure architectural alignment, and unblock complex, multi-year identity transformation programs.

• Developer Enablement & Prototyping: Assist customer development teams by providing architectural guidance on custom Auth0 Actions, SDK implementation blueprints, and modern full-stack application patterns (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Mobile).

• Product & NPI Feedback Loop: Act as a technical liaison between G2K Enterprise Customers and Auth0 Product Management to identify feature gaps, test early-stage NPIs, and drive product roadmap enhancements based on real-world enterprise needs.

• Industry Thought Leadership & Customer Mentorship: Create reusable code samples, technical documentation, and enablement guides to train G2K field teams and customer developers on advanced Auth0 capabilities, establishing yourself as a leading CIAM authority within the Okta ecosystem.

• AI Tooling & Automation: Leverage AI tools and LLM workflows to accelerate code generation, SDK debugging, technical documentation, and complex implementation analysis.

• Principal-Level Escalation Management & Multi-Project Execution: Manage multiple concurrent technical engagements effectively, acting as the ultimate technical escalation point for high-priority customer issues and fast-moving GTM activities.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

• Experience: 10+ years in a customer-facing technical field role within a Go-To-Market (GTM) organization (e.g., Pre-Sales/Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Solutions Architecture, Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or Senior Support) delivering identity or SaaS solutions to enterprise accounts.

• System Integrator (SI) Expertise: Proven experience working directly for, or in tight alignment with, global System Integrators (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, etc.), driving massive-scale enterprise identity or cloud transformation projects.

• Full-Stack Development Skills: Proven experience reading, writing, and debugging full-stack application code using JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, and modern Mobile SDKs.

• Identity Protocols & Security: Deep understanding of identity federation, access control frameworks, and core protocols including SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SCIM.

• Identity Security & Threat Defense: In-depth knowledge of the CIAM threat landscape, with a proven ability to design and scale resilient authentication flows that mitigate both traditional identity attacks (credential stuffing, account takeover, automated bot attacks, etc.) and emerging next-generation threats (AI-driven social engineering, LLM-based phishing, and automated fraud attacks, etc.)

• Top-Tier G2K Enterprise Experience: Demonstrated history of navigating complex, large-scale IT landscapes, web technologies, and cloud architectures specifically for the top echelon of G2K and Fortune 100 customers.

• Communication & Advisory: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical/developer concepts to non-technical stakeholders and strategically guide senior engineering leaders.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Commercial & Contract Management, Construction & Engineering
jobs.description:
Construction and engineering projects succeed or fail based on how effectively organizations manage commercial commitments, contractual obligations, procurement, change, cost, and risk.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager, Commercial & Contract Management to lead the strategy and evolution of IFS capabilities covering:

• Customer and sales contract management
• Procurement and supplier commitments
• Material and equipment procurement
• Subcontract management
• Contract changes, variations, and change orders
• Commercial controls across the project lifecycle

This is a senior, hands-on product leadership role for someone who understands how commercial and contractual processes operate in real construction and engineering environments and has translated that understanding into successful enterprise software products.

You will own the problem-to-outcome journey for the Commercial & Contract Management product area. You will define the vision and strategy, identify the most valuable customer and market problems, build evidence-led investment cases, and lead discovery and product definition with customers, engineering, design, sales, and industry specialists.

The initial focus will include strengthening our subcontract-management capabilities while also establishing a broader commercial management framework that connects customer contracts, procurement, supplier commitments, contract changes, and project financial outcomes into a cohesive experience.

You will work directly with construction and engineering organizations across Europe and North America, engaging with commercial managers, contract managers, quantity surveyors, project directors, procurement leaders, project controls teams, and finance stakeholders.

This role requires deep product leadership, strong industry credibility, commercial thinking, and the ability to lead a product area from strategy and customer discovery through delivery, adoption, and measurable market impact.

Core Responsibilities

Own the Product Strategy

• Define and communicate the vision and strategy for Commercial & Contract Management within IFS Construction & Engineering.
• Establish a differentiated market position spanning contract management, procurement, subcontract management, and commercial controls.
• Translate customer feedback, market trends, industry insight, and competitive intelligence into focused product investments.
• Own and evolve a roadmap that balances innovation, architectural modernization, adoption, customer retention, and commercial growth.
• Drive alignment across related domains including project management, project controls, procurement, finance, project accounting, risk management, and document management.

Lead Customer and Market Discovery

• Engage directly with construction and engineering customers to understand commercial processes, procurement workflows, contractual risk, and operating models.
• Build trusted relationships with customers, partners, and industry experts.
• Validate customer problems and product opportunities before committing investment.
• Establish lighthouse customers and design partners for discovery, prototyping, validation, and early adoption.
• Ensure the product strategy is grounded in measurable customer outcomes and business value.

Define the Product

• Own product specifications describing customer problems, business outcomes, user workflows, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
• Lead functional prototyping and validate solutions with real users before development.
• Work closely with engineering and design as part of a high-performing product triad.
• Ensure solutions form a coherent end-to-end commercial management experience rather than isolated features.
• Apply systems thinking across contracts, procurement, project execution, change management, cost control, revenue management, and commercial risk.

Deliver Commercial and Customer Outcomes

• Build investment cases with clear customer, strategic, and financial outcomes.
• Partner with engineering and design to move efficiently from validated problem to adopted product.
• Support go-to-market activities including positioning, enablement, launch planning, and customer engagement.
• Represent the product area with customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
• Drive adoption from early customers to repeatable market scale.
• Measure success through customer outcomes, adoption, retention, revenue influence, and commercial impact.

Shape the Future of Commercial Management

• Identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation across procurement, supplier management, contract administration, obligation management, commercial risk, and contract change management.
• Leverage AI to accelerate discovery, research, prototyping, and product definition.
• Ensure AI-enabled capabilities deliver tangible business outcomes and trusted decision support.
• Build reusable product capabilities that support multiple construction and engineering business models globally.

You will succeed in this role if you are:

• Customer obsessed and committed to solving meaningful industry problems.
• Commercially minded and focused on measurable business outcomes.
• Outcome driven, prioritizing impact over feature count.
• Credible in the industry, able to engage with experienced construction and commercial professionals.
• Decisive and pragmatic, able to make difficult prioritization decisions.
• Collaborative, working effectively across product, engineering, design, sales, consulting, and customer success.
• Technically fluent, comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, integrations, and AI.
• Comfortable with ambiguity, providing clarity and direction in evolving situations.
• Hands-on, willing to engage directly in discovery, prototyping, specification, and customer engagement.
• A multiplier, helping improve product-management practices and mentoring others.

Experience & Education

Essential Experience

• Significant product-management experience within a software company developing SaaS, ERP, construction-management, project-management, procurement, or enterprise software solutions.
• Direct responsibility for commercial management, contract management, procurement management, subcontract management, project controls, or related capabilities within an enterprise software portfolio.
• Strong domain experience within construction, engineering, EPC, infrastructure, contractors, specialist subcontractors, or project-centric industries.
• Deep understanding of commercial processes including:Customer and sales contractsProcurement and supplier commitmentsSubcontract managementChange orders and contract variationsCommercial obligations and complianceValuation, payment, retention, and claimsCost, revenue, margin, and cash-flow impacts
• Demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmap, discovery, delivery, launch, and adoption.
• Strong customer-facing experience working with both operational users and executive stakeholders.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder-management, and prioritization skills.
• Experience collaborating with global engineering and design teams.
• Fluent English communication skills.
• Based in Europe or North America with willingness to travel as required.

Desirable Experience

• Construction commercial management, quantity surveying, procurement management, contract administration, or project controls experience.
• Familiarity with major construction contracting models and commercial delivery frameworks used in Europe or North America.
• Experience with construction ERP, project controls, procurement, contract management, or capital-project software platforms.
• Understanding of project accounting, forecasting, cost controls, earned value, applications for payment, supplier payments, and revenue management.
• Experience modernizing enterprise software products and introducing AI-enabled capabilities.
• Exposure to pricing, monetization, business-case development, or product P&L ownership.
• Experience creating customer design-partner or lighthouse-customer programs.
• Degree or equivalent experience in construction management, engineering, quantity surveying, business, computer science, or a related discipline.

What We’re Offering

• Salary Range: $150,000 - $175,000 salary plus bonus
• Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday
• Medical, dental, & vision insurance
• 401K with Company contribution
• Flexible spending accounts
• Life insurance and disability benefits
• Tuition assistance
• Community involvement and volunteering events

Why Join IFS Construction & Engineering?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of commercial and contract management for one of the industry's most comprehensive enterprise platforms.

You will help define how construction and engineering companies manage contracts, procurement, suppliers, commercial risk, project change, and financial outcomes across the entire project lifecycle while leveraging the latest advances in AI and enterprise software.

You will work with some of the world's leading contractors, engineering firms, and project-driven organizations to transform how they deliver complex projects at scale.

Interviews and selections are being made continuously. If you are interested, apply as soon as possible.

As a step in our recruitment process, all final candidates will undergo a background check, to get us an understanding of our future employees.

We respectfully decline all offers of recruitment and/or advertising assistance.

IFS Fact

IFS develops and delivers enterprise software for customers around the world who manufacture and distribute goods, build and maintain assets, and manage service-focused operations. The industry expertise of our people and solutions, together with a commitment to delivering value to every one of our customers, has made IFS a recognized leader and the most recommended supplier in our sector. Our team of 7,000+ employees and growing ecosystem of partners support more than 10,000 customers around the world challenge the status quo and realize their competitive advantage. Learn more about how our enterprise software solutions can help your business today at ifs.com.

We believe that coming together as a community, in person, is important for innovation, connection and fostering a sense of belonging. Our roles have the right balance of remote and in-office working to enable flexibility for managing your life along with ensuring a real connection with your colleagues and the broader IFS community.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times is creating a video news series that brings our journalism to life in a new format. We are seeking a Managing Producer who is a seasoned journalist and manager, drawn to building ambitious work that breaks new ground.

You will nurture innovation and sustainability while cultivating a culture of collaboration. You will set the long‑term editorial vision and priorities for this new show and develop and manage relationships with the core newsroom and key internal stakeholders.

You will work closely with department leadership and other senior leaders to develop the show and support the talented team who will bring it to life. You are a builder: comfortable with creating from the ground up, evolving formats, and helping hosts and teams find their footing. You are also an editor and manager with deep experience in daily news and a strong strategic sensibility for what audiences want and how to grow them.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

• Work with Shows leadership to evolve the new video show, including driving the editorial direction and establish coverage priorities

• Manage a team to produce urgent, compelling and high-quality video journalism

• Develop relationships with Times reporters and editors

• Find opportunities to tell news stories in new and exciting ways

• Oversee production of episodes, including: helping the team define ideas, structuring episodes, and guiding the story

• Work with the team of makers and hosts to craft stories coherently and artfully

• Manage an editorial calendar, juggling immediate priorities and longer-term goals

• Assess staffing needs to build a diverse team of producers and editors

• Manage your direct reports, providing editorial feedback to producers and help guide their growth development

• Collaborate with programming and audience teams

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

• You will report to the Editor of The Daily

Basic Qualifications:

• 10+ years experience in audio or video production.

• 5+ years experience managing teams

• A passion for storytelling across various kinds of formats and subjects, with a track record of overseeing and evolving shows

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.location: Austin, TX, United States; Chicago, IL United States; Dallas, TX, United States; Kansas City, MO, United States; Lexington, KY, United States; Lincoln, NE, United States; Omaha, NE, United States
jobs.description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're seeking an experienced, automation-focused Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to join our North American Sports product team. This team develops insightful analytics and Recruit products for American Football, helping high-level coaches and analysts make faster, data-driven decisions on player performance and talent acquisition.

As the testing expert within your cross-functional squad, you'll own quality end-to-end — building the strategies and automation that ensure we're shipping software our users love. You'll drive quality discussions, challenge the team to maintain high standards, and be the advocate for reliability and performance at every stage of delivery.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll:

• Lead quality initiatives. Build risk-based testing strategies tailored to your squad's architecture, drive quality discussions in scrum ceremonies, challenge defect priorities, and continuously look for ways to improve practices and keep your squad's quality processes ahead of the curve.

• Test across the stack. Design and execute tests spanning front-end UI, APIs, backend services, and data pipelines — validating transformations, service outputs, and complex logic at scale.

• Automate with intent. Make informed decisions about what, when, and how to automate. Use Playwright and scripting to build reliable, maintainable automated checks that keep pace with development.

• Mentor and grow others. Use your technical depth and quality instincts to coach teammates, raise the bar for quality standards across the team, and influence how the whole squad thinks about quality.

• Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Design, contribute to hiring, and invest in your own professional development.

Location

While local candidates in Lincoln and Omaha, Nebraska are prioritized, we’re open to remote applicants who reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Nevada, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

Must-Haves

• Quality focus. You see the big picture and use it to drive improvements in both quality and velocity.

• Technical depth. 4+ years of software testing experience with hands-on expertise across the full stack — API testing, backend and data-heavy systems, and front-end validation — plus proficiency in automation frameworks like Playwright and languages like Python or TypeScript.

• A track record of leadership. You've owned quality for a squad, led testing initiatives end-to-end, defined success criteria, and designed approaches that measurably reduce risk in production.

• Investigative rigour. You dig to root causes of complex problems, back your findings with data, and measure outcomes.

• User focus. You think critically about the user experience and let that understanding shape your testing approach.

• AI-powered working. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow — for test case creation, failure diagnosis, documentation, and beyond — and look for new ways to apply them to raise the team's efficiency.

Nice-to-Haves

• Performance testing exposure. Familiarity with load, stress, and scalability testing concepts and tools (e.g. JMeter) for validating API and backend performance.

• Sports knowledge. Passion for or experience in Basketball, American Football or Ice Hockey — whether as an athlete, coach, or fan — and an appreciation for the unique challenges of sports technology.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience. A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience.

Our Role

• Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.

• Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.

• Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.

• Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.

• Support your mental and physical health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.

• Cover your medical insurance. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.

• Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range

$82,000—$137,000 USD

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:

Backed by deep partnerships across healthcare and supported by a culture of innovation, cross‑functional collaboration, and relentless curiosity, One Pass is scaling rapidly and shaping the future how people lead healthier, fuller lives.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As we continue to scale, our need for data-driven insights is growing rapidly. We’re ingesting, processing, and serving more data than ever before, and data plays a central role in how we build products, make decisions, and create competitive advantages. We believe data should be a core capability of the business, not simply a reporting function, and we're looking for a leader who is excited to help us build that capability from the ground up.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in startup environments and enjoys creating systems, processes, and teams that can scale. You'll have significant ownership over how our data function evolves and the autonomy to shape its future. Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between long-term strategy and hands-on execution, from defining a data vision and operating model to making critical architecture and design decisions.

To support our next stage of growth, we are looking for  Head of Data to oversee our Data organization, including data engineering, analytics, reporting, and data science. We're open to hiring this role at either a Senior Manager or early Director level, depending on the experience and scope a candidate brings — the right level will be determined collaboratively through the interview process. This is a people leadership role with direct management responsibility for the individuals across these functions, while also serving as a technical leader responsible for guiding our overall data strategy and platform evolution.

Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, you will be a key member of the engineering leadership team. You’ll inherit a high-performing team of nine across data engineering, analytics, and data science: small enough that your impact will be immediate and highly visible, yet large enough to already be solving meaningful challenges at scale.

While people leadership is a core part of the role, this is not a purely managerial position. As a growing company, we need a leader who enjoys staying close to the technology, partnering with engineers on architecture, influencing technical direction, and helping solve complex data problems. You'll work closely with our Staff Data Engineer on the technical leadership of the data organization — you'll be a strong technical voice and decision-maker, but not the only one, and this role is well-suited to someone who enjoys developing technical direction collaboratively rather than owning it unilaterally. You will play a pivotal role in defining our data platform, driving data quality and governance, and enabling the business to leverage data more effectively across every function.

Most importantly, you will help transform data from an internal support function into a strategic product capability that differentiates us in the market. The decisions you make over the next 12 to 18 months will establish the foundation for how the company captures, manages, and leverages data for years to come.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the transformation of data from a reporting and analytics function into a strategic product capability, identifying opportunities to leverage data as a competitive advantage, unlock new business value, and accelerate growth.

 - Define and drive the company’s data vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring our data platform and capabilities scale alongside the business.

 - Build, lead, and develop a high-performing data organization spanning data engineering, analytics, and data science. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

 - Partner closely with cross-functional leaders and stakeholders to translate company objectives into scalable data solutions, platforms, and insights that drive decision-making. 

 - Help shape the technical direction of the data platform in close partnership with our Staff Data Engineer, contributing to key architectural decisions while remaining hands-on in the design and implementation of critical systems and solutions. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and design patterns across the data ecosystem, while mentoring team members and elevating technical excellence throughout the organization.

 - Drive the evolution of data engineering practices, including data modeling, data quality, governance, security, observability, and validation frameworks to ensure trusted and reliable data at scale.

 - Lead the design, implementation, and operation of cloud-based data infrastructure and services on AWS, balancing scalability, performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.

 - Identify and prioritize investments in data platforms, tooling, and processes that enable faster product development, deeper customer insights, and increased organizational leverage.

 - Serve as a key member of the engineering leadership team, influencing company-wide technology strategy and helping shape how data powers future products, decisions, and growth initiatives.




ABOUT YOU

You’re a strong technical leader who can leverage both technical and leadership skills, and who has led multiple technical teams simultaneously. You have a proven ability to solve complex engineering problems, with a focus on system design, performance, and scalability, and you communicate well across cross-functional teams. You thrive here if you enjoy creating clarity out of ambiguity rather than waiting for it to be handed to you, and you're skilled at balancing tradeoffs between delivering short-term value and long-term architectural integrity. You enjoy mentoring other engineers and scaling your impact by elevating the people and teams around you. Just as important, you thrive in a small, fast-moving company environment — comfortable wearing multiple hats and moving fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on technical execution — and ideally you've had a hand in turning data into a product or business differentiator, not just internal reporting or BI.

What this role offers:

 - A unique opportunity to define the future of data at a company where data is becoming a core strategic capability.

 - Direct influence on company and product strategy, not simply execution against an established roadmap.

 - A seat on the engineering leadership team and the ability to shape technology decisions across the organization.

 - The opportunity to build and scale a modern data platform, data organization, and data culture from an early stage.

 - Significant autonomy, ownership, and visibility, with a direct connection between your decisions and business outcomes.

 - The ability to grow the function alongside the company, including expanding the team and developing future leaders.

 - The chance to leave a lasting mark on how data powers our products, decision-making, and competitive advantage for years to come.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, data platforms, or related technical disciplines, with a track record of building and scaling data capabilities in high-growth environments 

 - 3+ years of people management experience, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development of engineers, analysts, data scientists, or other technical professionals.

 - Experience defining data architecture, platform strategy, and engineering standards for modern data ecosystems.

 - Strong proficiency with SQL and deep understanding of relational database design, optimization, and performance tuning.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience developing production systems with Python and other modern programming languages.

 - Expertise with modern cloud data platforms and warehouse technologies such as Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Databricks, or similar solutions.

 - Experience designing, building, and operating scalable batch and real-time or near real-time data processing pipelines.

 - Experience using GitHub or similar source control platforms in collaborative, distributed engineering teams.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business goals into technical strategies and influence decision-making across the organization.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building data products, or data-driven features that serve as a competitive differentiator or revenue driver, beyond internal reporting/BI.

 - Deep knowledge and hands on experience with AWS tools such as – Redshift, S3, MSK, Glue, SageMaker, Bedrock

 - Experience with Kafka, dbt, data orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow, Dagster)

 - Experience working with both batch and near-real-time data processing pipelines

 - Solid experience designing and implementing scalable distributed systems

 

Work Location & Eligibility

One Pass Solutions, Inc. offers a flexible work environment. We operate as a hybrid company in the Minnesota–St. Paul Twin Cities area, where team members are expected to work in-office three days per week. We also support remote work across a number of U.S. states.

We are currently able to employ individuals who reside in the following states:

Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Montana, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, D.C.

Please note: At this time, we are unable to employ individuals residing outside of these jurisdictions.



One Pass Solutions, Inc. commits to provide a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, as well as equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Cyber Resilience Platform
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Job Title:

Staff Product Manager, Cyber Resilience Platform

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company that’s transforming the IT industry. At Kaseya, you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a dynamic team, and develop your career in a high-impact role.

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to define and deliver Kaseya’s unified Cyber Resilience platform, powered by Kaseya Intelligence and supporting more than three exabytes of customer data. This role owns the platform strategy, roadmap, and convergence of multiple products onto a shared foundation across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work closely with customers, Engineering, Security, Data, and go-to-market teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities and measurable cyber resilience outcomes.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the unified Cyber Resilience platform

• Lead the convergence of multiple products onto shared platform services while maintaining reliability and customer continuity

• Define platform capabilities and customer experiences that support cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments

• Gather input from customers, partners, and internal stakeholders and translate it into prioritized product requirements

• Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Data teams to define technical approaches, dependencies, and delivery plans

• Make product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical risk, and available resources

• Coordinate product launches, migrations, and adoption plans with Product Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success

• Define and monitor success metrics for platform adoption, usage, reliability, and customer outcomes

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of software product management experience, including ownership of a technical platform, infrastructure product, or enterprise software offering

• Experience leading the migration or consolidation of multiple products onto shared platform services

• Experience owning a product from discovery and requirements definition through delivery, launch, and post-launch measurement

• Experience partnering with engineering teams on architecture decisions, technical trade-offs, and detailed product requirements

• Experience defining product metrics and using customer, usage, or operational data to guide roadmap decisions

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with data protection, backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, or cyber resilience products

• Experience delivering products across cloud, on-premises, or hybrid environments

• Familiarity with enterprise security, privacy, governance, or compliance requirements

• Experience with shared platform capabilities such as identity, authorization, data services, auditability, or policy management

• Experience delivering AI or machine learning capabilities within enterprise products or large-scale data platforms

• Experience building products sold through Managed Service Providers, channel partners, or other indirect sales models

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

jobs.description:

Cutting Dynamics, LLC is part of the Re:Build family of companies, located in Avon, Ohio. They have been serving aerospace and other industries for over 30 years. The Mission of Cutting Dynamics is to provide unmatched value to customers in need of high-quality components, assemblies, or kitting needs within the aerospace industry. We accomplish this through an established system of measurable objectives, industry-leading technology, and continual improvement.

Re:Build Manufacturing is a rapidly growing family of industrial businesses combining enabling technologies, operational superiority, and strategic M&A to build America's next generation industrial company. At Re:Build we deploy deep expertise in operations management and technology to supercharge performance of our subsidiaries by implementing core technologies across industrial platforms in diverse growth markets. Our goal is to help revitalize the U.S. manufacturing base over the coming decades, creating substantial opportunities for our employees and the communities where we operate.

We leverage deep professional expertise and a candid, principled operating culture to drive differentiated outcomes for our customers, our employees, our communities and our investors. jobs.title: Fractional Senior People Advisor
jobs.location: Educate! | Remote | ~10–12 hours per week | Consultancy
jobs.description:
Who We Are!

🌍 Africa has the world’s youngest and fastest-growing population. By 2035, the continent is poised to contribute more young people to the global workforce each year than the rest of the world combined.

At Educate! we're obsessed with impact. We leverage iterative learning to build highly scalable youth employment solutions aimed at unlocking the potential of the world’s youngest continent.

Educate! prepares youth in Africa to learn, earn and thrive in today’s economy by:

• Introducing an employment-focused school subject into secondary and

• Delivering livelihood boot camps for out-of-school youth, with a focus on marginalized rural girls and young women.

To date, more than 500,000 youth have been meaningfully impacted across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania, and along the way, Educate! has become the largest youth employment and skills provider in East Africa.

Educate! is a team of over 300 largely African staff and 300 volunteer youth mentors. We prioritize building an engaging, fulfilling and growth oriented work environment. 50% of our top 30 leaders have been with us for over 5 years, 10+ alumni have started their own organizations, and 6 current or former team members were Acumen Fund East Africa fellows.

We have been backed by top foundations such as Imaginable Futures, Livelihood Impact Fund,  Jack Dorsey’s #startsmall, CIFF and Echidna Giving. Educate! won a 2018 Klaus J. Jacobs Prize and a 2015 WISE Award, and has been highlighted by the World Bank’s S4YE's Impact Portfolio, an Al Jazeera documentary, BBC, The Brookings Institution as one of 14 case studies on scaling education, and the Gates Foundation as a Goalkeepers Accelerator. In 2022, we received a catalytic investment from philanthropist Mackenzie Scott to scale our systems change work.

Educate!'s long-term vision is to design solutions that measurably impact millions of youth across Africa each year.

Good to note: To Our Awesome Applicants! 🚀💫

We know that incredible candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply!

We’re looking for passionate individuals who believe in our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team—not just those who check every box. We value diversity and strongly encourage women and individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Position Overview

Educate! is looking for a Fractional Senior People Advisor to partner with our CEO and executive team as a senior people advisor.

Educate! is now 300+ staff across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya and Tanzania. At this size our most interesting people problems aren't administrative. They're about how we manage growth across countries, how we apply policy and employment law to get the best outcome for the business and the people in it, and most importantly, strong communications in bringing our people along in the decisions we make.

This is a senior, part-time advisory engagement, roughly 10–12 hours per week, fully remote. You will not run the people function; that sits with our Global People & HR Director. You will be the seasoned people business partner our executive team leans on when the stakes are high: someone who reads a situation quickly, can decipher what the policy and the law actually allow, and helps the exec team choose the option that holds up commercially, legally, and with the team.

What You’ll Do🌟

Partner with the exec team on people decisions

• Act as a senior people business partner to the CEO and exec team

• Bring an independent read on org design, team composition, and succession questions as Educate! scales

• Pressure-test decisions before they are made, and name the risks nobody else is naming

Apply policy and employment law to get the best outcome for the business and our people

• Translate our existing global policy and countries' employment law into practical options the exec team can act on: what we can do, what it costs us, and what it does to trust

• Advise on the live, consequential cases: restructures, exits, performance situations, grievances and investigations across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya and Tanzania

• Judge when a global standard should hold and when local context should shift how we apply it

• Flag where our current policy is getting in the way of a good business or people outcome, so we can fix it

Work on team dynamics and development

• Coach individual team members through the interpersonal and cross-cultural dynamics of a matrixed, multi-country organization

• Design and, where useful, facilitate sessions that get the team moving when it is stuck

Sharpen how people decisions get communicated

• Shape the messaging behind restructures, policy changes, and leadership transitions before they land

• Edit and stress-test internal communications so they read as clear, honest, and consistent with how we talk about ourselves

• Advise on what to say, what to hold, and when to say it

Who You Are 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️

• 8+ years in senior HR, people, or organizational development roles. This can include time as a startup people leader, an HR business partner to an executive team or as an advisor to a CEO.

• Strong writing. You can take a difficult people decision and turn it into communication people accept

• Comfortable being the outside voice: direct with the top leaders, discreet with what you hear, and unattached to being the one who executes

• Fits our Five Culture Tenets (see What is Educate! About? below); Learn more by looking at Educate!’s culture deck here

Terms

• Fully remote.

• Approximately 10–12 hours per week, engaged on a consultancy basis

• Initial engagement with the intention to extend based on fit and need

• Compensation will be competitive and based on experience

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Our Culture & Tenets(Values) 🌱

We’re ambitious. Are you? Educate! is growing fast, so new opportunities are opening up and expanding all the time. We’re inspired by people with drive, and we love to help them reach their full potential. We expect everyone at Educate! to contribute above and beyond their job description, grow their skills, and advance their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey of their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey.

• We put Youth First, Impact-Obsessed - We are purpose-driven, focused on impact, and prioritize what truly matters. We listen to youth, design our efforts around their needs, and ensure every dollar creates transformative experiences they value.

• We Exceed Expectations - We take pride in going above and beyond to achieve the best results—proactively identifying problems and seeking solutions without waiting or stopping at what's requested.

• We Are Always Learning - We are committed to seeking and applying new knowledge and ideas. We stay open-minded and continuously try new things, experiment, grow, and improve. We invest in learning for ourselves and our teams.

• We are One Team, Many Views - We value all individuals, believe diverse ideas and open dialogue drive excellence, foster a supportive and respectful environment where everyone can freely express themselves. We work as one team and prioritize the organization's mission over personal or team interests.

• We have the Startup Mindset - We innovate relentlessly to grow our impact, we never think “we have arrived” or “we’re done.”We constantly challenge the status quo, embrace change, and move quickly toward our vision. Unafraid of failure, we question anything that hinders progress.

Every person at Educate! — from interns to the executive director — is evaluated by how they live up to these five cultural tenets. They are at the core of how we achieve our mission and why we work as well as we do.  Educate is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all who interact in our community. In creating this environment, we encourage people from a variety of cultures, backgrounds and life experiences to join our diverse team.

We’re committed to ensuring all candidates are screened for child and youth safety. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer (5637)
jobs.description:
In an era where the Federal Bureau of Investigation relies on near-real-time financial intelligence to power national security missions, the integrity of their Business Intelligence Suite is the foundation of operational success. As a Quality Assurance professional, the individual serves as the primary guardian of this integrity. This role offers an unparalleled opportunity to be part of a high-performing DevSecOps team in a "can't fail" environment, where the technical stack includes cutting-edge AWS cloud services, advanced WebFOCUS analytics, and a robust Selenium automation framework. This position is on site in Washington, DC and requires an active Top-Secret clearance.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

The duties of the Quality Assurance professional are designed to be both highly technical and strategically impactful.

1) Orchestrate the Automated Regression Framework: The individual will lead the expansion and maintenance of the existing Selenium-based automated testing catalog. This involves developing sophisticated test cases that cover data ingestion and reporting functions, ensuring that new code deployments do not introduce regressions into the mission-critical FRA-C and FDDW environments.

2) Facilitate Stakeholder Collaboration and UAT: The manager acts as the functional bridge between the technical development team and FBI business users. This includes supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by designing test scenarios that reflect complex financial workflows and mentoring junior analysts on automated testing best practices.

3) Manage High-Impact Quality Deliverables: The individual is responsible for the timely update of the Quality Assurance Plans (QAP). This documents must provide evidence of rigorous performance testing, defect resolution times, and adherence to security controls.

Required Skills & Experience

The nature of the FBI’s mission and the technical complexity of the ATS BI Suite necessitate a strict set of baseline qualifications. Candidates must meet these criteria to be considered for the position.

1) Security Clearance: An active Top Secret (TS) clearance is required.

2) Experience Level: A minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in software quality assurance

3) Automation Mastery: Demonstrated experience in designing and maintaining automated testing frameworks using Selenium

4) Cloud Competency: Hands-on experience performing quality assurance in cloud-native environments, specifically within AWS

5) DevSecOps Literacy: Proven ability to work within an Agile/Scrum framework and an understanding of CI/CD principles and GitLab pipeline operations

6) Communication Skills: Excellence in technical writing and verbal communication is essential for presenting quality metrics, risk assessments, and progress reports to both technical teams and senior FBI management.

7) Degree: A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Desired Skills & Experience

1) BI Tooling Familiarity: Previous experience with Tibco WebFOCUS or similar enterprise business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for financial reporting

2) Scripting for QA: Proficiency in Python for developing custom data validation scripts and automating repetitive manual checks

3) Database Proficiency: Advanced Structured Query Language (SQL) skills are required for backend data validation, data mapping verification, and the identification of discrepancies in large-scale data warehouses (e.g., AWS Redshift)

4) Certification: Possession of industry-recognized certifications such as ISTQB (Certified Tester), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or CompTIA Security+

5)Domain Expertise: Prior experience supporting financial, budget, or procurement systems within the Department of Justice or other federal intelligence agencies.

Some key components of our robust benefits include health insurance, paid leave, and retirement.

At SMX®, we are a team of technical and domain experts dedicated to enabling your mission. From priority national security initiatives for the DoD to highly assured and compliant solutions for healthcare, we understand that digital transformation is key to your future success.

jobs.title: Heavy Equipment Mechanic
jobs.description:
Pay rate of $30-34 per hour based on experience

Position Summary

Harsco Environmental is seeking a skilled and safety-focused Heavy Equipment Mechanic to inspect, diagnose, repair, and maintain a fleet of heavy industrial and mobile equipment operating in a steel mill and industrial site environment. The successful candidate will perform preventative maintenance, troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical systems, and ensure equipment reliability to support continuous operations. Experience working on Caterpillar (CAT) equipment, diesel engines, hydraulic systems, and electronic diagnostic tools is highly preferred.

This position requires a hands-on mechanic with strong troubleshooting abilities, a commitment to safety, and the ability to work independently in a demanding industrial environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform preventative maintenance, inspections, and repairs on heavy mobile equipment, including:Wheel loadersExcavatorsMaterial handlersDozersOff-road haul trucksIndustrial forkliftsCranes and support equipment
• Diagnose and repair:Diesel enginesHydraulic systemsElectrical and electronic control systemsPowertrain and drivetrain componentsBraking systemsSteering and suspension systems
• Utilize diagnostic software, laptops, and electronic testing equipment to identify equipment faults and perform repairs.
• Perform troubleshooting of CAT equipment and other heavy equipment manufacturers' machines using OEM diagnostic software and service manuals.
• Conduct welding, cutting, fabrication, and component replacement as necessary.
• Complete work orders, inspection reports, and maintenance records accurately and timely within maintenance management systems.
• Perform field repairs in industrial operating areas and respond to equipment breakdowns to minimize downtime.

Required Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Physical Requirements

• Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, and reach for extended periods.

Work Environment

We offer competitive benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and disability plans, as well as a 401k with company matching.
