jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Who we are

Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.

Across our three businesses -The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education - we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.

As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.

Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.

We are looking for a Customer Success Specialist to join The Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU) at a time of continued growth and investment.

In this role, you will support the success and retention of our US client base, ensuring customers derive value from EIU’s solutions and services. You will manage a portfolio of accounts across the customer lifecycle, taking ownership of retention strategy and renewals for lower-tier accounts, while working closely with Account Managers to support engagement and renewal outcomes for high-value and strategic customers.

Reporting to the Global Head of Customer Success, you will collaborate with Account Management and other internal teams to strengthen customer relationships, monitor account health, and drive adoption of EIU products.

Key responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of client accounts, supporting customer engagement, adoption, and satisfaction.

• Take primary responsibility for retention strategy and renewal management for lower-tier accounts, identifying risks and opportunities to maximise renewal outcomes.

• Partner with Account Managers to support high-value and high-touch accounts, contributing insights on product usage, adoption, and customer sentiment.

• Monitor customer health metrics including usage, engagement, and feedback, identifying opportunities to strengthen client value.

• Act as a first point of contact for customer queries, coordinating issue resolution with internal teams where required.

• Lead onboarding and user enablement, ensuring clients understand how to effectively use EIU solutions.

• Deliver targeted engagement initiatives such as webinars, product updates, and curated content to key user groups.

• Capture and share customer insights and feedback internally to help inform product development and improve the client experience.

Key skills and experience

• 5+ years’ experience in customer success, account management, or a client-facing role.

• Demonstrated ability to manage customer retention, renewals, and lifecycle engagement.

• Strong communication and relationship management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities across a portfolio of accounts.

• A collaborative approach, with experience working across commercial and product teams.

• Comfortable using data and insights to inform customer engagement and retention strategies.

• Experience working with financial services clients is ideal.

• Experience supporting data feeds, APIs or other technical data-delivery products is an advantage

Why join us?

• Work as part of a global organisation with a strong reputation for high-quality research and analysis.

• Join a growing customer success team with opportunities for development and progression.

• Contribute to strengthening client relationships and delivering value to organisations across Europe

The expected base salary for this position is $82,000 plus performance related bonus.

In addition to base salary we offer a competitive benefits package.

#LI-Hybrid

Working Arrangements

The majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.

AI usage for your application

We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.

What we offer

Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.

We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our Work From Anywhere program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.

You will also be given free access to all The Economist content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel, Emergency Cash & U.S. Programs
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly is building a faster model for humanitarian response – using data, technology, and partnerships to identify people affected by crises and deliver cash within days. Making that possible requires legal pathways that can be established before a crisis and activated quickly when one occurs.

We are seeking a Counsel to build and lead that legal model. Approximately 70% of the role will focus on Emergency Cash, from preparing for future responses to leading the legal and regulatory work required during an active emergency. When a response is underway, EC work will take priority.

You will also serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs, which work with governments, funders, researchers, and community organizations to deliver cash to low-income Americans. The portfolio includes programs such as Rx Kids, guaranteed-income initiatives, and housing-stability programs. You will help teams design and expand these programs, structure partnerships, and navigate the legal issues affecting delivery and recipients.

This is a delivery-focused role for a practical lawyer who can build for scale, exercise clear judgment under pressure, and help ambitious programs move from idea to implementation.

Reports to: Head of Legal

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirement: ~ 3–4 trips per year, plus travel as needed during active emergency responses.

What you’ll do:

Build and deliver the Emergency Cash legal model

• Serve as the primary legal partner to Emergency Cash across program strategy, design, launch, and delivery.

• Build a repeatable legal model for emergency responses, including approaches to country entry, regulatory review, government engagement, contracting, data use, and the engagement of local counsel.

• Develop response-readiness tools, templates, and decision frameworks that allow common issues to be addressed quickly while escalating matters requiring legal judgment.

• During active responses, lead the legal work needed to launch and operate on emergency timelines, providing clear recommendations when information is incomplete.

• Coordinate with country teams, program-facing Counsel, and local advisors to use existing knowledge and relationships while retaining legal ownership of the response.

• Apply GiveDirectly’s global standards for MNO data and remote enablement to individual responses, working with the Corporate & Strategic Affairs Counsel on novel or cross-cutting issues.

• Draft and negotiate the partnership, technology, vendor, data-sharing, and other agreements required to deliver emergency programs.

• Capture lessons from individual responses and use them to strengthen the EC legal model over time.

Lead legal support for U.S. programs

• Serve as legal partner to GiveDirectly’s U.S. programs across program design, implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations.

• Advise on the legal design and delivery of U.S. cash programs, including eligible recipient populations, interactions with public benefits, tax treatment and reporting, payments involving minors or caregivers, family-law considerations, privacy and data use, and state-specific requirements.

• Structure and negotiate program-specific agreements with governments, research institutions, community organizations, payment providers, and other partners.

• Develop reusable guidance for recurring issues and coordinate state-specific or specialist counsel where needed.

Contribute across Legal

• Work with the Corporate & Business Affairs Counsel on organization-wide standards and initiatives affecting Emergency Cash or U.S. programs.

• Partner with the Africa Programs & Country Operations Counsel when emergency responses occur in countries within that role’s portfolio.

• Work with Legal Operations support to delegate recurring contracting, research, coordination, and administrative work appropriately.

• Support other priority legal matters as needed as part of a small, global Legal team.

What you’ll bring:

• Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

• Qualification as an attorney in at least one jurisdiction, with relevant post-qualification legal experience.

• Experience advising on complex program, commercial, or regulatory matters in fast-moving or high-pressure environments.

• Strong commercial contracting skills, including drafting and negotiating complex partnership, technology, vendor, or data-related agreements.

• Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar legal and regulatory frameworks and advise where precedent, time, or information is limited.

• Strong legal and business judgment, including the ability to identify meaningful risks, assess tradeoffs, and recommend a practical path forward.

• Ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for colleagues without legal backgrounds.

• Experience coordinating external counsel, consultants, or other specialist advisors.

• Working knowledge of data privacy and data protection law.

• Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and reprioritize quickly during active emergency responses.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; English fluency.

• Preferred:

• Experience in emergency response, humanitarian operations, or other crisis-context legal work.

• Experience supporting the launch of programs or operations in new countries.

• Experience with U.S. public-benefits, family-law, charitable-assistance, or government-program matters.

• Experience working across multiple jurisdictions, particularly in emerging markets.

• Experience supporting programs involving vulnerable populations or sensitive personal data.

• Experience in international development or another mission-driven organization.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

• Base Salary: $114,660

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$11,466, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $13,415 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $126,126+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

• Base Salary: £77600

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~£7,760 with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £9,079 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £85360+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

• Base Salary: $83,820

• Bonus at Target Performance: 15% (~$8,382, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $9,806 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $0+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

#LI-REMOTE

Why work at GiveDirectly?

At GiveDirectly, we work to ensure that you have everything you need to excel in your role and on your team, including:

• A supportive team that works hard and cares hard

• A robust health benefits plan (exact details will vary by country)

• Flexible paid time off that staff is encouraged to take

• Allowances for desk set-up and learning and development

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible application process for all of our open roles. If there are questions or concerns you have about the accessibility of our hiring process, we warmly invite you to reach out to careers@givedirectly.org.

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

jobs.title: Legal Counsel, Corporate & Business Affairs
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this role

GiveDirectly is seeking a Legal Counsel, Corporate & Business Affairs to build our Business Affairs capability and serve as a primary legal partner to our global functions. You will help GiveDirectly structure complex corporate, commercial, funding, and charitable relationships and navigate the legal and regulatory questions that arise as the organization grows.

You will advise teams including Partnerships and Fundraising, People, Finance, Communications, Technology, Product, Grants Management, and public affairs. Your portfolio will include complex partnerships and transactions, non-standard gifts and fundraising arrangements, nonprofit regulatory matters, and organization-wide strategic initiatives.

A major initial priority will be building the legal and regulatory foundation for Data Partnerships and remote enablement. Working with Global Data Partnerships, Product, Technology, and program teams, you will develop workable approaches to data privacy and MNO data that can be used across GiveDirectly and adapted by program-facing Counsel to local contexts.

This is a broad role for a corporate and commercial lawyer with strong data-privacy expertise who can understand what teams are trying to accomplish, structure a practical path forward, and bring in specialist expertise when needed.

Reports to: Head of Legal

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirement: ~ 1–2 trips per year, with additional travel as needed for significant partnerships or regulatory engagement

What you’ll do:

Build Business Affairs and advise global functions

• Serve as a primary legal partner to Partnerships and Fundraising, People, Finance, Communications, Technology, Product, Grants Management, and public affairs teams.

• Structure, draft, and negotiate complex corporate partnerships, funding arrangements, technology and vendor agreements, and other strategic transactions.

• Advise on corporate, commercial, employment, privacy, nonprofit, and operational matters arising within the teams you support.

• Partner with teams early to understand their objectives, develop workable structures, and provide practical advice on legal and business risk.

• Build templates, playbooks, and repeatable approaches that allow GiveDirectly to handle recurring work more consistently as the organization grows.

Support fundraising, charitable giving, and public affairs

• Advise on the structure, acceptance, and administration of significant or non-standard gifts, including bequests and other planned gifts, donor-advised fund grants, restricted gifts, securities, cryptocurrency, and other non-cash contributions.

• Draft and review gift agreements, donor restrictions, planned-giving documentation, and other funding arrangements, coordinating with tax or trusts-and-estates counsel where needed.

• Advise on charitable solicitation, fundraising disclosures, sponsorships, cause-marketing arrangements, commercial co-ventures, and related nonprofit regulatory requirements.

• Support public affairs, Communications, and other teams on lobbying, advocacy, public-policy engagement, and political-activity restrictions, including applicable registration, tracking, and reporting requirements.

• Develop practical guidance and escalation pathways so teams can identify when fundraising or external-engagement activities require Legal review.

Lead legal strategy for Data Partnerships and other strategic initiatives

• Lead legal strategy for new products, partnerships, and operating models that affect multiple programs, countries, or teams.

• As a major initial priority, develop GiveDirectly’s legal and regulatory approach to Data Partnerships, MNO data, and remote enablement.

• Serve as legal partner to Global Data Partnerships, leading the legal work required to establish relationships with MNOs, governments, and other data holders.

jobs.title: Director, Payment Operations
jobs.description:
Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API.  Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.

As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.

As the Director of Payment Operations, you will own the operating model, processes and controls required to deliver reliable, compliant and scalable payment capabilities across Array’s products. You will build and lead the function responsible for client payment onboarding and lifecycle management, transaction monitoring, settlement and reconciliation, disputes, payment incidents, and client and partner escalations as Array expands from gateway functionality into payment facilitation.

You will:

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and Risk to define the operational requirements, controls and readiness plans needed to launch and scale Array’s payment capabilities

• Partner with our existing Money Operations team responsible for our D2C offerings. You ensure our B2B and D2C operating models, capabilities and roadmaps are aligned

• Build, operate and continuously improve the transaction monitoring, settlement, reconciliation, exception-management and reporting processes supporting Array+ and Private Label solutions

• Define and manage the end-to-end payment account lifecycle for B2B clients, including onboarding, activation, account changes, risk-related actions and offboarding

• Establish and lead the response to payment incidents and complex client escalations, including runbooks, triage, communication, resolution, root-cause analysis and corrective-action tracking

• Own the day-to-day operating relationships with processors, sponsor banks, gateways, and acquirers, including partner performance, issue escalation and the operational implementation of new partners

• Establish scalable processes for disputes, chargebacks, returns, holds and other payment exceptions in partnership with Risk, Compliance and Finance

• Serve as a Subject Matter Expert internally and externally

• Partner with Legal and Compliance to translate regulatory and contractual requirements into operational controls, documentation, audit evidence and remediation plans

• Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it’s your default, not an afterthought.

You have:

• 5+ years of experience in payment operations, financial operations or payment infrastructure, including several years leading teams or functions

• Direct experience working for a payment facilitator, embedded-payments platform or vertical SaaS company with integrated payments

• Experience building or scaling payment operations in a high-growth, technology-driven environment

• Strong working knowledge of ACH and card-payment flows, including authorization, capture, funding, settlement, reconciliation, refunds, chargebacks and exceptions

• Experience managing payment incidents and complex client escalations, including triage, communications, root-cause analysis and corrective actions

• Demonstrated ability to design operational controls, procedures, reporting and audit evidence in partnership with Legal, Compliance and Risk

• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to define operational requirements, launch new payment capabilities and automate manual processes

• Strong analytical ability, including defining KPIs, identifying payment-performance issues and using data to improve reliability, risk and efficiency

• Experience building teams, establishing coverage models and creating accountability in a function where responsibilities are still evolving

• A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do.

Pay transparency: $175,000+ for base salary, depending on experience. Full time employee compensation includes an Incentive Stock Option (ISO) grant, subject to Board approval.

Expected interview process: Recruiter Conversation - Hiring Manager Interview - Loop round.

Expected onboarding process: Onboarding at Array is active, not passive: new hires spend their first two weeks building fluency in our products, customers, and value proposition, and are expected to pass scored assessments before beginning role-specific work. Success means meeting defined performance standards through a six-month evaluation period — with continuous feedback and ongoing accountability as core parts of working at Array.

Array Offers All Full Time Employees the following Benefits and Perks:

• Full medical, dental, and vision, premiums covered at 100% for full-time employees and 70% for dependents

• Unlimited PTO and sick leave + 14 company holidays to encourage a healthy work-life blend

• 100% 401k match up to 4% with immediate vesting

• Generous and competitive parental leave for all parents

• $1,000 desk setup subsidy to set-up your unique remote office

• $100/month to subsidize wifi/cell phone expenses

• Summer Fridays (half-day Fridays) typically from late May to the end of August

• Commuter benefits for those who choose to go into our New York City or San Francisco office spaces

Not sure if you meet the Qualifications? We know that folks tend to only apply if they check every box. If you think you have the appropriate qualifications, but don’t meet every single one, we encourage you to still apply. We’d love to hear from you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace; we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Array will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants—if you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please email talent@array.com to make your request.

We enable customers across defense, law enforcement, and enterprise to turn mission-critical data into actionable intelligence.

Role

Internal IT keeps our colleagues working - from the first onboarding call to daily support on macOS and Linux and the access rights behind it. We are looking for an experienced support engineer who has already taken ownership of systems and topics, and who wants to split their time between support and project work.

This is a hands-on role, not a leadership role: you own systems and projects technically and work in the ticket queue alongside the rest of the team.

What you'll do

• Work on support tickets - a responsibility shared across the whole Internal IT team.

• General support for macOS and Linux: setup, device management, troubleshooting, software and hardware lifecycle.

• Identity & Access Management: user lifecycle, groups, roles, permissions and SSO across our core systems.

• System ownership for our tooling - configuration, access, integrations and lifecycle.

• Run the IT onboarding call for new joiners as their first contact with internal IT.

• Own internal IT projects from scoping through rollout to handover into operations.

• Automate our user journeys: onboarding, role changes, tool provisioning, offboarding.

• Improve our processes.

• Document processes, systems and tooling so colleagues can use them without asking. As well as for our internal IT Documentation

About you

• Several years of experience in IT support or internal IT, at an advanced level.

• You have already owned a system or topic end to end and kept it running.

• Confident with macOS and Linux support, the command line and basic scripting (e.g. Bash or Python).

• Practical knowledge of Identity & Access Management (SSO, MFA, directory services, roles and permissions).

• Experience running projects independently alongside day-to-day support.

• Interested in AI agents and automation, and willing to use them in your own work.

• Clear communication with non-technical colleagues and a service mindset.

• Documentation is a habit, not an afterthought.

• English at C1 or above, German at B1 or above.

Nice-to-haves

• ITIL expertise (certification or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience in an ISO 27001 environment.

What we offer

• Remote-first, Germany-wide: Work from wherever you do your best work, with regular team gatherings in Berlin and other off-site locations.

• Flexibility by default: Flexible working hours help you make work fit your life.

• Your setup, your way: Get a personal home-office equipment budget to create a workspace that works for you.

• 30 days of vacation: Take the time you need to recharge and come back with fresh energy.

• Keep growing: We invest in your personal and professional development.

• Get rewarded for impact: Performance bonuses are tied to agreed objectives and key results.

• A warm welcome: Every new team member gets a welcome goodie bag.

• Good people, good times: From summer and Christmas parties to regular team gatherings, we make time to celebrate together.

• A mission that matters: Work on challenges with tangible impact on public safety and national security.

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer (Hybrid, $90-$115k)
jobs.description:
IT SUPPORT ENGINEER — GLOBAL (BASED IN NEW YORK)




ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is an AI-powered qualitative research platform. Our AI moderates real interviews at scale, so insights teams can run qual research with the speed and reach of quant — without losing the depth that makes qual worth doing.

We've raised a Series A ($50M) and we're headquartered in London, with a team across Belgium and the US. We hold ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, with ISO 42001 in progress.




HOW WE WORK

 - AI-first, genuinely. We use AI across the whole company, not just in the product.

 - Automate the boring parts. If a process runs often, it shouldn't be manual.

 - Small team, real ownership. You'll own systems outright, not a slice of someone else's queue.

 - Distributed by design. Being in a different time zone from your colleagues shouldn't be a handicap.
   
   


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a global IT role, based in New York.

You'd be the second person on Conveo's IT team, working alongside our IT Manager in London and reporting to him. You'd take day-to-day ownership of support, devices, access and the office - freeing the IT Manager to focus on strategy, security and governance.



Why New York? Presence and coverage. Our US team is growing, and they should be able to reach someone in their own hours rather than wait for the next London morning. With one of us in each region, IT's combined working day stretches across both.



You'd inherit a modern stack — Okta with SSO and SCIM, Google Workspace, Iru for macOS management,Notion, 1Password, Vanta and a whole load of Internal AI agents — and a lot of room to shape what comes next.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Support the team, wherever they are

 - Be a first point of contact for colleagues across the US, UK and Belgium - patient and clear with people who don't share your technical vocabulary

 - Triage and resolve requests end-to-end, from password resets to complex access problems, fixing causes rather than symptoms

 - When something bigger breaks, drive it to resolution, keep people informed before they ask, and document the root cause

 - Own vendor escalations, and know when to bring in the IT Manager — you'll be the only IT person in your time zone for much of the day



Run identity, access and the employee lifecycle

 - Administer Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and 1Password day-to-day

 - Handle access requests through our approval workflow, and keep our SaaS inventory accurate

 - Run onboarding and offboarding end-to-end for any region



Own devices and the office

 - Manage our macOS fleet through Iru — blueprints, configuration profiles, security baselines — plus BYOD enrolment and hardware lifecycle

 - Help engineers with development environment issues: tooling, permissions, machine setup

 - Own office AV, meeting booths and hardware, and hold the standard that calls start on time without anyone fiddling with cables

 - Shape the office into somewhere people choose to come, because collaborating there is easier than doing it from home



Improve how IT runs

 - Design the processes that repeat - onboarding, access requests, provisioning

 - Decide what should be automated and what shouldn't. Judgement about where a human needs to approve something matters as much as knowing what can be handed off

 - Build how we track IT work. We don't have a request tracking system and we want one  but we don't want to become a ticket-driven company. Visibility not bureaucracy

 - Turn repeat questions into self-service. Write the documentation once — clear internal guides and a knowledge base that colleagues and our helpdesk tooling can both answer from.

Keep IT compliant

 - Operate the IT controls that sit behind ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001 — access reviews, evidence collection, joiner-mover-leaver records, so audits are seamless rather than a scramble

 - Help answer customer security questionnaires and vendor assessments. Clear, accurate answers about how we actually run things.




WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW

Security and compliance ownership. You'd start by supporting our certifications, evidence, access reviews, control operation across ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001,  and grow into being accountable for a defined set of controls.

Deeper identity work. User lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver automation, and access governance and  designing the policy and procedures

AI governance. Conveo runs on AI internally as well as selling it. There's a growing body of work around how we govern our own agent and tool usage,  access, data boundaries, audit trails.

The automation roadmap. More say in what gets built and in what order, and eventually owning the decision rather than proposing it.




WHAT YOU BRING

The stack is learnable. The temperament isn't.

 - You genuinely like helping people. Not "tolerates end users" — you enjoy unblocking someone and explaining it in a way that leaves them better off. Personable, approachable, empathetic. This is the one we won't compromise on.

 - Meticulous, and calm when things break. Access provisioning is a security control, not an errand — a sloppy mistake is an incident. You know what to handle yourself and what needs another pair of eyes.

 - Comfortable working across time zones. Much of your support happens in writing, with colleagues you may rarely meet. You write things down without being chased.

 - You think in processes. You notice when something's being done the slow way, and can describe a better version clearly enough that someone else could build it.

 - You care about the physical environment. Working AV and a well-set-up office aren't beneath you — they're most of how people experience IT.

 - Solid IT fundamentals — macOS, networking basics, SaaS administration — and hands-on experience with an identity provider and Google Workspace. Okta or Entra ID, or a track record of picking things like this up fast.

 - You've run onboarding and offboarding before — groups, roles, access changes, secure deprovisioning.

 - Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-changing environment, without a defined procedure for everything.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Startup experience — somewhere small and fast-moving, where the answer to "who owns this?" was often "you, now"

 - Agentic AI — you've used AI agents in your own work and have a view on where they're reliable and where a human still needs to approve

 - Supporting a distributed or multi-country workforce

 - familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, 27701 & 42001

 - Setting up request tracking from scratch, especially somewhere that wanted visibility without bureaucracy

 - An early-stage IT function where the processes were still being built

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Library
jobs.description:
About the team

The ChatGPT Library team is building the persistence layer that helps people and organizations collaborate with increasingly capable AI systems. ChatGPT Library provides users with a durable place for their files, context, and creations, forming a substrate between humans and agents—a foundation for AI that can remember, retrieve, and act on the right context over time.

The team sits within the Personalization organization and partners closely with product, design, research, model, and infrastructure teams. Its work helps models become a useful second brain for individuals—for example, answering questions such as “What did I work on last week?”—and supports enterprise use cases that turn company knowledge into accessible, actionable context.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on engineering manager to lead a team of approximately 9–10 engineers and own execution across the product roadmap. This is a technical leadership role for someone who can set a high product bar, build a strong team, shape architecture, and contribute directly when needed. You will form and translate an ambitious product vision into a focused roadmap and help the team ship reliable, intuitive experiences at the intersection of AI, knowledge, and collaboration.

The ideal candidate leads by example. You are comfortable moving between people leadership, product decisions, technical design, and code. Founder or early-stage startup experience is especially valuable because the role requires urgency, sound judgment under ambiguity, and a willingness to operate across boundaries.

In this role you will

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of approximately 9–10 engineers while creating clarity, accountability, and a healthy execution rhythm.

• Own the engineering roadmap for Library, working with product and design partners to prioritize the highest-impact problems.

• Set a high bar for product quality, technical excellence, reliability, privacy, and user trust.

• Provide hands-on technical leadership through architecture reviews, prototyping, debugging, and coding when it will accelerate the team or unblock a critical path.

• Build systems that allow AI products to persist, retrieve, and use personal and organizational context effectively.

• Partner across Personalization, model, research, infrastructure, enterprise, and third-party integration teams to deliver cohesive end-to-end experiences.

• Navigate ambiguity, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI capabilities into a clear product and engineering plan.

• Hire exceptional engineers and develop technical leaders who can scale the team’s impact.

You might thrive in this role if you

• Have experience managing and developing high-performing engineering teams while remaining technically hands-on.

• Have a strong software engineering foundation and are comfortable contributing production code in a modern codebase.

• Have built and shipped user-facing products with a high quality bar, ideally in fast-moving or zero-to-one environments.

• Bring founder, startup, or early-stage product experience and know how to create momentum with limited structure.

• Can reason about distributed systems, data persistence, retrieval, permissions, collaboration, and the product implications of AI-native architectures.

• Communicate clearly across engineering, product, design, research, and executive stakeholders.

• Balance long-term technical direction with near-term delivery and know when to simplify, prototype, or invest for scale.

jobs.title: SRE / Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT NABLA

We are a team of entrepreneurs, clinicians and engineers committed to bringing back joy to the practice of medicine.



Together with a community of clinician innovators, we’ve harnessed the best of machine learning science to develop Nabla: the leading AI assistant that’s restoring the human connection at the heart of healthcare. By streamlining clinical documentation, Nabla is helping clinicians focus on what matters most - patient care. Today, over 100,000+ clinicians across 130+ healthcare organizations trust Nabla to support how they deliver care every day.



We’re at the start of an ambitious journey: Ambient listening, dictation, coding, and command capabilities are all converging into a proactive assistant that intuitively streamlines clinical and financial workflows.



Backed by a recent $70M Series C, we’re hiring to build the next generation of clinical AI and improve the lives of clinicians and patients everywhere.

This is a great time to join us!




YOUR TEAM

Our AI ambient documentation product is used by 100,000+ physicians across the US and EU, automatically generating clinical notes in real time during patient encounters and syncing them directly with EHR systems.



Product development at Nabla is organized into cross-functional squads, each owning a specific area end-to-end. You'll be joining the Platform squad, which owns the infrastructure and engineering foundations that the rest of the company builds on. 



We process billions of tokens monthly, serve real-time APIs in high-stakes clinical environments, and handle hundreds of thousands of note syncs with EHR systems every week, at a scale that keeps growing. 



As we scale, reliability engineering is becoming a first-class discipline within the team, and you'll have real ownership in defining how we operate and build for resilience.






WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own production reliability - take meaningful accountability for the stability, robustness, and performance of our platform across the full stack

 - Own and scale the on-call culture - take what's already in place and bring it to the next level: strengthen our runbooks, sharpen escalation paths, and build incident response processes that can scale with the team

 - Instrument everything - develop and improve our monitoring, alerting, and observability stack so that issues surface before they reach users, and our engineers can diagnose them fast

 - Drive the SRE roadmap - work with the Platform squad and Engineering leadership to define and prioritize the reliability investments that matter most, from SLOs to chaos engineering

 - Make engineers faster - reduce toil and improve the developer experience: better tooling, clearer feedback loops, smoother deployments

 - Collaborate across squads - partner with back-end, ML, and front-end engineers to embed reliability best practices into how we build, not just how we operate






YOUR DNA

 - Demonstrates strong, senior-level experience in SRE, infrastructure, or back-end engineering, ideally within fast-paced, production-critical environments.

 - Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure experience considered if you're ready to learn a new stack)

 - You've been part of a structured on-call process: alerting policies, runbooks, incident post-mortem, escalation flows

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals - you write clean, maintainable infrastructure-as-code and are as comfortable reviewing a Terraform PR as you are debugging a live incident

 - Autonomy is your default mode - you can identify what needs to be done, prioritize it yourself, and drive it to completion without being managed step by step

 - You communicate clearly and effectively with engineers and leadership across distributed teams, including during incidents, even outside regular working hours

 - Bonus: experience with Kubernetes, GCP-native tooling (Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub), PostgreSQL at scale, or security/compliance in a healthcare context



Candidates must be currently authorized to work in the United States and must be able to maintain authorization to work in the United States without requiring employer sponsorship, now or in the future. For this role, the Company is not able to sponsor, transfer, or extend employment-based visas or other work authorization.




BENEFITS

Just like we’re dedicated to supporting doctors’ well-being, ensuring yours is a top priority. We firmly believe that by prioritizing your well-being, we support you to excel in your work.

Here Are The Benefits You Get When Joining Nabla

 - Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary and stock options

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: 100% individual coverage for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

 - Time Off: Unlimited paid time off and 11 national holidays

 - Health Comes First: Unlimited sick leave

 - Parental Leave: Paid leave for new parents

 - Remote-friendly: $1,500 to purchase home office equipment

 - Trust & accountability: Full ownership of your time and schedule




LIFE AT NABLA

When you become a part of our company, you join a team of excellence-driven, curious, and genuinely kind individuals. Together, we're committed to making clinicians' lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe in a world where clinicians can focus on what they were trained to do - caring for their patients, and where no patient feels their visit was rushed.



We come to work excited to leverage AI to do more for clinicians. We’re obsessed with our users’ satisfaction and we actively seek out opportunities to engage one-on-one with clinicians to understand how Nabla can better help. We consistently look for ways to improve and do not shy away from doing the work to excel. Whether it’s a feature our users asked for, or a new article for our blog, we prioritize collaboration to deliver exceptional outcomes.



We love having fun as much as we love work. Our #nablabla channel is as active as our #feature-show-off channel, we exercise during the work day at least 3 times a week (yoga, running, pilates, or HIIT, your choice!), enjoy regular off-sites to gather the team, and travel to see each other in places like NY, Paris, San Francisco, and many other vibrant cities. Oh, and we’re constantly snacking on chocolate or nuts!



If this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, we look forward to reading your application!




OUR VALUES AT NABLA

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.



Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.



Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.



Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.



Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.






DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.



As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.







AVOID RECRUITMENT SCAMS: STAY SAFE AND INFORMED

There is an active employment scam which is now using Nabla to collect personal information or financial scams. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure whomever is contacting you truly represents Nabla and is utilizing a nabla.com http://nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity from people who could be pretending to be recruiters or senior professionals at Nabla. You can find more information following this link https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2023/05/scammers-are-hijacking-job-ads-heres-how-spot-fakes.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Producer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly systematic Senior Creative Producer to own the ad creative engine for one of our core D2C subscription products in the consumer AI category. You will be fully responsible for the full concept-to-performance loop, generating the angles, driving production volume, running structured tests, performing competitor research, and turning creative-level data into the next round of winning concepts.

This is a high-impact role. Your ad creatives will be the primary performance lever: your work moves CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS directly, and you are accountable for those numbers alongside the User Acquisition team. The bar is high and so is the upside; performance here is directly and significantly rewarded.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Creative Strategy & Concepting
   
   - Own the creative angle strategy: Define which hooks, pains, and value propositions get tested next
   
   - Develop creative concepts: demo-led ads, UGC-style video, statics, and AI-generated formats
   
   - Translate product features and capabilities into concrete, scroll-stopping propositions for target audiences
   
   - Build and maintain a documented library of proven angles, hooks, and creative patterns
   
   
   PRODUCTION & TESTING VELOCITY
   
   - Own the creative pipeline across ad networks (Google, YouTube, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Applovin, etc) shipping new concepts every week
   
   - Structure systematic A/B testing frameworks, isolate variables, and analyze the results to bring solid conclusions.
   
   - Produce clear creative briefs for designers to execute high-performing concepts aligned with the brand.
   
   
   PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS & ITERATION
   
   - Own creative-level metrics: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS
   
   - Generate testable hypotheses from performance data and retire underperforming angles quickly
   
   - Identify winning patterns, codify why they work, and scale them into new concept batches
   
   - Deliver structured creative performance reviews with clear recommendations for the next cycle
   
   
   MARKET RESEARCH & COLLABORATION
   
   - Run systematic competitor creative research across ad libraries and creative intelligence tools
   
   - Track emerging formats, platform policy shifts, and creative trends in the consumer AI category
   
   - Communicate daily with User Acquisition Managers, taking briefs on which angles need more volume




QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience

 - 4+ years producing performance ad creative for D2C or subscription consumer products

 - Proven track record of high-volume output, shipping and live-testing multiple new concepts weekly

 - Deep working knowledge of the major ad network ecosystems (Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, etc).

 - Demonstrated fluency with an AI production stack across image, video, voice, and scripting tools

 - Ability to read creative-level performance data independently and act on it without an analyst in the loop

 - Experience building structured creative testing frameworks, not ad-hoc one-off tests

 - Strong portfolio of ads with verifiable performance results. (Applications must include a CV and a portfolio of ad creative you personally produced).

Leadership Attributes

 - Systematic operator. You build repeatable creative processes, not one-time wins

 - Fully accountable for performance outcomes, not just delivery of assets

 - Fast and decisive under volume. Comfortable killing your own concepts when data says so

 - Treats User Acquisition as a working partner, not a downstream recipient of files




LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. 

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. 

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. 

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. 

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Take-Home Assignment

 - First Interview (60 minutes)

 - Final Interview (40 minutes)




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

jobs.title: VP Market Development
jobs.description:
VP Market Development - US

Home-based, East Coast US

Full-time

• Are you excited to lead a foundational commercial function and build the US sales organization from scratch?

• Do you have deep expertise in enterprise payments, embedded finance, or fintech - and want to lead into a new market?

• Can you carry a quota yourself while simultaneously recruiting, developing, and scaling a high-performing sales team?

Who We Are

Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability – built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast-growing SMEs to global enterprises.

We automate how money moves into and out of a business (payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection) through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use, and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.

As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam and Mumbai.

Now expanding into the US, Modulr has launched the same programmable, API-first infrastructure across ACH, RTP, FedNow, and push-to-card networks in partnership with leading sponsor banks and FIS.

Find out more about us on our website.

What You'll Do

• Lead the design, implementation, and scaling of Modulr's US commercial strategy across three segments - earned wage access, business payments, and non-bank lending.

• You'll build and lead a high-performing sales team, own the new-business number, carry a quota yourself, and establish our market presence with enterprise accounts.

• Develop US market commercial strategy including territory planning, named-account tiering, pricing strategy, and go-to-market approach across the three Phase 1 segments.

• Own the total new-business revenue number and manage the full sales pipeline from generation through close, ensuring quarterly forecasting accuracy and pipeline coverage ahead of target.

• Partner with Product, Solutions Engineering, and Marketing to refine product positioning for the US market and drive brand presence through speaking engagements and industry conferences.

• Execute on warm pipeline from existing UK customers with US operations and convert pilot customer references into scalable commercial motion.

Who You Are

What you'll need

• Extensive enterprise B2B sales experience with solid experience in a senior leadership role (VP/Head of Sales) managing teams.

• Proven success launching and scaling new markets or geographies, with consistent quota attainment and experience managing large deal cycles.

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, build, and retain top talent with a collaborative leadership style and track record of new hires reaching productivity in their first quarter.

• Deep knowledge of enterprise payments, embedded finance, or B2B SaaS sales models with working fluency in US payment rails (ACH, RTP, FedNow, push-to-card).

• Experience at fintech or financial services firms navigating regulatory requirements and compliance-driven sales cycles.

• Comfort with data-driven decision making and proficiency with CRM, sales enablement, and AI-powered tools.

• Passion for building something transformational and genuine excitement about embedded payments and fintech innovation.

What We Offer You

• Compensation- Competitive base salary and commission-based bonus plan.

• Equity- Equity participation via Company Share Option Plan.

• Benefits- 401(k) plan, comprehensive health insurance, flexible benefits, wellbeing support, and learning and development programs.

• Leadership- Opportunity to build and lead the US commercial organization and go-to-market framework from inception, with regional leadership role in a high-growth international fintech.

ModInclusion

At Modulr, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where everyone feels they belong and can bring their whole self to work. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds as we believe it is the right thing for our people, our business, and the community we operate in.

By submitting your CV, you consent to us using your personal data to assess your application, contact you, or share your CV with relevant hiring managers. You can request removal of your data at any time by emailing peopleops@modulrfinance.com - though this will withdraw you from consideration for the role.

jobs.title: Senior AB Journey Manager - Onboarding
jobs.location: US: San Mateo (1875 South Grant Street)
jobs.description:
The role and its impact

As our Senior AB Journey Manager for Onboarding, you will design and optimise the onboarding journeys that accountants and bookkeepers move through when they first partner with Xero. Your work will shorten the time it takes a new partner to get real value from Xero, lift activation rates, and build the foundation for long term revenue growth across one of our most important channels. You will own the acquisition and onboarding performance funnel, mapping how product, digital, AI and human led touchpoints connect for each entry point and partner segment, then using research, behavioural data and funnel analytics to find the friction worth removing and the moments worth improving.

From there, you will Go Bold by designing and running experiments that test new onboarding models, offers, messaging and channel mixes, using propensity scoring and AI powered personalisation to reach the right partner with the right action at the right moment. You will turn results into a prioritised roadmap, bring Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success along with you, and Go Further by scaling what works into globally aligned playbooks that regional teams can tailor to their own partners. This role sits where strategy meets execution, so you will be as comfortable setting a twelve month vision as you are building the tracking, the campaign brief or the playbook that makes it real.

The team and how they connect

You will join the Accountant and Bookkeeper Journeys team within Xero's Customer Growth and Engagement group, a small team of journey managers who each look after a stage of the partner lifecycle, from onboarding through to upsell and loyalty. The team is remote and async by design, with members across the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand, and a manager based in the UK. You will work as a peer to the other senior journey managers, sharing what you learn as you go, and partnering closely with regional go to market teams so journey work connects to the partner cohorts that matter most.

The team is currently working on

➔ Building the personalised onboarding journey strategy for the second half of FY27 across three to four priority accountant and bookkeeper segments
➔ Running a cross channel experimentation roadmap that tests digital only against sales led activation models, and the blends in between
➔ Putting partner propensity scoring, behavioural signals and AI driven personalisation to work so outreach lands at the right moment rather than in bulk
➔ Next up, designing post activation workflows and an attribution framework that links journey work directly to revenue, partner growth and early engagement

Where and how you can work

This role is based in our Bay Area office in San Mateo, and we offer a flexible, hybrid set up so you can work from a mix of home and the office. We come together on designated boost days for the planning, problem solving and connection that is simply better in person, and our office spaces are built for collaboration with quieter corners for focused work. Because your team spans the UK, Australia and New Zealand, some flexibility in your hours will help, and in return we care about outcomes rather than where you sit.

Here are some of the things we're looking for, for this role

➔ You will bring solid grounding in B2B marketing or customer journey strategy, ideally gained in a SaaS or fintech business, with commercial results you can point to
➔ Experimentation is where you do your best work, from designing a clean A/B test to reading the results honestly and deciding what deserves to scale
➔ Data is how you make decisions, whether that is funnel analytics, behavioural signals, customer segmentation or propensity models
➔ You Go Together by influencing Product, Marketing, Sales and Customer Success as a genuine partner, without relying on formal authority
➔ Ambiguity does not slow you down, and you Go Fast by shipping, learning and refining rather than waiting for a perfect plan
➔ Curiosity about accountants and bookkeepers sits behind your work, because the nuance between segments is where good journey design comes from

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheck. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role is: 

 - $162,400 - $243,600 USD

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ page.

Xero uses AI to help screen applications based on job-related qualifications. These tools assist our recruiters but do not make automated hiring decisions. A human recruiter reviews all candidates before any hiring action is taken.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships (SAP)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08328-6 cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics https://www.oxcan.org/news/prior-labs-and-oxford-cancer-analytics-partner-to-advance-liquid-biopsy-and-clinical-decision-making-in-lung-disease to preventing train failures with Hitachi https://siliconangle.com/2025/12/01/prior-labs-debuts-tabular-ai-foundation-model-scales-10-million-rows/. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ https://priorlabs.ai/about with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-hutter-9190b24b/, Noah Hollmann https://www.linkedin.com/in/noah-hollmann-668b9010b/, and Sauraj Gambhir https://www.linkedin.com/in/sauraj-g/, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP https://priorlabs.ai/blog-posts/priorlabs-sap as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.



The role

Prior Labs builds TabPFN, the foundation model for tabular data, and is now part of SAP. That puts a new class of model in front of one of the largest enterprise field organisations in the world.

Tabular Foundation Models is a new category. Your job is to make SAP's sellers and solution teams effective at finding, qualifying, and winning TabPFN opportunities, and to make the partnership work commercially for both sides. You will act as an individual contributor and in parallel build and manage the team around this motion.

This is not a generic alliances role. It is a go-to-market role focused on one deep partnership and the ecosystem around it.



What you'll do

 - Build and run enablement for SAP account executives and solution advisors, from qualification criteria through to demo, pricing guardrails, and objection handling.

 - Shape the joint commercial framework, co-sell approach, and deal registration so TabPFN is an easy product for an account team to carry.

 - Carry a focused set of lighthouse accounts with SAP account teams and help convert them in partnership with Prior Labs sellers.

 - Turn our commercial knowledge into industry use case maps, value cases, and scope templates that land inside SAP.

 - Co-develop packaged, industry-mapped use cases with SAP's industry teams.

 - Work day to day with our counterparts across SAP, and extend the motion to hyperscalers, marketplaces, and systems integrators alongside them.

 - Own the joint business plan, pipeline plan, and monthly partner pipeline reporting.

 - Build and manage a specialist team of partnerships managers working with SAP across enablement, specialized use-cases and account teams.
   
   

What we're looking for

 - You have sold to or through SAP successfully, and you know how SAP buys and how the organisation fits together.

 - You have built a partnerships or alliances motion from scratch as an individual contributor, sourcing, structuring, and closing partner-driven deals before there was a team or a playbook.

 - You have enabled a large field organisation and can point to pipeline that came out of it.

 - You understand how a large vendor's partner organization works: co-sell incentives, joint business plans, marketplace mechanics, and what actually motivates a partner's sales force to carry your product.

 - You have built in a high-growth company with no inherited process, and can create structure while navigating a very large organisation.

 - You are credible with a data science or ML buyer, and carry a deep understanding of the structured data ecosystem.



Nice to have

 - Marketplace and co-sell experience with a hyperscaler that produced real revenue.

 - Depth in one or more of our core industries: financial services, insurance, retail, energy, manufacturing.

 - Background selling or partnering into data and ML infrastructure.

 - Experience operating through an acquisition by, or deep integration with, a large strategic acquirer.




LIFE AT PRIOR LABS

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.




OUR COMMITMENTS

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy https://priorlabs.ai/recruiting-data-privacy page
