jobs.title: EVENT SHIFT SUPERVISOR
jobs.description:
Organization Overview:

The Florida Panthers are in their 33rd season in 2026-27 as one of the National Hockey League's premier franchises. As back-to-back Stanley Cup Champions in 2024 and 2025, the Panthers have won 11 of their past 12 postseason series and captured four Eastern Conference Championships. The organization is led by President of Hockey Operations & General Manager Bill Zito, entering his seventh season, and President of Business Operations Michael White, beginning his first full season.

Anchored by a championship culture on the ice, the Panthers are equally committed to building a world-class sports and entertainment platform off of it. The organization focuses on delivering an elite guest experience across all venues, deepening the connection between the team and the South Florida community and continuing to grow the sport for the next generation. The Panthers operate four facilities in Broward County: Amerant Bank Arena in Sunrise which is home of Panthers home games, concerts and events, Panthers IceDen in Coral Springs, the state-of-the-art Baptist Health IcePlex in Fort Lauderdale and renovated War Memorial Auditorium which hosts concerts and events year-round.

The Panthers are owned by Vincent J. Viola, a graduate of the United States Military Academy at West Point and a veteran of the U.S. Army. That foundation of selfless service shapes the organization's identity at every level. The Panthers' pillar program, "Heroes Among Us," honors a U.S. military veteran at every home game, and the Florida Panthers Foundation directs its efforts across four core pillars: veterans' affairs, children's health and education, raising awareness for the endangered Florida Panther and growing youth hockey throughout the region. The organization remains deeply committed to empowering and strengthening the diverse communities of South Florida and the tri-county area.

Event Shift Supervisor

• Organization: Florida Panthers Hockey Club

• Department: Housekeeping

• Reports To: Housekeeping Manager

• FLSA Status: Exempt (Salaried)

• Employment Type: Full-Time

• Location: Amerant Bank Arena, Sunrise, FL — On-Site

• Schedule: Flexibility required for evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedule

Job Summary

The Event Shift Housekeeping Supervisor is a full-time position responsible for the training, supervision, and performance management of the event shift housekeeping team at Amerant Bank Arena. This role ensures the efficient, timely, and detail-oriented execution of custodial operations throughout the facility.

Key responsibilities include oversight of cleaning standards, proper handling and use of cleaning products, chemicals, and equipment, inventory management, and quality assurance. The Supervisor works closely with internal departments and external partners to ensure the highest level of facility presentation and a positive guest experience.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Supervise event operations and time management for part-time event housekeeping staff; support Alliance staff during event shifts as needed

• Plan, develop, and manage weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual housekeeping projects

• Oversee daily supply usage and assist with ordering event-specific supplies

• Complete daily shift reports documenting operational challenges, staffing concerns, and facility conditions

• Train staff on proper use, handling, and storage of cleaning products, chemicals, equipment, and supplies

• Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) for all applicable products and materials

• Oversee and perform custodial tasks including sweeping, mopping, shampooing, dusting, polishing, trash removal, window cleaning, and restroom restocking

• Ensure all cleaning equipment and machinery are maintained in safe, functional working condition

• Conduct daily walkthroughs of the entire facility to ensure cleanliness standards are met and identify areas requiring repair or improvement; ensure prompt corrective action

• Complete assigned work orders according to established schedules and priorities

• Maintain appropriate inventory levels and implement effective inventory control measures to prevent loss or theft

• Enforce safety standards and maintain a safe working environment at all times

• Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Prior custodial or housekeeping experience preferred

• Strong work ethic, resilience, and empathy for teammates and guests

• Ability to understand and comply with company policies and procedures

• Receptive to supervision and responsive to management direction

• Maintains a professional appearance during work hours

• Strong listening skills with the ability to follow instructions accurately

• Ability to work effectively in large crowds and fast-paced environments

• Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills

• Punctual, dependable, and reliable attendance required

• Ability to lift up to 25 pounds without accommodation

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with a high level of attention to detail

• Ability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required by event schedules and hockey season

Work Environment

This role is performed within a large arena environment. Noise levels are frequently high, crowd traffic is heavy, temperatures may vary and are often cold, and there may be occasional exposure to pyrotechnics and special effects.

Physical Demands

• Prolonged standing and walking, including moving between work sites over long distances

• Climbing ladders, stairs, scaffolding, and ramps

• Balancing on narrow, slippery, or moving surfaces

• Stooping, kneeling, crouching, and reaching in various directions

• Pushing, pulling, lifting, and grasping objects; lifting items from lower to higher positions requiring use of upper extremities and back muscles

• Repetitive motion of wrists, hands, and/or fingers

• Must be able to communicate clearly through talking and hearing at normal speaking levels

Position Type / Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time, Exempt (Salaried) position requiring flexible scheduling. Work hours may include nights, weekends, and holidays based on operational and event needs.

jobs.title: Social Worker – Community Older People's
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting an Adult’s Social Worker to join its client’s Community Older People's team, based in Solihull. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to support older adults within the community, promoting independence, wellbeing, and positive outcomes through strengths-based and person-centred social work practice.

The successful candidate will manage a varied caseload of older adults with complex care and support needs, undertaking statutory assessments, reviews, safeguarding interventions, and support planning. Working collaboratively with service users, carers, families, health professionals, and partner agencies, you will play a key role in ensuring individuals receive appropriate support to remain safe, independent, and connected to their communities.

This role requires a confident Social Worker with strong assessment skills, sound knowledge of Adult Social Care legislation, and the ability to manage complex casework whilst delivering high-quality, outcome-focused interventions.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Managing a caseload of older adults with a range of care and support needs within a community setting.

• Undertaking Care Act 2014 assessments, reviews, reassessments, and support planning to identify eligible needs and promote positive outcomes.

• Developing, implementing, and reviewing person-centred Care and Support Plans that promote independence, wellbeing, and choice.

• Arranging and coordinating care packages, community support services, and support arrangements to meet assessed needs.

• Undertaking safeguarding enquiries and interventions in line with Adult Safeguarding legislation, policies, and procedures.

• Completing Mental Capacity Assessments and contributing to Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Assessing and managing risk effectively, balancing individual choice with safety and safeguarding responsibilities.

• Supporting adults and carers through periods of change, providing advice, advocacy, guidance, and access to appropriate services.

• Working collaboratively with health professionals, community services, care providers, carers, families, and partner agencies to achieve positive outcomes.

• Preparing professional reports, assessments, and documentation for legal proceedings, including Court of Protection matters where required.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, safeguarding discussions, case reviews, and professional forums.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records, assessments, reports, and support plans.

Qualifications and Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have;

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Older People's Services Experience: Experience supporting older adults within a community-based Adult Social Care setting.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake Care Act Assessments, reviews, risk assessments, and support planning.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns.

• Court Work: Experience preparing professional reports and supporting Court of Protection processes is desirable.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with health professionals, community services, care providers, families, and carers.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice and continuous professional development.

• Organisational Skills: Ability to manage a complex caseload effectively and work independently within a busy community team.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

Reasonable Adjustments:

If you consider yourself to have a disability or require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please highlight this at the earliest opportunity by contacting our team. With this information, we will provide appropriate support to you throughout the process and into your work placement.

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

jobs.title: Accuracy Checking Pharmacy Technician (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Tired of retail pharmacy?

Imagine working in a modern, technology-enabled online pharmacy where you can focus on accuracy, quality and patient safety—without standing behind a retail counter, selling OTC products or being interrupted every few minutes.

No retail counter. No walk-in patients. No OTC. Focus entirely on delivering safe, high-quality pharmacy care.

Modern pharmacy. State of the art renovated premises with onsite Free parking 

That's what we're building at Montu.

What is the job?

You will be a central, trusted part of our pharmacy operation at our Winnersh site — the person the team relies on to make sure every medicine that leaves our pharmacy is right. That means accuracy checking dispensed medicines, keeping standards high, and actively contributing to a culture where getting it right the first time is non-negotiable. You will not be managed through every task. You will be trusted to lead, to spot problems before they become incidents, and to raise the bar for everyone around you.

What will you be doing?

 - Carrying out accuracy checks on dispensed medicines, ensuring full compliance with legal, operational and safety standards

 - Taking ownership of the end-to-end dispensing process — not just your part of it

 - Maintaining clear, accurate prescription records and escalating discrepancies without hesitation

 - Actively mentoring junior colleagues and helping to build a team culture rooted in accountability, safety and quality

 - Staying sharp on professional development, best practice and regulatory changes — because you want to, not because you have to

 - Working with pace and purpose alongside the wider pharmacy team to ensure every patient gets exactly what they need, when they need it

What do you need?

 - Level 3 NVQ in Pharmacy Services (ACT) or equivalent ACT qualification

 - Current registration as a Pharmacy Technician with the GPhC — no exceptions

 - Solid, proven experience in a pharmacy setting with a strong track record in accuracy checking

 - Deep working knowledge of pharmacy regulations, policies and SOPs

 - The kind of attention to detail that you simply cannot switch off

 - Someone who communicates directly, takes accountability for their actions, and does not wait to be told what to do

 - A genuine, proven commitment to patient outcomes — not just patient care on paper, but real passion for what happens to the person at the end of the process

What we offer:

 - Part-time hours: We offer 16 and 24 hours per week contract (8 hours per day)

 - Generous Leave: 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after year one and 30 after year three) + 8 bank holidays

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

 - Private Healthcare

 - Flexibility and Wellness: cycle-to-work scheme, and more

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

 - Enhanced Maternity & Paternity Leave

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

What do you need?

 - Solid, proven experience in a pharmacy setting with a strong track record in accuracy checking

 - Deep working knowledge of pharmacy regulations, policies and SOPs

 - The kind of attention to detail that you simply cannot switch off

 - Someone who communicates directly, takes accountability for their actions, and does not wait to be told what to do

 - A genuine, proven commitment to patient outcomes — not just patient care on paper, but real passion for what happens to the person at the end of the process

What we offer:

 - Full-time contract: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, & Saturdays as either overtime or on a shift basis.

 - Pension Matching: Up to 5% employer matching contributions

 - Private Healthcare

 - Flexibility and Wellness: cycle-to-work scheme, and more

 - Growth Opportunities: Collaborate across teams and represent Montu at events, with support to grow your skills and impact

About Us

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments. Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need at every step of their journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare. At Montu UK, your work has a direct impact on improving patients’ lives and expanding access to modern medical treatments.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

As Senior Product Manager,Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the strategy and execution for how Bitwarden surfaces actionable security insights to admins, security teams, and executives. You will be meticulous about the data model, reporting experience, and the signals that drive user and organizational security posture improvements. You will partner with Design, Engineering, and GTM to build intelligence features that are clear, trustworthy, and drive meaningful action. You will partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering on how reporting capabilities accelerate enterprise deals and support compliance requirements. You will use qualitative customer feedback, usage analytics, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking deeply about both SMB admin and enterprise security team needs.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the in-product reporting experience, admin dashboards, health score frameworks, anomaly and risk detection surfaces, and data export capabilities

• Analyze how 1Password, Keeper, Okta, and adjacent IAM/PAM vendors approach access reporting, risk signals, and security posture scoring

• Model the relationship between reporting feature adoption and expansion ARR, retention, and enterprise deal velocity

• Define and monitor engagement metrics, report generation frequency, and export/integration usage by cohort and segment

• Support Sales on how Access Intelligence capabilities map to security buyer pain points, including RFP responses and deal-stage demos

• Share performance metrics, roadmap updates, and intelligence feature wins with leadership and cross-functional partners

• Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data modeling, and rapid prototyping

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

• 4+ years experience in product management

• Experience with B2B SaaS products

• Familiarity with data and analytics product patterns including dashboards, alerting, exporting

• Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive admin experiences

• Ability to have technical discussions with engineering around data pipelines, event schemas, and query performance

• Extremely organized and able to make highly informed prioritization & trade-off decisions with engineering

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others

• Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

• Interview with Senior Director, Product Management

• Interview with Chief Innovation Officer

• Interview with Chief Executive Officer

• Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

• Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

• Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

• We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

jobs.title: Head of Partnerships
jobs.description:
What is Amplemarket all about?

Amplemarket's premise is that a lot of the playbooks used by B2B sales teams that worked 5 years ago don't cut it anymore.

In today's environment, sales teams need to have a tremendous amount of information about their prospects to decide when is the best moment and channel to reach out in the most relevant way. You can't do this with 5 different data/sales enablement point solutions that don't share the same data schema and barely communicate with each other. Amplemarket is the all-in-one compound solution that enables this.

Our AI-powered sales platform helps B2B companies generate more opportunities thanks to our advanced lead generation engine, hyper-personalized sequencing, omnichannel outreach, and AI-powered smart actions. We are backed by Y Combinator, and we are powering the sales teams at some of the fastest-growing companies in the world like Deel, Moveworks, H1 and Vanta.

As Head of Partnerships, you’ll own our partnerships channel end-to-end - from defining the strategy and partner mix to driving revenue, pipeline, and long-term growth. You’ll work closely with Sales, RevOps, Marketing, Product, Legal, Finance, and CS to build a scalable and disciplined partner program.

You’ll lead the Partnerships team, build the processes and systems needed to scale the channel, and develop strong relationships with our most strategic partners.

You will:

• Define, implement, and prioritize our channel strategy: which partner types we invest in and which we deprioritize, the economics and guardrails for each, the target mix, and the run-rate the channel should reach.

• Be accountable for the channel's new business target and forecast, reported on a single governed revenue definition used in every recap, QBR, and target.

• Own the onboarding, mentoring, development, and performance management of the partner base, from first activation through ongoing reviews, with a program that rewards partners for performance.

• Own the quality of partner-sourced pipeline and its handoff into Sales, in close alignment with the AE team.

• Ensure partner compliance with program terms and agreements, applied consistently regardless of partner size, and keep the channel's concentration and legacy arrangements under control.

• Manage channel conflict by upholding clear rules of engagement between partners and the direct sales team, with strong internal and external communication.

• Drive new monetization for the channel by developing new initiatives with Marketing, Sales, Product, Legal, and partners, across the reseller, services, technology, and startup ecosystems.

• Discover new relationship opportunities in the reseller, service, and technology partner ecosystems.

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with our most important partners, and run a proactive planning process with them that sets shared performance goals and benchmarks.

• Proactively examine, clarify, and validate partner needs, and be the partner community's advocate in internal planning with Marketing, Sales, Product, RevOps, CS, and Legal.

• Lead, coach, and develop the partnerships team; build scalable processes; own the partner tooling and reporting stack with RevOps.

• Contribute to channel management best practices and keep the program benchmarked against the market.

About you:

• 5+ years in partnerships, channel, or alliances at a B2B SaaS company, including 2+ years owning a partner channel's revenue number.

• At least one channel strategy you defined and then implemented yourself, from diagnosis through program design to operating results.

• A track record of scaling a partner program while keeping it disciplined: consistent enforcement of terms, evolving program structures over time, and focusing effort on what converts.

• Fluent working with sales leadership and AEs, RevOps, Product, Legal, Finance, and CS.

• Operational discipline: you document, automate, and build things a small team can run.

• We are backed by YCombinator

• Fast growing startup with product market fit

• Founders also created https://fermatslibrary.com

• You can listen more about us here: https://bit.ly/2W7fVDR

We offer:

• Competitive Salary

• Health Insurance

• Stock Options

• Annual Company Trip in a secret location

• and more!

Amplemarket is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all.

Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that what truly matters is how your skills, knowledge and personality fit our company. So bring your best professional version of yourself, and apply - we'd like to hear from you!

jobs.title: Продавач - консултант - Mall Veliko Tarnovo
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

Като продавач - консултант ти ще заемаш ключова роля в създаването на изключително клиентско преживяване. Посрещайки нашите клиенти, ще им помагаш в техния избор, като същевременно ще ги запознаваш с нашите нови продукти и колекции. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Споделяш модните си познания, така че клиентите ни да изберат най-доброто за себе си.
• Работиш заедно с екипа, за да осигурите перфектно обслужване на клиента, включително активно промотиране на лоялната ни програма
• Подсигуряваш етажа и складовите помещения заредени и подредени.
• Помагаш с процедурите по отварянето и затварянето на магазина.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.

​

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

​

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в обслужването на клиенти в сферата на търговията ще е предимство.
• Удоволствие от общуването с клиенти и интерес към модата – ние ще те научим на всичко останало!

И човек, който е…​

• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Адаптивен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 150 лева;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на непълен работен ден, намираща се в град Велико Търново.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на български език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

*Оценка за ролите в магазина:

За да успеем да обработим голямото количество кандидатури за позицията продавач-консултант, използваме онлайн метод за оценка на уменията за подбор в някои от нашите магазини. Трябва да го попълниш като част от процеса на кандидатстване и селекция. След като завършиш оценката, ще имаш възможност да споделиш мнение и да зададеш въпроси. Ако срещнеш трудности или предпочиташ алтернативен метод за оценка, моля, свържи се с recruitment_support@hm.com. Изборът на алтернативен метод няма да има влияние върху твоята кандидатура.

За повече информация относно това как обработваме твоите лични данни, моля, виж нашето уведомление за конфиденциалност.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

About this Role

GiveDirectly's People Operations team owns global payroll, employee lifecycle, HR data, and total rewards delivery for a workforce spread across more than 20 countries. As the team has grown, so has the case for additional capacity at the leadership level to help own the operating engine that keeps payroll, service delivery, and people data running well every day. This role is that operating engine.

The Senior Manager, People Operations will manage a team of Associates and Coordinators (3 in total for now). You'll own end-to-end payroll delivery, the ticketing system and employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, transfers), HRIS data quality, and execution of the annual compensation cycle and mobility transactions. You'll be the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, and ticketing matters, and you'll build depth across your team so critical knowledge doesn't sit with one person.

This is a hands-on, builder's role. You'll set the operating model for your areas (cadence, controls, service standards) and be accountable for the outcomes, not just for delivering against someone else's plan.

Job Type: Full-time

Reports to: Senior Manager, People Operations

Level: Senior Manager

Location: Remote, with a requirement to overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours, and meaningful overlap with US Eastern hours. We can only employ people in certain places at the moment, so it's worth checking our current list of eligible countries to see if yours is included. If you're based elsewhere, it's not an automatic no, but do flag it early with your recruiter. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

Travel Requirements:  Must be able to travel ~3-4 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats and oversight.

What you'll do

• Team leadership and delivery: Lead, coach, and develop a team, setting clear priorities, standards of work, and ownership across payroll, service delivery, people data, and lifecycle operations Build depth and cover across the team so critical knowledge is not concentrated in one person, and establish clear escalation paths for absences and peak periods Define the operating model for your areas, including cadence, controls, service standards, and how work is prioritized against the function roadmap Serve as the first point of contact for country HR teams on operational payroll, data, lifecycle, and ticketing matters

• Global payroll: Own end-to-end payroll delivery for all global staff across entities and employer of record arrangements, ensuring accurate and timely processing of salaries, benefits, and deductions Own the payroll calendar, approvals, controls, and reconciliation, partnering with Finance on month-end, accruals, and people cost reporting Manage payroll providers operationally, including service quality, issue resolution, invoicing, and migrations Maintain current knowledge of payroll and statutory requirements across all operating locations, and drive the changes needed to stay compliant Run annual bonus administration end to end, ensuring calculations are accurate and payments are made within designated timelines

• People operations service delivery and employee lifecycle: Own the ticketing system and its operating rhythm, including triage, assignment, SLA performance, and reporting Own onboarding, offboarding, transfers, and role changes as designed processes rather than a series of transactions, and be accountable for the experience they produce Analyze trends and root causes of recurring issues and deliver structural fixes rather than repeat workarounds Drive the implementation of tools that improve functionality and user experience Act as the escalation point for complex or high-priority tickets, providing direction and ensuring timely resolution

• People data and systems: Own HRIS operations and data quality, including the method for preventing inaccurate data entering the system at source Own the people systems roadmap covering workflows, automation, integrations, and reporting infrastructure, partnering with IT and Finance on delivery Run the audit and reporting cycle, and maintain reporting standards in practice Produce the people reporting that leadership decisions rely on

• Total rewards and mobility operations: Execute annual compensation cycles, salary adjustments, and increase rollouts accurately and on time Own benefits administration across all locations, including renewals, enrollments, and issue resolution Produce the analysis behind compensation decisions, including benchmarking, compa ratio and cost modelling, and equity audits Execute mobility transactions end to end, including payroll and entity transfers, contract issuance, location-based pay changes, work permit and employer of record administration, and the supporting trackers and records

• Other tasks: Participate in cross-functional initiatives and organizational projects, representing People Operations requirements Perform all other duties that may be assigned to you from time to time by the Senior Manager, People Operations and stakeholders

What you'll bring:

• 6+ years of professional experience in People Operations, HR operations, or global payroll, including at least 2 years managing a team

• Direct experience running multi-country payroll and people operations, ideally including Sub-Saharan Africa and employer of record arrangements

• Demonstrated ownership of an HRIS, including an implementation, migration, or significant data quality turnaround

• A systems and process mindset, with the ability to point to workflows you have automated, simplified, or eliminated

• Working knowledge of employment and statutory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, with sound judgment on compliance risk and a clear sense of when to decide and when to escalate

• Strong analytical skills, including comfort with compensation and cost modelling and advanced spreadsheet ability

• Ability to liaise remotely with a wide range of people at all levels and across different cultures, and to act with credibility, tact, and diplomacy

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical people operations content to non-specialist audiences

• Comfort operating with incomplete guidance and shifting priorities, and strong time management across competing deadlines

• Professionally proficient in English

• Experience in a global non-profit, international development organization, or mission-driven company with an Africa presence preferred

• Familiarity with employer of record and contractor models across multiple countries (Oyster, Remote, or similar) preferred

• Aptitude to learn new software tools such as Slack, BambooHR, Jira, and Asana, and comfort with AI-assisted tools to streamline people operations workflows

• Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

• Base Salary: $114,660

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$11,466, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $13,415 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $126,126+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

• Base Salary: £77,600

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~£7,760, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be £9,079 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: £85,360+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

• Base Salary: $83,820

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10% (~$8,382, with potential for upside. For reference, with the organization’s current performance multiplier, this amount would be $9,807 in 2025)

• Estimated Total Compensation at Target: $92,202+

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in the US, UK or Kenya, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

#LI-REMOTE

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

jobs.title: Product Security Analyst
jobs.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com http://Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).



HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.



HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.




PRODUCT SECURITY ANALYST



REMOTE LOCATIONS


- BOSTON, MA


- AUSTIN, TX


- WASHINGTON, DC


- SEATTLE, WA


- SAN FRANCISCO BAY AREA, CA




POSITION SUMMARY 

HackerOne is a global leader in offensive security solutions. Our HackerOne Platform combines AI with the ingenuity of the largest community of security researchers to find and fix security, privacy, and AI vulnerabilities across the software development lifecycle.

As a Product Security Analyst, you will join HackerOne’s Technical Services organization and work directly with some of the world’s most skilled security researchers to help customers identify and remediate impactful vulnerabilities. You will play a critical role in validating, reproducing, and communicating security findings across bug bounty and vulnerability disclosure programs while helping maintain a high-quality experience for both customers and hackers.

As we continue evolving our AI-powered offensive security platform, this role offers an opportunity to deepen technical expertise in web and mobile application security while collaborating with globally distributed teams and the broader hacker community.



At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Boston MA, Austin TX, Washington DC, Seattle WA, or San Francisco Bay Area CA. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

Please note: this role requires weekend work. You will work both Saturday and Sunday and ideally your days off are two of Tues, Wed, or Thurs.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Evaluate vulnerability reports submitted by security researchers to determine validity, severity, exploitability, and business impact for HackerOne customers using Data-Driven Decision Making and established security frameworks such as CVSS.

 - Independently reproduce reported vulnerabilities across web and mobile applications, applying First Principles Problem Solving to validate findings, identify root causes, and clearly communicate impact.

 - Collaborate directly with security researchers to gather missing information, clarify technical details, and improve report quality while maintaining clear and professional communication with customers.

 - Create concise, technically accurate summaries for validated findings, including reproduction steps, impact analysis, and remediation guidance.

 - Demonstrate Change Agility by adapting to evolving customer environments, changing program scopes, emerging attack techniques, and shifting operational priorities.

 - Contribute to an AI-First approach by leveraging automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve operational efficiency, report analysis, and vulnerability triage quality.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Technical Services teammates and customer-facing teams to ensure timely handling of vulnerabilities and a high-quality customer experience.

 - Proactively identify opportunities to improve internal processes, documentation, tooling, and triage workflows to enhance scalability and consistency across the Technical Services organization.

 - Note: weekend work required (you will receive two days off in the week)




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS  

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience performing security testing, vulnerability research, or ethical hacking on web and mobile applications.

 - Strong technical understanding of common application security vulnerabilities, including the OWASP Top 10.

 - Experience using security testing tools such as Burp Suite and familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks including CVSS.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Ability and desire to work weekends (with two days off during the week)




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 - Experience participating in bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs.

 - Experience reproducing and validating vulnerabilities submitted by external researchers or customers.

 - Familiarity with scripting or automation used in security testing or operational workflows.

 - Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and maintain operational excellence in a fast-paced, globally distributed environment.




COMPENSATION BAND

Tier A (SF Bay Area) - $135,000 to $155,000 (+ equity)

Tier B (all other locations) - $120,000 to $140,000 (+ equity)



#LI-MH1


JOB BENEFITS:

 - Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance*

 - Equity stock options

 - Retirement plans

 - Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO

 - Paid maternity and parental leave

 - Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)

 - Employee Assistance Program

*Eligibility may differ by country

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com https://remote.com/preemployment-faq as our Employer of Record (EOR).



Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available. 



Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.



HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.



This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.



For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného Senior účtovníka/účtovníčku, ktorý/á prevezme kľúčovú úlohu v oblasti lokálneho účtovníctva a finančného reportingu pre slovenskú entitu spoločnosti TOMRA RECYCLING.

Táto pozícia nie je o rutinnom účtovaní. Budete mať významný vplyv na kvalitu finančných procesov, podporovať automatizáciu, spolupracovať s vedením spoločnosti a podieľať sa na ďalšom rozvoji finančného oddelenia.

Čomu sa budete venovať?

🟠zodpovednosť za hlavné účtovné procesy v súlade so slovenskou legislatívou,

🟠účtovanie faktúr, spracovávanie platieb a účtovanie miezd, príprava DPH, zodpovednosť za register majetku

🟠spolupráca na príprave mesačných, kvartálnych a ročných uzávierok,

🟠príprava finančných a štatistických výkazov

🟠spolupráca s externými audítormi pri auditoch,

🟠inventarizácia účtov hlavnej knihy a koordinácia inventarizácie,

🟠identifikácia a riešenie účtovných nezrovnalostí,

🟠kalkulácia účtovania rezerv a dohľadných položiek

🟠návrh a implementácia procesných zlepšení,

🟠podpora automatizácie a digitalizácie finančných procesov,

🟠poskytovanie odborného vedenia a podpory kolegom v rámci tímu,

🟠úzka spolupráca s lokálnym aj medzinárodným finančným tímom.

Úspešný kandidát by mal mať:

• minimálne 5 rokov skúseností v oblasti účtovníctva,
• veľmi dobrú znalosť slovenských účtovných a daňových predpisov,
• skúsenosti s mesačnými a ročnými uzávierkami,
• skúsenosti s DPH, daňovými priznaniami a auditmi,

• skúsenosti s ERP systémami (SAP, IFS alebo ekvivalent),
• angličtinu na úrovni umožňujúcej každodennú pracovnú komunikáciu,
• analytické myslenie a orientáciu na riešenie problémov.

Výhodou bude:

• skúsenosť z výrobného alebo medzinárodného prostredia,
• skúsenosti s automatizáciou procesov,
• znalosť Power BI,
• skúsenosti s IFRS reportingom.

Prečo si vybrať TOMRA?

V TOMRA budete súčasťou globálnej spoločnosti, ktorá sa venuje riešeniam pre obehové hospodárstvo a udržateľnosť. Vaša práca bude mať priamy dopad na fungovanie spoločnosti a budete mať priestor prinášať vlastné nápady a zlepšenia.

Ponúkame stabilné pracovné prostredie, dlhodobý rozvoj a možnosť pracovať s odborníkmi z celého sveta.

Ponúkame:

jobs.title: Senior NPI Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.

We are seeking a Senior NPI Quality Engineer to join Bevi’s manufacturing and quality team. This role reports to the Director of Quality Engineering, and will be responsible for measuring, improving, and maintaining the quality of Bevi’s products. The Senior NPI Quality Engineer will work closely with NPI and sustaining engineering teams to identify and prioritize targets for improvement. The ideal candidate will embrace the Bevi core values, learning new skills, working across disciplines, and driving issues to completion.

Your Day to Day

• Lead quality team in product development activities and product design reviews, ensuring quality requirements and reliability standards of components, subsystems, and final products are embedded into the design.

• Serve as the lead subject matter expert for Customer Care and Field Service teams to triage and resolve quality issues impacting end-customers while ensuring top-level quality metrics are met.

• Apply an Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) framework to drive a proactive approach to quality and minimize reactive risks.

• Lead the implementation of key quality processes, including defining CTQs, PFMEAs, quality control plans, MSA/GR&R, FAI, and Ok2Ship.

• Ensure excellent manufacturing quality through tight process controls, preventive measures, and timely corrective action implementation.

• Lead quality initiatives with the Supply Chain team to establish a formal qualification process for new suppliers.

• Act as the technical liaison between Engineering, Manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure all requirements are fully understood and complied with.

• Facilitate and lead cross-functional teams through comprehensive Root Cause Analysis for failures occurring in manufacturing or at end-customer sites.

• Regularly generate, publish, and present quality KPIs and relevant operational metrics to executive leadership.

• Maintain supplier quality data collection activities, running periodic reports to summarize data and initiate supplier continual improvement programs.

Requirements

• Passionate about delivering best-in-class quality to customers and stakeholders.

• 5-7 years minimum work experience as a Quality Engineer or 2-3 years at a Senior QE level, with NPI experience preferred.

• Demonstrated capacity to lead with an appropriate blend of tenacity and grace while acting as a culture carrier during periods of growth and challenge.

• Strong communicator able to facilitate discussion and present data across all levels of internal and external organizations.

• Strong analytical and technical skills to interpret specifications and drawings, perform problem-solving, and analyze data to lead improvement initiatives.

• Very strong background in APQP, statistical tools, PFMEAs, quality control plans, PPAP, and root cause problem-solving frameworks such as 8D.

• Experience leading process improvement teams and managing major projects.

• Experience using SPC tools with a deep understanding of how to apply them to measure process reliability and repeatability within the supply chain.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Mechanical, Electrical, or Manufacturing Engineering.

• Experience in the commercial appliance industry with knowledge of NSF and UL standards is a plus.

• ASQ certifications such as CQE and CQA are a plus.

• Ability to work in the office 4-5 days per week.

• Must be able to travel up to 20%, primarily domestic with occasional international travel as needed.

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal AI Platform Architect to define and build the next generation of our AI platform and cloud-native application ecosystem. This is a senior technical leadership role responsible for designing scalable, secure, and resilient platforms that enable AI-powered products, intelligent automation, and modern software development across the organization.

The ideal candidate is hands on technologist with extensive experience designing cloud-native applications and AI-enabled platforms. They understand how modern APIs, event-driven systems, orchestration frameworks, and agentic AI capabilities come together to create enterprise-scale solutions that are secure, observable, and operationally efficient.

This role partners closely with product leadership, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders to establish architectural direction, define platform standards, and guide the implementation of next-generation AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build a scalable AI platform supporting LLMs, agentic workflows, and federated development across multiple teams
• Establish architectural standards for AI governance, security, evaluation strategies, and operational excellence
• Architect cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform supporting enterprise-scale workloads
• Define platform patterns for microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
• Build CICD pipelines that deploy automatically to the cloud while interfacing with legacy systems
• Provide architecture guidance and governance across engineering teams through reviews and standards
• Balance strategic platform vision with hands-on implementation to earn respect from engineering teams
• Enable teams to add new components, agents, and functionalities within the overarching platform

Required Qualifications & Technical Experience

• 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise software platforms with proven success at scale
• Strong GCP expertise - deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform services, semantics, and AI capabilities (Vertex AI preferred)
• AI platform experience building production systems that support product use cases, including agentic frameworks, LLMs, and orchestration
• Evaluation strategy experience - particularly building eval loops in production for monitoring and tuning AI systems (highly preferred)
• Event-driven architecture and distributed systems expertise with understanding of microservices and APIs
• Platform security and governance knowledge, including responsible AI practices
• Python proficiency (primary language for AI development), plus experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native tools
• Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• Establish the architectural vision for our enterprise AI platform.
• Define reusable cloud-native platform patterns supporting AI-enabled applications.
• Enable engineering teams through standardized platform capabilities and architectural guidance.
• Improve platform scalability, security, observability, and operational efficiency.
• Accelerate the adoption of AI capabilities while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and engineering quality.

Additional Information

We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at an Informa event – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

If you would like to request reasonable adjustments or accommodations to assist your participation in the hiring process and, or in the advertised position, please inform the appropriate Talent Acquisition Partner for the role once they have been in touch. Your request will be reviewed and considered in confidence.

Informa TechTarget complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.title: (Senior) Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we're building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We're backed by world-class investors including CapitalG and Index Ventures, as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI and Goldman Sachs.

Duna's infrastructure is part of the product. Enterprise customers buy our reliability, security posture and auditability, not just our features.

Since your role with us will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING IN THIS ROLE

 - Own and harden our platform: AWS, Kubernetes, Postgres, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and incident response

 - Make security the default, with least privilege, secrets management and tenant isolation built into the platform instead of bolted on later

 - Turn our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments into controls and evidence that are automated, not a yearly scramble

 - Turn recurring operational toil into self-service systems that engineers actually adopt, from preview environments to internal access

 - Help Duna run AI agents in engineering safely, with the sandboxes, guardrails and human checkpoints that make it possible

 - Take calm ownership of incidents, and make sure the system gets better afterwards, not just the moment

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deep, hands-on experience with AWS (or comparable), Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability

 - Real security engineering skills: you turn least privilege and auditability requirements into working systems

 - Comfort with the enterprise IT side of a startup, from certifications and customer security reviews to identity and device management

 - High agency in ambiguity, turning a vague problem into a shipped plan

 - Pragmatic judgement about when to harden, when to simplify and when to leave something alone

 - Curiosity about what AI changes in how we build and run software

Our platform runs on AWS and Kubernetes with Terraform, Postgres and RabbitMQ, alongside a Node.js and TypeScript product stack built on event sourcing. You will not have used all of it before. We care more about the depth you bring and how you pick up the rest.

A final note before you apply: please read through our website in detail. You'll find the fundamentals there: what we believe in, how we work, and why we're building this company.

We're a remote-first, fast-moving team of builders looking for exceptional people who love to create, build, and ship. Beyond passion and grit, we highly value curiosity, authenticity and kindness.

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!


PS. We are looking to hire passionate people from a variety of backgrounds. So even if you don't check all the boxes, we welcome your application!

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to design, build, and scale internal platforms and software tools that power our infrastructure operations. You will treat operational challenges as software problems, developing clean services and developer platforms that make managing our global infrastructure reliable, fast, and effortless.

Responsibilities

• Build Infrastructure Software: Architect, write, and maintain scalable services, APIs, and tools that automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and runtime operations.

• Streamline Developer Workflows: Develop platform software and self-service tools that reduce operational toil, enabling engineering teams to deploy and manage resources safely and efficiently.

• Drive Engineering Best Practices: Apply standard software engineering practices—including modular design, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD—to infrastructure codebases and tooling.

• Ensure System Reliability: Write observability frameworks, automated testing pipelines, and self-healing tools to maintain high availability and proactively catch operational failures.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Security, Systems, and Product Engineering teams to integrate infrastructure software seamlessly across the application lifecycle.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Demonstrable experience as a Software Engineer building production software, with an emphasis on backend systems, APIs, or developer platform tools.

• Strong proficiency in modern programming languages (e.g., Go, Python, Java, or Rust) with a track record of writing clean, testable, and maintainable code.

• Solid understanding of software design patterns, API architecture (REST, gRPC), and data structures applied to operational tooling.

• Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and programmatically interacting with infrastructure APIs.

• Strong analytical, debugging, and system troubleshooting skills to diagnose issues across both application logic and underlying infrastructure.

Bonus Points

• Experience writing software that interacts with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure) or container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Familiarity with building robust CI/CD systems, automated integration testing, or continuous deployment tooling.

• Active contributions to open-source developer tools, CLI applications, or infrastructure platforms.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Strategic Projects Lead, Managed Services

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The Role

As a Strategic projects lead focused on AI projects, you’ll play a key role in delivering some of Prolific’s most important and complex client programmes.
You’ll own client engagements end to end, working directly with clients to understand what they’re trying to achieve and translating their requirements into successful human data programmes. You’ll bring together teams across Prolific to deliver the right solution, while owning the client relationship, project execution and overall success of the engagement.
This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving area of AI. Projects can be complex and requirements can evolve quickly, so you’ll need to be comfortable working through ambiguity, getting into the detail when needed and making sound decisions to keep delivery moving.
You’ll combine strong client management with an understanding of AI and human data workflows, helping us deliver excellent work for our clients while continuing to improve how we deliver AI projects at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Own the end-to-end delivery of complex AI projects, from understanding client requirements and shaping the delivery approach through to execution and completion.

• Act as the primary point of contact for your clients, building strong relationships and providing clear, consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle.

• Work with clients to translate complex or evolving requirements into clear project scopes, delivery plans, success criteria and practical solutions.

• Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Product and Engineering to coordinate resources, solve delivery challenges and ensure projects meet both client and Prolific goals.

• Stay close to project execution, identifying risks or issues early and working through problems directly to keep delivery on track.

• Own and track key delivery metrics including quality, timelines, budgets and profitability, using project data to identify opportunities to improve outcomes.

• Help improve the way we deliver AI projects, developing more effective and scalable processes, tools and ways of working as our client base grows.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

• 3–6+ years of experience managing complex client projects or programmes, ideally within AI/ML, human data, data services or another technical environment.

• A solid understanding of AI technologies and the AI/ML development lifecycle, including familiarity with areas such as data collection, annotation, evaluation or validation.

• Strong client-facing skills, with experience building trusted relationships and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience taking complex or ambiguous client requirements and turning them into clear, executable plans and successful outcomes.

• A hands-on approach to delivery and problem-solving, with the ability to get into the detail, identify what’s going wrong and drive solutions forward.

• Strong analytical and commercial judgement, with experience managing project KPIs, budgets, profitability, quality and delivery performance.

• Proven ability to lead across teams, align different stakeholders and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and requirements can change.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research.

Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.
