jobs.title: Space Mechanical Design Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.



About the Summer Internship Program

Internships at Antares are anything but ordinary. You'll work alongside our team as we design, build, and test fission microreactors built to deliver reliable energy for critical missions on Earth, in space, and underwater.

Our interns contribute to real work from day one. Depending on your role, you may touch hardware, write and test software, support manufacturing and operations, or help build the systems that allow Antares to move quickly as we scale. You'll work alongside engineers, operators, and other experts solving challenging problems—and you'll leave your internship with hands-on experience that's difficult to find anywhere else.

We work hard, move quickly, and take pride in what we're building. If you're excited to learn by doing and want to contribute to the next generation of nuclear energy, we'd love to have you join us next summer.



We will be running two separate cohorts to accommodate students on both semester and quarter schedules:

Cohort #1

Monday, May 17 – Friday, August 13

Cohort #2

Monday, June 14 – Friday, September 10



All internship roles are based at our Torrance headquarters and require interns to work onsite five days per week. We will not be considering candidates for remote or hybrid arrangements.

Interns will receive a relocation and housing stipend as part of their offer package.



About the Role

As a Space Mechanical Design Intern, you will contribute to the mechanical design and development of Antares reactor and power systems, with a particular focus on space applications. You will work on hardware ranging from space radiators and power conversion components to reactor mechanical systems, taking projects from early design and manufacturing concepts through integration and testing.

You will also evaluate how Antares systems could be deployed across different applications, translating customer operating conditions into technical requirements and concepts of operation. This role offers exposure to both detailed hardware development and the system-level engineering required to deploy nuclear power systems in space and terrestrial applications.



Roles and Responsibilities:

 - Design, develop, and test space radiator hardware

 - Develop manufacturing approaches for scaling radiator technology from small test coupons to full-scale hardware

 - Contribute to the development and integration of space power conversion systems

 - Own the design and development of power conversion components such as recuperators, primary heat exchangers, and piping

 - Support overall mechanical integration of space power conversion systems

 - Contribute to reactor mechanical design

 - Perform microgrid analyses, including identifying nominal customer load profiles, outage frequencies, integration with other energy sources, and power distribution requirements

 - Develop reactor deployment assessments and concepts of operation for candidate applications

 - Evaluate external markets, including process heat, to identify potential reactor deployment concepts and customer use cases

 - Translate potential customer applications into technical requirements

 - Expand technoeconomic analyses to evaluate potential reactor applications and deployment scenarios



Basic Qualifications:

 - Enrolled in at least a bachelor’s degree program, and going into your Junior or Senior year of studies

 - Must have prior internship experience, or significant (>1yr) project team, laboratory, or research experience



Preferred Skills & Experience:

 - GPA of 3.5 or above

 - Experience in a University club or organization, leadership role preferred

 - Strong interpersonal and technical communication skills (examples: leading a student project team, presenting research at conferences, etc.)

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

 - Ability to work cross-departmentally with different groups and teams

 - Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements

 - Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively



Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Inventory Controller
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position:

The Inventory Controller is responsible for analyzing, improving and maintaining optimal inventory health to support efficient operations and evolving business needs. This role requires strong analytics capabilities, clear communication, cross functional collaboration, sound judgement, and well-structured inventory planning. The controller drives accuracy, prevents shortages, identifies risks and supports continuous improvement across the supply chain.

Essential Job Duties:

Inventory Accuracy & Root Cause Analysis

• Analyze recurring discrepancy patterns and implement proactive corrective actions.
• Perform in-depth root cause analysis for complex exceptions.
• Troubleshoot and resolve material master related discrepancies.

Inventory Health, Monitoring & Optimization

• Analyze inventory data to report trends, risks and opportunities from improvement.
• Identify overstated quantities in the system that may impact production and prevent material shortages.
• Monitor inventory levels to support operational reliability.
• Identify and resolve expired or at-risk inventory.

Cross-Functional Issue Resolution

• Investigate and resolve inventory issues related to stock transfer orders across internal plants.
• Act as a liaison between Inventory Control and broader operation groups.
• Support inventory impact of New Product Introduction life cycle projects.
• Reporting & Communication
• Prepare and present inventory reports, KPIs and insights to leadership and crossfunctional stakeholders.
• Use data to influence decision-making and optimize inventory strategies.
• Provide mentorship by sharing inventory knowledge and analytical insights with team members.

Process Governance & System Controls

• Maintain Kanban systems that align with operational replenishment strategies.
• Participating in UAT sign-off for system or process changes.

Continuous Improvement & Project Support

• Collaborate cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement in Inventory Accuracy and processes.
• Support operational readiness efforts, analytics projects and ongoing process enhancements.
• Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

Required Skills and Experience:

• Minimum 5 years in warehouse, inventory control experience
• Analytical Skills: ability to interpret complex data, perform trend analysis, and translate insights in actionable recommendations
• Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills for reporting findings, and collaborating with stakeholders
• Liaison Skills: Proven ability to work cross-functionally and coordinate between departments
• Decision-Making Skills: sound judgment in evaluating options and recommending inventory actions under varying conditions
• Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Required Education and Training

• Associate’s degree or the equivalent 5 years of experience in inventory management or related area.

Working Conditions

• Ability to lift 35 pounds frequently each day.
• Extensive walking and repetitive physical motion (squatting, bending, lifting) is required (at least 70% of hours worked).
• Safe operation of all material handling equipment (forklifts, pallet jacks. Portable stairs etc.) with ISI Training and Certification

• Ability to multi-task.

SAP and Agile software experience preferred.

jobs.title: Conveyor Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
About Atlas Energy Solutions

Headquartered in Austin, TX with operations in Kermit and Monahans, TX, Atlas Energy Solutions is the leading provider of frac sand to the Permian Basin. We are proud of what we do – we have state of the art manufacturing facilities, high quality products, outstanding customer service, and exceptional work culture and a commitment to giving back to the community. Atlas was established in 2017 by a team of career oil & gas operators led by Bud Brigham. Since then, we’ve added top industrial sand mining talent and have navigated, grown and innovated our way through the recent ups and downs in the commodity markets. We’re very excited about what we see in front of us, and we think you will be too – so come join the team!

The Conveyor Maintenance Supervisor provides technical support for the safe and efficient operation of the 42-mile-long Dune Express equipment. Duties include but are not limited to assisting maintenance in repairing equipment such as conveyors, compressors, pumps, diesel engines and control devices. Assist in troubleshooting issues, repairs, failures of production and facilities equipment and ensures maximum efficiency and effectiveness of operations.  Work with planner/scheduler on coordinating jobs and required downtime.  Help develop SOP’s and PM’s to improve operations and mechanic job skills.  Understands process flow and evaluates ways to increase operating efficiency.

Safety:

Follow all company and MSHA established regulations and guidelines.  This includes, but not limited to:

• Proper Lockout/Tagout procedures

• Pre-shift/Operational inspections.

• Safe operation of plant equipment.

• Wear proper PPE, i.e., safety boots, safety glasses, goggles and face shields, hard hats, welding helmets and fall protection.

• Safety meetings with crews

Environmental:

• Proper storage and disposal of universal waste.

• Report any spills (large or small) to supervisor or EH&S director.

Essential Functions:

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions or employment related responsibilities of the job to the fullest extent required under federal and state law except where doing so would result in a direct threat of harm to the employee or third party or an undue hardship on the Company

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Supervise a team of 20+ fixed and mobile equipment mechanics

• Gather technical information for maintenance crews to perform the jobs safely and efficiently.

• Develop SOP’s and procedures to improve employees’ skills.

• Work with maintenance team to help maintain our 42 mile right of way cleanliness and appearance through general housekeeping, including washing and maintain company vehicles and tools.

• Make sure equipment repairs are being done properly and parts are being issued to the work orders, checks the status of equipment availability, and work with logistics supervisors to coordinate downtime.

• Help develop tasks related to predictive and preventative maintenance programs to improve the operation of equipment.

• Be able to interrupt blueprints and equipment manuals.

• Work with Warehouse specialist to maintain critical spares for plant equipment.

• Contact and work with contractors/vendors on projects and to keep up with the latest technologies.

• Coordinate and plan down time efficiently to maximize uptime of production and communicating with logistics when tasks are being scheduled.

• Knowledge of how equipment works, from gearboxes, conveyors, hydraulics, load out chutes, gas and diesel engines, vehicle and machine repairs, with the ability to troubleshoot and analyze equipment problems.

• Coordinate work with Planner/Scheduler and follow up on completed jobs.

• Work overtime as required to minimize equipment downtime.

• Perform any other tasks asked of you by your supervisor.

• Always looking for new and better ways to improve process and maintenance procedures.

Position Qualifications

• Can perform all tasks of Level 1, 2 and Senior mechanics

• Basic hand tool knowledge.

• Safe work practices and procedures.

• Methods, equipment and materials used in the mechanical trade.

• Knowledge of health, safety and environmental regulations.

• Applicable laws, codes, regulations, policies and procedures

• Working knowledge of blueprints, shop drawings and sketches

Physical Requirements/Working Conditions:

• Regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear.

• Required to stand; walk; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, sit and climb or balance.

• Must regularly lift and/or move up to ten pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to fifty pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move more than fifty (50) pounds.

• Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

• Capable of working extended hours when needed.

• Must be able to tolerate conditions associated with no air conditioning or heat.

Skills & Abilities

• Education: High School Diploma or GED required.

• Sufficient education to make appropriate arithmetic equations and complete written documentation and records; or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training that provides the desired knowledge, skills and characteristics. Must be able to read and interpret drawings, follow routers, use simple math, and use basic hand-held measuring tools.

• Experience: Minimum Five (5) plus years’ experience in Industrial and/or mining related fields at a supervisory level is required and with a good understanding of overland conveyors, hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical repairs. Must have experience in maintaining and repairing process equipment and heavy equipment.

• Computer Skills: Basic computer skills required to use maintenance related software for writing work orders and troubleshooting. Proficiency with Microsoft word and Excel are required.

Certifications& Licenses

Courses and/or logged hours in the industrial maintenance field are recommended. Knowledge in equipment reliability and preventative maintenance preferred. Prior training and certification in the following areas highly desirable: welding certification, vibration analysis, electrical/mechanical, bearing training and conveyor systems.

• A valid state driver's license with no active violations within the previous three years

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Maintenance (Arsenal)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE
At Anduril, maintenance isn't an afterthought — it's the backbone that keeps our high-throughput, automation-
heavy factories running. As we scale production at Arsenal-1, our new manufacturing campus in Ashville, Ohio,
we are standing up the site maintenance organization for Building 1 from a blank sheet of paper.
We are looking for a Senior Manager of Maintenance to own that build end to end. This is the senior site leader
accountable for the maintenance and reliability of Arsenal-1 Building 1 as it ramps to multi-program, two-shift
production supporting Fury, Barracuda, Altius, Roadrunner, and additional advanced programs. You will set the
maintenance strategy, design and staff the organization, build the leadership team beneath you, stand up the
preventive maintenance and spare parts programs, and establish the reliability culture that everything
downstream depends on. As a member of the site operations leadership team, you will represent maintenance
in capital planning, facility expansion, and program-launch decisions.
You will report directly to the Senior Director of Manufacturing Operations at Arsenal-1 and partner closely with
Anduril's central maintenance Center of Excellence to bring enterprise standards to life on our floor.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Set the maintenance strategy and build the organization from scratch — define the operating model, org structure, shift coverage, budget, and multi-year staffing plan for Arsenal-1 Building 1, and grow it as production ramps across two shifts.

• Build and lead a multi-layer team — hire and develop maintenance managers and supervisors beneath you, along with skilled-trades technicians (electrical/controls, mechanical/millwright, and facilities) and planners/schedulers spanning administrative, tactical, and strategic roles.

• Stand up the preventive and predictive maintenance program — develop PM schedules, job plans, and reliability strategies for a mixed environment of manual and automated assembly, machining and fabrication, and building/facility systems.

• Own the spare parts and MRO strategy and budget — define critical spares for the program plan of record, set stocking levels and reorder points, establish the storeroom, own the maintenance operating and capital budget, and build OEM and supplier relationships to protect uptime.

• Deploy maintenance systems and data — implement and administer the CMMS for work order management, asset tracking, PM compliance, and KPI reporting, configured to the enterprise standard.

• Support new equipment and automation launches — partner with controls engineering, automation, and facilities on equipment installation, commissioning, spare-parts provisioning, and maintainability from day one.

• Own tooling, calibration, and documentation — establish calibration schedules, asset registers, equipment manuals, and maintenance records for the site.

• Drive reliability and continuous improvement — track and improve uptime, MTBF/MTTR, PM compliance, and cost, and lead root-cause analysis on chronic and high-impact failures.

• Roll up your sleeves — work shoulder-to-shoulder with manufacturing on the floor, and get hands-on when it counts, especially in the early stand-up phase.

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS WITH THE CENTRAL MAINTENANCE TEAM
Anduril is building a central maintenance function and Center of Excellence that defines the standards, policies,
and best practices every site runs on. This role is the primary Arsenal-1 counterpart to that team.

• Governance and standards: you adopt and localize the enterprise operating model — CMMS configuration and naming conventions, PM and calibration standards, KPI definitions, safety and LOTO procedures, and reliability best practices — so Arsenal-1 stays consistent with the broader network.

• Site autonomy: you own the day-to-day execution and site-level decisions — shift coverage, trade mix, hiring, local vendor and OEM relationships, and priority calls on the floor.

• Two-way flow: you contribute Arsenal-1 lessons learned back to the Center of Excellence, and you have a dotted-line relationship to the central maintenance leader for standardization, mentorship, and network- wide alignment while reporting solid-line to Manufacturing Operations at the site.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of maintenance experience in manufacturing environments, including 4+ years in maintenance leadership roles managing managers and/or supervisors.

• Based on-site at Arsenal-1 in Ashville, Ohio.

• Demonstrated experience standing up maintenance organizations, PM systems, and spare parts strategies from scratch — ideally in greenfield or early-stage facilities.

• Proven ability to own a maintenance budget and represent maintenance in capital planning and site leadership decisions.

• Hands-on experience with OEMs and automated production equipment.

• Skilled-trades background, or engineering experience paired with a genuinely hands-on approach.

• Working knowledge of CMMS/work-order systems, tooling, and calibration.

• Proven ability to operate at both the strategic and shop-floor levels.

• Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, especially with manufacturing, controls, and automation teams.

• Background in automotive, aerospace, defense, or heavy industry (e.g., Caterpillar, Boeing, Tier 1 suppliers).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience standing up or leading maintenance for automation-heavy facilities.

• Experience building and running multi-shift maintenance coverage at scale.

• 3–5 years in a startup or fast-growing company environment.

• Experience partnering with a central/corporate maintenance function or Center of Excellence.

US Salary Range

$143,000—$191,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. jobs.title: Optical Engineer
jobs.description:
Optical Engineer


ABOUT MATTER INTELLIGENCE

Welcome to Matter, where we are building the future of vision AI: pairing a world-first sensor that sees molecular chemistry, temperature, and 3D shape with a Large World Model that will be the most powerful intelligence engine for the physical world. This system doesn't just see what something looks like; it understands everything from a single pixel. We call this Superintelligent Vision.

Our team has delivered technologies to Mars for NASA/JPL, designed advanced sensors for U.S. Defense, and frontier artificial intelligence systems. We are now building the next generation of space- and airborne-based sensing systems.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Matter is hiring an Optical Engineer to help design, integrate, calibrate, and operate the optical path for our sensing payload. This role will work across optical design, optomechanics, calibration, systems engineering, and test.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Generate optical designs and system trade studies for advanced electro-optic sensors, balancing performance, manufacturability, and end-user utility across the required spectral range.

 - Decompose system requirements into optical system and subsystem requirements; derive optical specifications, drawings, interfaces, alignment approaches, tolerances, and performance budgets with adjacent engineering teams.

 - Perform optical analysis—including image simulation, radiometry, stop analysis, and stray-light analysis—and plan and execute optical assembly, alignment, characterization, calibration, and integration activities.

 - Support the design of optical test equipment, environmental, ground, and flight testing; analyze results, investigate performance gaps, and lead root-cause efforts.

 - Participate in design reviews and document optical requirements, test methods, calibration results, as-built optical designs, and configuration changes.


QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - Advanced degree in optics, physics, engineering, mathematics, or a related field, with a strong foundation in optical engineering and experience applying it to physical systems.

 - Proficiency with Zemax or equivalent optical design and analysis software, along with experience in optical alignment, characterization, calibration, laboratory test methods, and design of test equipment and validation procedures.

 - Experience with stray-light analysis in FRED or equivalent, modeling optical alignment procedures, and using performance-prediction tools for novel optical systems.

 - Hands-on experience building and aligning optical assemblies, with a cross-functional approach to integration and troubleshooting.


PREFERRED

 - Experience with imaging, spectroscopy, remote sensing, or precision optical instruments; familiarity with diffractive or meta-optics applications, manufacturing, and modeling.

 - Experience working across broad spectral ranges and tightly constrained payload packaging.

 - Familiarity with flight test, environmental test, and calibration under operational conditions.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Optical system meets defined performance and calibration requirements.

 - Alignment and calibration processes are repeatable, documented, and practical for field operations.

 - Flight-test data is translated quickly into clear root causes and design or process improvements.


LOCATION

This role is based in El Segundo, CA, and requires onsite work.


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To comply with U.S. export regulations, applicants must be one of the following:

 - A U.S. citizen or national

 - A lawful permanent resident (green card holder)

 - Eligible to obtain required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State


EMPLOYEE OFFERINGS AND BENEFITS

At Matter, we believe in rewarding high performance and providing the support you need to thrive. Our compensation and benefits package includes:

 - Competitive compensation based on experience

 - Early-stage equity package

 - 100% employer-paid health, dental, and vision coverage

 - Opportunity to work on novel sensing, data, and AI systems with real-world deployment paths to the largest industries in the world

Matter Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds who can raise the ambition and performance of the team.

jobs.description:
AI AT ZAPIER

Remote - United States of America



Hi there!

We’re seeking a hands-on, sharp, and technology-savvy Counsel (based in the United States) to join our legal team to provide practical and clear legal advice on a broad range of commercial and compliance matters, including vendor and sales contracts, data privacy, and employment law. We’re looking for a legal counsel with a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, who is excited to learn new areas and will thrive in a fast-paced, technology-forward, and intellectually challenging work environment. This position provides a great opportunity to lead efforts to incorporate technology, like automation and AI, in legal operations and practice. You will be a member of our legal team and report to  https://www.linkedin.com/in/benjaminfreshman/the General Counsel.

If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…

Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

ABOUT YOU:

 - You have exceptional drafting and negotiation skills. You are experienced at drafting and negotiating a range of inbound and outbound commercial contracts, including technology/cloud agreements, SaaS service agreements, contractor/consulting agreements, events-related agreements, and other business agreements.

 - You are a regulatory expert, with strong business judgment. You have a knack for analyzing and assessing laws, regulations, and policies across multiple jurisdictions to extract the most relevant provisions for the business. You are comfortable with assessing risk and proposing solutions that balance risk with business goals.

 - You love new challenges. You have experience with, and an enthusiasm and intellectual curiosity for new legal issues. You are a creative thinker who is comfortable with change and ambiguity, and excited to learn areas of the law that may be new to you.

 - You think of yourself as a builder in legal practice. You increase the efficiency of your legal practice by using technology such as Zapier for automating legal processes, CLM products, and AI tools. You love exploring and implementing new ways to improve in-house legal processes for a small but growing legal team.

 - You are self-aware and have a high EQ. You have a positive attitude with a solution-oriented mindset. You work effectively across teams and have strong listening and interpersonal skills.

 - You’re solid at time management. You are successful at working independently and have a proven track record of prioritizing and managing multiple matters simultaneously in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly engaged environment. You also recognize when to ask for help or escalate issues.

 - You're a skilled communicator. You can take legalese and make it easy to read for a diverse workforce spanning the globe. Zapier is a 100% remote team and writing is our primary means of communication.


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

 - Juris Doctor degree

 - Admitted to practice and in good standing with one or more state bars in the US

 - 4-8 years of legal experience across commercial, operational, or general corporate matters

 - Combined law firm and in-house experience at a SaaS/technology company preferred, but not required.


THINGS YOU’LL DO:

 - Lead response to legal tickets from teams across Zapier, including from sales, procurement, and HR teams, and escalate to subject matter experts to resolve, as needed.

 - Partner with the procurement team and stakeholder teams across Zapier to draft, review, and negotiate inbound SaaS, service, and consultant/contractor agreements of all types.

 - Collaborate with Zapier’s commercial counsel on providing effective and efficient legal support to close sales deals.

 - Collaborate with Zapier’s employment counsel on the development, preparation, and training on various personnel-related compliance policies and documents, and provide day-to-day support to the People team.

 - Advocate for and implement technology to improve the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the Zapier legal team, including using automation, AI, and other tools.

 - Monitor legal developments globally for compliance purposes in locations where Zapier has personnel and customers, including labor, data privacy, and AI-related laws. Work with internal and external subject matter experts as needed. Advise the business on these developments with practical solutions.

 - Advocate for finding and implementing the “right” solution, which is one that is compliant and meets business goals, while remaining committed to our customers, our people, and Zapier’s core values.

 - Understand company-wide goals to develop systems, processes, and metrics that support Zapier’s growth.

 - Other duties as needed to meet the ongoing needs of the legal team at Zapier.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

jobs.title: Transaction Finance Professionals: AI Output Annotation and Ranking
jobs.description:
WHAT WE'RE RESEARCHING

We're hiring finance experts to evaluate AI-generated outputs related to transaction finance. Our goal is to improve how artificial intelligence processes complex financial data and structures transaction-related information. This work directly feeds into training more accurate and reliable financial models for the industry.


HOW IT WORKS

During this paid study, you will review various AI-generated documents and data points specific to transaction finance. You will be asked to rank these outputs based on their factual accuracy, industry relevance, and overall quality. Additionally, you will provide detailed annotations to highlight errors or areas where the model's logic breaks down. The work is conducted asynchronously through our remote platform, allowing you to complete tasks at your own pace.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator (Contract to Hire)
jobs.description:
About Arena Club

Arena Club is building the number one digital marketplace for collectibles. We started by reinventing the hobby with the first-ever digital card show, and we are expanding into new categories so collectors can buy, sell, grade, and showcase everything they care about in one place. Our ‘Slab Pack’ product brought the mystery and chase of opening physical packs of cards to a digital format, and has led to Arena Club being one of the fastest-growing (and highly profitable) companies in Los Angeles. Our business was founded by 5x World Series Champion Derek Jeter and serial entrepreneur Brian Lee, who previously founded LegalZoom and The Honest Company, both of which are now public companies.

About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Recruiting Coordinator to own end-to-end interview logistics, candidate communications, and operational processes across our global corporate functions. Working closely with teams in the US, UK, and India, you will cross the line from standard scheduling into recruiting operations. This is a high-visibility role with significant ownership, ideal for someone who wants to build and optimize scalable hiring frameworks for a fast-growing startup.

What You'll Do

• Global Interview Logistics: Own complex, multi-timezone scheduling across corporate functions. Manage seamless candidate travel and accommodation logistics for on-sites in Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, and Oregon

• Platform Management: Serve as the primary administrator for our automated scheduling ecosystem. Manage day-to-day software configurations, optimize interview templates, and build out efficient interviewer training rotations

• Process Partnering & Intakes: Partner with recruiters and hiring managers by joining intake meetings to map out new interview loops, define interviewer panels, and set up structured evaluation templates

• Candidate Experience & Messaging: Act as the high-touch, professional face of Arena Club. Draft and maintain engaging candidate resources, interview prep guides, and customized messaging templates

• Operations & Metrics Reporting: Monitor weekly coordination metrics to proactively identify process improvements and streamline daily operations

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or talent operations within a fast-moving startup environment

• Hands-on experience with modern scheduling automation platforms (such as ModernLoop, GoodTime, Prelude, or similar tools) with the aptitude to quickly become our internal platform owner

• Global coordination capabilities, with a proven comfort level navigating complex scheduling across US, UK, and India time zones

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong track record of creating clear, polished, and impactful candidate resources

• Strong stakeholder management skills, capable of partnering effectively as a trusted partner to interviewers and hiring managers

• High candidate empathy, a strong work ethic, and a team-first attitude

• Ability to work across time zones to ensure quick support is provided to team members and candidates in the US, UK, and India

Compensation & Structure

• Type: Contract-to-Hire

• Rate: $45 – $55 per hour

• Location: Must be based in the US; can work remotely or hybrid in LA

jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer, EW
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to join our Electronic Warfare (EW) team supporting various Electronic Support Measures (ESM) and Electronic Attack (EA) / Electronic Counter Measures (ECM) Systems. This is an exciting role which provides an opportunity to work across the full product life cycle, from concept to deployment.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 15+ years of hands on systems engineering leadership experience

• Experience with system design, development and test of ESM and EA / ECM in one or more of the following ground-based or aerial EW domains: Counter-Radar Counter-UAS Counter-Comms (Wireless protocols: Bluetooth, 3G/4G/5G, Wi-Fi, etc) Counter-PNT Counter-RCIED

• Experience with embedded devices and Software Defined Radios (SDRs).

• Experience with system requirements creation, requirement traceability, and requirement verification and validation.

• Experience coordinating across disciplines to ensure system requirements and design are properly and thoroughly defined, implemented, and validated.

• Experience leading program teams through systems engineering reviews and owning related CDRLs including System Requirements Review (SRR), Preliminary Design Review (PDR), and Critical Design Review (CDR).

• Excellent technical writing skill with experience in writing white papers, proposals, trade studies, test plans, test procedures, and test reports.

• Skilled at explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Excellent at balancing multiple projects at any given time.

• Enthusiastic about both working with a team and executing work individually.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret/Top Secret security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in SIL (System in Lab) design, setup and automation.

• Familiarity with RF systems and RF test equipment including multimeters, oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and vector network analyzers.

• Experience with system level RF cascade analysis, co-site analysis, and mission modeling.

• Experience with mission modeling tools like AFSIM and STK.

• Flight Test experience and flight test data analysis.

• Experience in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including the use of modelling tools (e.g. Cameo)

• Experience in integrating Firmware and Software builds on prototype and production grade hardware.

BENEFITS

• Platinum Benefits: We offer top tier platinum coverage (medical, dental, vision, life) and cover 100 percent of the premiums for you.

• 16 Weeks paid parental leave for all caregivers.

• Family planning: We’re proud to offer comprehensive family planning support. Fertility planning and treatment, adoption support, gestational carrier support and fertility preservation are all included.

• Unlimited Provisions: From breakfast to dinner, our kitchen team has you covered with healthy meals and snacks at every office.

• Commuter benefits depending on region.

• Relocation assistance.

• Unlimited and Incentivized Time Off.

US Salary Range

$191,000—$253,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. jobs.title: Head of Talent and People
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.



Our culture:

 - We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

 - We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. 

 - We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.



About the role

Sardine is looking for a Head of Talent & People to lead and grow our global team. This is a hands-on, player-coach role - you'll set direction and manage a full team of practitioners, while still staying close enough to the work to source a hard-to-fill candidate yourself, sit in on a tough employee relations conversation, or dig into a comp band directly. You'll own Talent, People Ops, and HR Business Partnering end-to-end, with a mandate to build pragmatic systems that scale with a fast-growing startup.



What you'll be doing

Team Leadership

 - Lead and manage a team of Recruiters, People Ops/HR professionals, including any team leads within those functions

 - Set goals, priorities, and capacity plans across Recruitment and People Ops/HR

 - Coach, develop, and performance-manage team; build a bench of future team leads as the org grows

 - Own headcount planning across the organization

 - Create the operating rhythm for the team (standups, pipeline reviews, OKRs, hiring sprints) without over-processizing a still-scrappy function

 - Model the player-coach standard you expect from the team - jump into the work alongside them



Talent Acquisition (the largest part of the job. This role is Talent-heavy)

 - Build and continuously improve our hiring process: interview loops, scorecards, calibration, and candidate experience

 - Partner directly with the CEO and Exec team on leadership hires. Own full-cycle recruiting for key leadership roles, including sourcing, screening, and closing candidates yourself

 - Build scalable sourcing channels and employer branding so Sardine competes for top talent without over-relying on agencies

 - Track and report on hiring metrics (pipeline health, time-to-fill, offer acceptance) and adjust strategy accordingly



People Operations

 - Oversee the People Ops Lead and team who own the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, HRIS administration, benefits administration, and compliance) - ensure the function runs smoothly and scales with rest of the company

 - Manage and scale our existing performance review, compensation banding, leveling, and promotion cycle infrastructure - this is already built and robust; your job is to run it well, refine it as we grow, and make sure it stays credible with employees and managers

 - Ensure compliance with employment law across jurisdictions where Sardine has employees, in partnership with your People Ops team

 - Provide oversight and escalation support on vendor relationships (benefits brokers, payroll providers) that the People Ops Lead manages day to day



HR Business Partnering

 - Act as a trusted advisor to managers and the leadership team on org design, team structure, performance management, and employee relations

 - Partner with leaders as an internal leadership coach

 - Handle employee relations issues with sound judgment, discretion, and fairness



What you'll need

 - 12+ years in talent/recruiting and people roles, with real depth in talent

 - Experience running people function at fast-paced, high-growth tech startups

 - Proven experience managing a strong Talent and People team, ideally spanning both Recruitment and People Ops/HR - you know how to set direction, hold people accountable, and develop managers

 - Generalist range: you're equally credible talking about an offer negotiation, a comp band, a difficult employee relations issue, or a performance management

 - A player-coach mindset - you want to do the work, not just direct it

 - Excellent judgment and discretion; you build trust quickly with founders, execs, and employees at every level

 - Strong operating instincts: you build lightweight, scalable systems rather than heavy process

 - Based in the Bay Area, with the ability to work from our Berkeley office at least 2 days every week



Benefits we offer:

 - Generous compensation in cash and equity

 - Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

 - Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

 - Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

 - Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

 - 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

 - MacBook Pro delivered to your door

 - One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

 - Monthly meal stipend

 - Monthly social meet-up stipend

 - Annual health and wellness stipend

 - Annual Learning stipend



Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.



To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice https://www.sardine.ai/applicant-and-worker-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Client Office Phlebotomist-Full-time Days DC
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, phlebotomy position located at a draw site in Mokena.

Must be able to work Monday, Wednesday, Friday 9am - 5:30pm; Tuesday, Thursday 11am - 7pm; every other Saturday 8am - 12pm.

The Phlebotomist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Phlebotomist provides expert phlebotomy services and must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills. The phlebotomist must have the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First”.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

As a Quality Inspector, you will inspect machined components to make sure they meet engineering drawings and specifications before they become part of our hardware. You will use precision measurement tools, document results clearly, identify nonconformities, and help keep defects from moving downstream.

This role requires careful, consistent inspection and sound judgment. Good work means catching problems early, documenting exactly what you found, and communicating clearly with the people responsible for building and improving the parts.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

• Inspect machined components for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, and acceptance requirements.

• Use calipers, micrometers, profilometers, thread gages, pin gages, and other precision measurement tools to verify component dimensions and features.

• Perform visual inspections to identify burrs, damage, scratches, foreign object debris (FOD), and other workmanship issues.

• Document inspection results clearly and maintain accurate inspection records.

• Identify nonconforming parts and write nonconformance reports that clearly describe the issue and supporting inspection data.

• Work with engineering and manufacturing teams to communicate inspection findings and resolve questions about part conformity.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical inspection or quality control in a manufacturing or engineering environment.

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings and specifications, including an intermediate understanding of ASME Y14.5 and GD&T.

• Proficiency with precision inspection tools and mechanical measurement techniques.

• Working knowledge of helicoils, Keenserts, AS5202 port threads, and surface finish requirements.

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to create clear, accurate inspection documentation.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with manufacturing and engineering teams.

Desired Qualifications

• Machining experience or a practical understanding of machining processes sufficient to help identify likely root causes and corrective actions for nonconformances.

• Experience operating or programming a Romer or FARO measurement arm or a CMM; Verisurf experience is especially useful.

• Experience working with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and/or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

• Experience inspecting low-volume or complex mechanical hardware where drawings, tolerances, and manufacturing processes require judgment rather than simple pass/fail checks.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Must be authorized to work in the United States.

• Must be able to work on-site in Portland, Oregon.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $35.00 - $45.00 per hour.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon.

jobs.title: Interface Manager
jobs.description:
About the Position

We’re seeking an experienced Interface Manager to support a large, complex, heavy-civil rail infrastructure program. This role is responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing a formal Interface Management Plan, including the governance, processes, and tools required to identify, track, and resolve all technical and organizational interfaces across engineering, procurement, and construction activities. This position operates within multi-contract programs involving significant discipline integration and high-risk interface environments (e.g., tunneling, major utility coordination, or systems integration), requiring coordination across contractors, stakeholders, and technical teams to ensure alignment, minimize risk, and support efficient project execution.

This is a long-term, full-time, hybrid position (three days per week in office) position located in the greater San Francisco Bay Area, CA.

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Develop, maintain, and implement the project interface management plan, including the interface register, interface control documents, and the process for identifying, assigning, and closing interface points.

• Identify technical and organizational interfaces across engineering, procurement, and construction activities, and coordinate resolution across design contracts, construction packages, and disciplines.

• Chair interface coordination meetings, track open interface items to closure, and escalate unresolved items with a recommended path forward.

• Review design submittals and deliverables for interface conformance, including spatial coordination, structural envelope, equipment clearance, access, and maintainability, and verify that the design supports long-term operations and maintenance rather than the minimum equipment footprint.

• Coordinate interfaces between civil and structural work and the systems it houses, including tunnel and station ventilation, mechanical and electrical rooms, traction power, trackwork, fire life safety, and communications.

• Evaluate change proposals, design change notices, and requests for information for interface impact, and document the cost, schedule, and scope consequences across affected contracts.

• Coordinate with third parties, utility owners, adjacent contracts, and permitting and operating stakeholders on interfaces that cross the contract boundary.

• Support the program risk process by translating unresolved interfaces into identified risks with assigned owners, mitigation actions, and closure dates.

• Maintain interface traceability from design criteria through construction verification, and confirm that interface requirements are carried into testing, commissioning, and turnover.

• Support schedule coordination by identifying interface-driven dependencies between concurrent design and construction contracts and confirming they are reflected in the program schedule.

• Prepare interface status reporting and briefings for program leadership, and support decisions with analysis, documentation, and recommendations.

Attributes

• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

• Excellent multi-tasking and organizational skills.

• Collaborative mindset that fosters teamwork, trust, and positive relationships.

• Natural curiosity, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or systems engineering, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• 10+ years' experience with interface management roles in large, complex rail infrastructure programs.

• Experience developing and implementing an interface management plan, interface register, or equivalent structured process on a program with concurrent contracts.

• Experience performing interdisciplinary design review across civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical scopes, including spatial coordination, clearance, access, and maintainability.

• Experience with underground and tunneled construction, including the interfaces between tunnel and station structures and the mechanical, electrical, and ventilation systems they house.

• Experience coordinating concurrent design and construction contracts, including interface-driven change, schedule, and risk impacts.

• Working knowledge of how civil and structural work interfaces with supporting systems on transit, rail, or other complex infrastructure, including ventilation, power, trackwork, fire life safety, and communications.

• Experience with industry standard project / construction management software (e.g., Primavera P6, MS Project, Unifier, Kahua, etc.).

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite/Office 365 (e.g., Outlook, Teams, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or systems engineering.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license, Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) (International Council on Systems Engineering), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification (Project Management Institute).

• Experience carrying interface requirements through testing, commissioning, and turnover to verified closure.

• Experience coordinating interfaces with operating agencies, utility owners, and third parties in a dense urban environment.

• Experience with interface, requirements, or issue management platforms (e.g., IBM DOORS, Jama Connect, Coordinate, etc.).

• Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI, Oracle Cloud Analytics, or other dashboard KPI reporting software.

jobs.title: OPEX Process Specialist
jobs.description:
Simtra BioPharma Solutions (Simtra) is a world-class Contract Development Manufacturing Organization, partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their sterile injectable products to market. With facilities in Bloomington, Indiana, US and Halle/Westfalen, Germany, we offer a wide range of delivery systems including pre-filled syringes, liquid/lyophilized vials, diluents for reconstitution, powder-filled vials and sterile crystallization.

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide.  As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra.  We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging.  Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Why join Team Simtra? Because we:

Make it HAPPEN – We bring a growth mindset to every opportunity, developing new skillsets and exceeding our expectations and those of our customers.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

Make it RIGHT – We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence, fulfilling our commitments to the customer, their patients, and our team members.

Make it COUNT – We take pride in our day-to-day work, knowing the impact we make – taking on challenges big and small to improve patient health.

This role:

The OPEX (Operational Execution) Process Specialist provides technical/process support to maximize production efficiency. The position is visible on the manufacturing floor and has high interaction with the production team. It’s expected that the OPEX Process Specialist will drive process improvements and equipment effectiveness (equipment availability, operator efficiency and product yield). This position reports directly to the Associate Director of OPEX and indirectly to production management. This position is 100% onsite at the Bloomington location.

The responsibilities:

• Evolve into a SME (subject matter expert) for assigned manufacturing processes/equipment - including, but not limited to, syringe/vial lines (value stream), lyophilizers, isolators, and packaging equipment

• Serve as advisor to building leadership, relative to assigned equipment and processes

• Use Lean/Six Sigma tools (SPC, CPk, Statistics, Pareto, Fishbone, 5-Why’s, etc.) to drive improvements in overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)

• Participate and lead cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives (Kaizens) impacting performance and conversion loss

• Manage multiple projects and work with cross-functional teams

• Responsible for standardization/training of set-up, operating, and troubleshooting procedures for production, maintenance, and training personnel

• Ability to create, manage and approve master change controls and work orders

• Participate in and/or author investigation/analysis of complex issues and determine root cause(s) and implement innovative, cost-effective corrective actions to prevent recurrence

Required qualifications:

• BS degree in science or technology preferred or 5+ years of pharmaceutical manufacturing experience in lieu of a BS degree

• 3+ years experience in a regulated industry/environment

• Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook)

• Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to provide solutions

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher preferred

Physical / safety requirements:

• Duties may require overtime work, including nights and weekends

• Extended periods of standing and/or walking

jobs.title: Aerospace Verification Engineer
jobs.description:
Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can’t keep up. At Neon Aero, we’re breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.

Here, you won’t just take a job — you’ll help reinvent how the world flies. If you’re ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.

We are seeking an Aerospace Verification Engineer to own the technical architecture, build-out, and operation of the HIL environments used to verify Neon Aero's flight-critical actuator control software. This is a Staff-level individual contributor role for an engineer who can set technical direction across the company through their own work and influence, and who is equally comfortable writing architecture documents and debugging timing on a real-time target.

Why This Role Matters

In this role, you will build the environment that generates certification credit evidence for Neon Aero's flight-critical software. Your architecture, tooling, and rigor will directly determine whether that evidence is traceable, repeatable, configuration controlled, and defensible in front of a DER or certification authority.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of systems architecture, hands-on lab work, and certification rigor.

What you’ll Bring

• 10+ years in embedded or aerospace systems, including at least 5 years designing or leading HIL or systems integration lab environments.

• Direct experience with DO-178C verification objectives and producing evidence that has passed certification authority or DER review.

• Hands-on experience with at least one real-time test platform and its Python or scripting API.

• Strong Python skills, including designing frameworks and APIs used by other engineers.

• Understanding of motor control fundamentals sufficient to specify and validate a real-time motor model.

• Clear technical writing and the ability to drive technical decisions across teams without formal authority.

• Experience with dual-processor architectures, FPGA-based signal emulation, or flight control actuation preferred.

Working Conditions

• Fast-paced, highly collaborative engineering environment.

• Occasional travel to vendor sites, test facilities, and partner locations.

• Hands-on lab work alongside architecture and documentation responsibilities.

• Role may involve regulated, export-controlled, or classified environments.

Why Join Us

• Work alongside elite engineering talent and innovators across aerospace and technology.

• Be part of a team moving faster than the industry standard and shaping solutions that are lower-cost, autonomous, and scalable.

• Help deliver the future of aviation while building your career in an environment that values ownership, innovation, and meaningful impact.

• Competitive compensation, including equity participation, growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits, helps support you in and out of work.

This is the expected compensation range for this role. Final compensation will be based on role scope, experience, skills, internal equity and location. This role may also be eligible for bonus/equity/benefits, if applicable.

$150,000—$250,000 USD

Neon Aero, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.
