jobs.title: Engineer - Fleet Management (Saudi National)
jobs.description:
Engineer - Fleet Management

Do you relish the prospect of working with cutting-edge energy technology? Would you enjoy contributing to global energy solutions in a dynamic and evolving industry?

Join our Team

The Regional Product Service Engineering team of Engineers supports the current operation and maintenance of Heavy-duty gas turbines, Aero turbines, centrifugal compressor, steam turbine & their Controls system, Protection and Accessory systems. As product Service engineer controls, you will be responsible for providing timely technical solutions for heavy duty gas turbines and associated auxiliaries.

Collaborate with the best

As a Product Service Engineer for Heavy Duty Gas Turbine, you will be responsible for upholding BH's product integrity by proactively identifying customer issues, investigating technical anomalies, providing technical assessments at both component as well as systems levels, and communicating BH technical solutions to customers. Specific responsibilities include.

• Responding to internal and external customer requests for technical issue resolution, using technical product knowledge and analytical skills while adhering to sound engineering principles, standards, practices, procedures. Escalate issues as required, acting as the liaison between field and design engineering to drive specific technical resolution and to help engineering identify, drive corrective actions.
• Establishing and maintaining relationships with customers to make customers’ technical issues/requirements understood and addressed in a timely manner.
• Leading and program managing root cause analysis/investigation activities for product technical issues. Interface with Product Service, System and Design Engineering teams, providing technical leadership to personnel supporting projects assigned to resolve customer technical issues.
• Preparing technical presentations for BH Leaders and Customers ensuring the timely communication of significant issues or developments.
• Traveling to customer locations to: - Support customer technical review meetings and present recommendations to champion BH's commitment technical solution - Support unplanned/forced outages to meet reliability/availability goals - Provide commercial teams with technical support for sales and services proposal activities.
• Planning and providing technical engineering oversight to the Contractual Services and Field Services teams during planned outages to meet reliability and availability goals.
• Partnering with the Design Engineering teams and interfacing with external and internal suppliers to facilitate the logistical implementation of Fleet Program technical solutions.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role, you will:

• Have bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical, Electronics /Control & Instrumentation/Electrical & Electronics) OR equivalent
• Have 2-5 years’ experience in design engineering or operation, maintenance & trouble shooting of for heavy duty gas turbines and associated auxiliaries.
• Be ready to travel at short notice 20 to 25% of the time.
• Have availability of working during weekends for emergency technical support.
• Be eligible to work in Saudi Arabia without complany sponsorship or legal restriction.

Desired Characteristics

• Have experience in a matrix leadership environment
• Have prior experience in design engineering or field maintenance /customer service facing role.
• Be able to communicate effectively both to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Be able to work well with teams and communicate requests and requirements clearly.
• Have experience working in global, matrix organization & ability to make timely and sound decisions based on data.
• Be able to interface effectively with all levels of an organization and demonstrate leadership to pursue correct engineering actions in adverse conditions or situations.
• Be self-starter with strong technical and analytical skills
• Have strong technical aptitude & problem-solving skills including awareness of applicable engineering tools and systems.
• Have strong and written communication skills
• Have strong interpersonal and leadership skills
• Be fluent in English & considered preference for Arabic speaking.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognise that everyone is different and the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best varies. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns [Select as appropriate]

• Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit in everything in and work when you are the most productive.
• This role is working with our customers on-site in locations across the world. When onsite, you will have the flexibility to work in line with customer working patterns. When projects are complete, we offer you the opportunity to take extended leave before you take on your next project.

Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work.

We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input.

Applicants must have work authorization in Saudi Arabia

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Engineering Experienced Professional - Fleet Management

jobs.title: SAP GRC Lead Consultant
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Allstate India is looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Security & GRC Consultant who can partner with our global teams to drive secure, scalable, and compliant SAP solutions. The ideal candidate brings strong expertise across SAP GRC Access Control, Fiori, SoD, S/4HANA Security, and HANA Database Security with hands-on experience in end-to-end implementations and auditing.
You will collaborate closely with functional, technical, and compliance teams to design solutions, remediate risks, and enhance the overall SAP security posture supporting enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives.

SAP GRC Access Control

• End-to-End GRC implementations (minimum 2 full life cycles)
• Activate BC Sets, IMG nodes, and SICF services for AC, PC, RM
• Configure connectors, connector groups, EUPs, MSMP workflows, and BRF+ rules
• Develop initiator/agent/routing rules, mitigation controls, and customized risk/function IDs
• Design and maintain Fiori rulesets for GRC–Fiori integration
• Configure integration scenarios (SUPMG, AUTH, ROLEMG, PROV)
• Manage synchronization jobs, password self-service, and role methodology
• Integrate GRC with HANA DB for provisioning and risk analysis

SoD Risk Management, ITGC & Audit

• Design and build SoD risk rulesets including Fiori and HANA-specific rulesets
• Support SoD cleanup, remediation, and role redesign initiatives
• Review GRC configuration, ruleset coverage, and mitigation controls
• Support RACM design/review and audit readiness for SAP landscapes

SAP Fiori Security

• Design Spaces & Pages aligned to business roles
• Activate OData services, SICF nodes, and semantic objects
• Maintain target mappings for custom apps
• Troubleshoot Fiori issues across logs (IWFND/IWBEP, browser console)
• Support Fiori App Support framework for faster issue resolution
• Lead migrations from distributed to embedded Fiori architectures
• Redesign Fiori landscapes replacing Groups with Spaces/Pages

S/4HANA, ECC, BI/BW & HR Security

• Manage table access using SE54 and map authorization groups
• Execute SU24, SU25 activities and maintain system security policies
• Restrict program access using RSCSAUTH, S_PROGRAM/S_PROGNAM
• Create and maintain BW Analysis Authorizations
• Perform CUA administration
• Drive ECC → S/4HANA migration security tasks
• Support compliance audits for ERP and S/4HANA
• Execute mass-security activities via SECATT, LSMW, GUI scripting
• Configure S/4HANA UI Masking & Logging for GDPR compliance

SAP HANA DB Security

• Create and maintain SQL, Analytic, Package, System & Application privileges
• Restrict access to DB objects (schemas, views, tables, procedures)
• Manage users (standard & restricted) and security parameters
• Work with HANA views (Analytic, Attribute, Calculation)
• Create and transport HANA packages using Delivery Units

Good to Have

• Understanding of SAP functional processes and business flows
• Experience in SAP SaaS solutions like IAS/IPS, Ariba and Fieldglass security
• Experience designing GRC/IAG risk rulesets for cloud/Fiori applications

What You’ll Bring

• Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work in a global, agile environment
• Passion for secure design and continuous improvement

Primary Skills

Defect Resolution, ERP Applications, Functional Designs, Integration Testing, Issue Management, SAP Governance Risk & Compliance Access Control (SAP GRC AC) (Inactive), SAP Governance Risk and Compliance (SAP GRC)

Shift Time

Shift B (India)

Recruiter Info

Hiral Parag Rughani

hparb@allstate.com

About Allstate

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To support the development of audits aligned to the bank’s standards and objectives by working collaboratively with colleagues, providing accurate information and recommendations, and complying with policies and procedures.

Accountabilities

• Participation in the planning of audits, including documenting the scope, process understanding, risk and control identification and testing strategies.
• Completion of audit fieldwork by testing key controls and drawing conclusions about their design and effectiveness.
• Discussion and agreement relating to the factual accuracy of audit issues with the audit team.
• Writing of high quality issues and recording management’s action plans.
• Keeping up to date with risks, issues, and changes across relevant business units.
• Challenging others, including auditees, where appropriate to make sure the right conclusion is reached.
• Execution of all work in full compliance with regulatory requirements and Barclays’ policies and procedures. Recommend additional Accountability - Contributing to risk assessment activity.

Analyst Expectations

• To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
• Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
• Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
• They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
• OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
• Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
• Partner with other functions and business areas.
• Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
• Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
• Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
• Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
• Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
• Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
• Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
• Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
• Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique.

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Internal Audit Internship programme?

Barclays Internal Audit (BIA) plays a key role in our business worldwide. Independent assurance and insightful challenge are at the heart of what we do, helping to protect Barclays' assets, reputation, and sustainability, while supporting the management of current and emerging risks in an increasingly digital, technology-driven world.

We're an independent control function that provides objective, reliable, and insightful assurance to the Board and Executive Management. Known as the "third line of defence", we work closely with the business to help strengthen governance, risk management, and controls. We do this by regularly reviewing and assessing business areas across the bank, evaluating how effectively risks are managed and whether controls are operating as intended. We then report our findings and work with stakeholders to help drive meaningful improvements and ensure issues are resolved effectively.

Barclays Internal Audit is a leader in Data Analytics and other specialist areas, using innovative approaches and technology to enhance the way we provide assurance. We've built a strong reputation in the financial services industry for our expertise, fresh thinking, and forward-looking approach.

This is your chance to work in an area that has a real impact across the bank, gain unique insight into how Barclays operates, and work alongside experts who will help you build the skills, knowledge, and experience needed for a successful career.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028. We welcome applicants from all academic backgrounds. While a STEM degree (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) can be a great fit for the analytical nature of Internal Audit, it’s not essential. We value diverse perspectives and encourage students from any field of study to apply.

Ideally, you’ll also be naturally analytical, eager to learn and ready to take on new challenges. You know how to manage your time, build strong relationships and thrive in a team.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from June 2027 to August 2027.

Working In London

If you love the buzz of city life, our global HQ is the place to be. Our London hub is in Canary Wharf, at the heart of London’s financial district. Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant.

It is the policy of Barclays to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.

The closing date for applications is 25 September 2026. Please note that this vacancy may close ahead of the advertised date due to application volumes, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as early as possible.

Marketing at Barclays is about understanding customers and clients, building trusted brands and driving sustainable growth. As a graduate, you'll help shape how millions of customers, clients and communities experience our brand while gaining broad exposure across customer insight, brand, content, digital channels, data and emerging technologies such as AI.

Through three eight-month rotations, you'll contribute to meaningful work with measurable customer, commercial and brand impact, developing your strategic thinking, creativity, analytical judgement and stakeholder management skills along the way. You'll build connections across the bank, take ownership of your development and discover how Marketing drives outcomes across consumer, business-to-business and Group environments.

You’ll also bring a customer-first mindset and a natural curiosity for what’s next. You’re quick to adapt, eager to explore new technologies and comfortable turning complex data into clear, compelling stories.

Here, you won’t just be perfectly placed to explore the nation’s capital; you’ll be in a place where you can explore the many functions and opportunities of a global financial giant.

About the Job:

As a Case Manager, you will deliver exceptional service to patients and families throughout their therapy journey through empathetic listening, compassionate care, and unwavering commitment. You will serve as the vital connection between patients, families, healthcare providers, insurance companies, specialty pharmacies, and local resources.

Your responsibilities will include conducting benefit investigations, providing patient education, enrolling patients in support programs, and coordinating drug delivery. You will excel at creating positive patient experiences and become a trusted resource within the rare blood community. As an active cross-functional team member, you will help deliver best-in-class services that ensure seamless access to therapy.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Main Responsibilities:

• Engage patients and families to build long-term relationships, uncover needs, understand challenges, and provide education and support to initiate or continue therapy; manage complex issues and utilize approved resources to reduce or remove barriers as needed
• Assist in obtaining insurance approvals for therapy and proactively plan for ongoing coverage maintenance by collaborating with patients, families, healthcare providers, insurance companies, and specialty pharmacies.
• Enroll eligible patients in financial assistance or gap coverage programs
• Educate patients, families, and healthcare providers on available patient support services, insurance options, limitations, and requirements; connect patients and families with relevant local resources
• Ensure close cross-functional collaboration with Patient Support Services field teams, Sales, and Market Access partners as appropriate to deliver a consistent, integrated approach to patient access
• Establish and maintain professional, effective relationships with all internal and external stakeholders, including Patient Support Services colleagues, Medical, Sales, Market Access, Patient Advocacy, insurance case managers, specialty pharmacies, home health agencies, infusion site staff, and office coordinators
• Represent Sanofi at patient congresses and meetings as a trusted community resource
• Document call details with a strong focus on data integrity to ensure compliance and continuously enhance our service offering
• Leverage CRM reporting tools and data analytics to make strategic, territory-level decisions and prioritize patient and customer needs
• Provide caseload coverage outside of assigned territory as needed
• Actively seek coaching and feedback to continuously enhance service skills
• Ensure full compliance with Sanofi policies and guidelines
• Professional-level Spanish proficiency (verbal and written) required to communicate directly with patients, families, and healthcare providers in Florida and Puerto Rico

About You:

You are a passionate, detail-oriented professional with a strong background in patient-facing roles.  You thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at building meaningful relationships, and are deeply committed to improving the lives of patients living with rare and chronic conditions.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required
• Minimum 2+ years patient-facing role experience in case management, reimbursement, patient advocacy, or provider’s office
• Experience with engaging patients and caregivers managing rare or chronic conditions
• Professional-level Spanish proficiency (verbal and written)
• Comprehensive understanding of the reimbursement process, billing and coding, insurance plans, payer trends, financial assistance programs, charitable access and related resources
• Excellent phone communication with a strong service-oriented mindset
• Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to multi-task effectively in a fast-paced environment
• Experience with Salesforce CRM preferred
• Proficient in Microsoft Word, MS Excel, and PowerPoint
• Ability to travel within the US, including occasional nights and weekends (up to 10%)
• Flexibility to adjust working hours based on business needs and team coverage requirements.

Why Choose Us?

• Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.
• Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
• Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.
• Make an impact across borders and functions, collaborating with leaders to turn complex challenges into real-world solutions.
• Advance your career through stretch roles, cross-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition.
• Thrive in inclusive, high-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what’s next.

jobs.title: Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Role

The Medical Scientific Liaison (MSL) is responsible for maintaining deep expertise in the assigned therapeutic area and staying current on major clinical studies, product information, competitor therapies, and relevant pipeline developments. This knowledge enables the MSL to provide balanced, evidence-based scientific information to Scientific Leaders, Key Decision Makers, and the broader healthcare community, ultimately supporting improved patient outcomes.

The MSL is a field-based medical professional whose primary responsibility is to engage in non-promotional, peer-to-peer scientific exchange and provide medical and scientific information to Scientific Leaders and Key Decision Makers. These interactions are driven by stakeholders' professional interests and needs and are grounded in the principles of scientific exchange.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

-Engage in non-promotional peer-to-peer exchange of medical and scientific information with Scientific Leaders or Key Decision Makers to the extent permitted by law and local regulation, local industry codes, and other provisions of the Guiding Principles for Ex-US Oncology Global Medical Affairs External Stakeholder-Facing Activities.
-Gain deep insights on disease, therapeutic area, and healthcare needs, data gaps and opportunities within the assigned geography.
-Represent Medical Affairs at local and regional non-promotional medical events, including congresses and scientific symposia, and contribute to the development of pre-event scientific materials and post-event scientific summaries.

Job title: Sr. Maintenance Technician

Location: Pearl River, NY

About the job

Join a global network that powers how Sanofi delivers — seamlessly, purposefully, and at scale. In Manufacturing & Supply, you’ll help reimagine how life-changing treatments reach people everywhere, faster.

The Maintenance Execution position supports site shop floor manufacturing equipment (Bioreactors, mixers, chromatography skids, autoclaves, etc.) to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. This role requires strong technical skills, the ability to work cross-functionally, and leadership in training manufacturing operators on routine maintenance and troubleshooting.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world.

Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

• Support Operations: Provide technical support to manufacturing operations, maintenance teams, and site projects.
• Work Order Management: Complete all work orders and time entries accurately in the CMMS system.
• Training & Development: Work with the Asset Care Manager to train and mentor maintenance technicians and manufacturing operators in maintenance tasks and troubleshooting.
• Preventive & Predictive Maintenance: Perform daily checks and scheduled PM activities on site-wide equipment.
• Troubleshooting: Identify root causes of system failures and perform necessary repairs. As such, the technician will provide SME support to deviation investigations as needed.
• Coordination & Scheduling: Plan, schedule, and coordinate maintenance activities.
• Compliance & Safety: Complete all assigned training (SOPs, SWIs) and follow site safety and compliance requirements.
• Collaboration: Assist other technicians and teams to support site-wide maintenance and projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to maintenance practices and equipment reliability.
• Other Duties: Execute additional tasks as assigned to support operations.

Technical Scope:

• Preventive maintenance and repair of industrial/process equipment.
• Instrumentation and electronics, including PLCs.
• Electrical systems (single-phase and three-phase 480V).
• Manufacturing equipment: Bioreactors, Centrifuges, Autoclaves.
• Ability to read and interpret P&IDs and technical documentation.
• Proficiency in Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

Decision-Making Matrix (DAI):

• The Maintenance Execution position plays an active role in decision-making processes across maintenance and operations activities. Responsibilities are defined as follows:
• Preventive and Corrective Maintenance Execution

D (Decider)

• Executes and decides on necessary actions to maintain equipment performance and reliability.
• Equipment Issue Reporting and Recommendations

A (Accountable)

• Presents data, identifies problems, and proposes solutions to supervisors or engineering teams.
• Site Maintenance Strategy and Long-Term Planning
• Delivers training and ensures operators are properly qualified to perform routine tasks.
• Coordination of Major Repairs and Shutdowns

I (Informed)

• Receives updates on site strategy but does not participate in high-level decision-making.
• Operator Training on Basic Maintenance Tasks
• Remains informed on all safety policies and compliance updates and applies them in daily activities.

A/I (Accountable/Informed)

• Provides technical support and coordination, informed of scheduling and resource planning decisions.
• Safety and Compliance Communication

Work Expectations:

• Overtime as required.
• Availability to work weekends and holidays.
• Always promote and uphold safety culture and compliance.

About You

Requirements:

• High School diploma or equivalent required. Associate's degree or technical certification preferred.
• Minimum of 3-5 years of maintenance experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, preferably in biotech, pharmaceutical, or food industries.
• Strong troubleshooting skills with mechanical, electrical, and control systems.
• Experience with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices).
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Strong communication and documentation skills.

Why Choose Us?

• Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
• Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
• Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
• Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

jobs.title: Fragrance Raw Materials Global Assistant Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Fragrance Raw Materials Global Assistant Procurement Manager

Business Function: Supply Chain, Procurement

Location: Port Sunlight

JOB PURPOSE

This role is part of Procurement’s Sourcing team, which is responsible for leading supplier relationships, and possessing and delivering Value Chain Expertise, Scale & Global Leverage and Sourcing Best Practices.

Your role is to help establish Unilever’s transformation of its Fragrance business model to achieve affordable superiority in our fragrance portfolio by establishing an in-house fragrance material sourcing capability. The sourcing of Fragrance Materials is aligned to the Business Group and Supply Chain Strategies for Homecare, Personal Care, and Beauty & Wellbeing. You will be responsible to support and lead sourcing and supplier management activities, helping deliver cost, quality, service, sustainability, and innovation objectives through effective procurement processes. Procurement teams are responsible for sourcing goods and services, negotiating with suppliers, managing supplier relationships, and supporting business operations through competitive buying. The role reports into the Fragrance Raw Materials Global Procurement Manager.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• You are a strategy guru: You help the co-creation of a long term, strategic sourcing strategy for fragrance raw materials. You can keep on top of dynamically changing market conditions, understand direct and indirect factors influencing prices and develop a view of future trends. You implement this strategy by deciding what to buy, where to buy, how to buy and when to buy with multiple global & local suppliers. Set up all contracts with 3rd parties for timely progress of the activities required by the business stakeholders while securing favourable legal & commercial conditions in terms of time, quality, price Cost control and savings.
• You are external facing and an expert in the supplier landscape: You assess, identify, and select the appropriate supplier base and materials that meet the needs of the business. You ensure and manage overall performance of suppliers and surpass stakeholder needs. You will develop and implement a digital Supplier performance programme for fragrance raw materials.
• You take considered decisions under pressure: You handle complex and diverse customer, supplier, supply chain or operational issues within generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Specific focus is required to ensure that a resilient supply chain is established and that regulatory requirements and proactively assessed and managed through digital tools.
• You are a born leader: You are a leader of procurement projects in your portfolio and for your materials. You take on a role leading portfolio wide activity such as accurate price forecasting and complexity reduction. You build strong collaborative business partnerships with Brand, R&D, Finance, Quality, and Business Operations.
• You are a storyteller: You use your strategic influencing skills to drive Procurement considerations and strategic recommendations with Stakeholders.
• You create growth for Unilever: You work closely with Brand, R&D, Supply Chain, Strategy and Insights and Category Procurement teams to support the launch of innovations and new product development.
• You achieve key financial targets: Delivering the business financial targets for Buying Performance, Product Superiority, Supplier performance, and Complexity reduction for the portfolio materials/services and suppliers. You prepare information on purchase prices and conditions to enable proper budgeting and cash forecasting.

Key Responsibilities

• Support/Lead sourcing events, RFQs, RFPs, and supplier tenders.
• Managing a raw materials, direct procurement portfolio.
• Analyse spend, pricing, and market data.
• Maintain supplier and contract information.
• Track savings, cost avoidance, and procurement KPIs.
• Support supplier relationship management activities.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and processes.
• Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements.
• Assist in risk management, sustainability, and responsible sourcing initiatives.

ALL ABOUT YOU

Key Skills

To drive additional value from the unique position you are in, you need to be excellent in:

• Procurement Sourcing Strategy – (level 2 - Capable) Ability to find, evaluate and select the best suppliers to drive savings, increase value and manage risk.
• Supplier Analysis – (level 3 - Intermediate) Ability to assess the weaknesses and strengths of prospective and current suppliers with respect to their – availability of capable staff, business model, capacity, sales revenue, stocks, reputation, mark-ups, mark-downs, gross margins, quality, service, reliability, pricing policies, payment terms, etc.​
• Value Chain Understanding – (level 3 - Intermediate) A value chain is a set of activities that an organization carries out to create value for its customers. Value Chain understanding is the ability to understand how the company makes value, by understanding all the activities and how they connect. Understanding the value chain allows us to look for ways to add more value.
• Supplier Negotiation – (level 2 - Capable) Successful negotiations are not a win-lose proposition. The best negotiations result in a win for all parties, which leads to stronger relationships and a desire to continue a partnership that is mutually beneficial. During the procurement process, a negotiation between corporate buyers and sellers is the first step in developing a supply contract which has a direct effect on profit or loss. To be a good negotiator you need to: prepare and plan, be knowledgeable about the subject matter negotiated; be able to think clearly and rapidly under pressure and uncertainty; be able to express thoughts verbally; be a good listener; have sound judgment and integrity; and be able to persuade others.
• Having a procurement/finance and or R&D background would be seen as an advantage but not deemed essential, as training would be provided.
• Contract Negotiation – (level 3 - Intermediate) Contract negotiation is the process of coming to an agreement on a set of legally binding terms. When two companies negotiate, both parties seek to obtain favourable terms and minimize financial, legal, and operational risk.
• Sourcing Resilience – (level 3 - Intermediate) Ability to run procurement operations to focus not only on 'just in time' but also on 'just in case', by anticipating and planning for uncertainty. It does involve finding robust alternative suppliers and anticipate situations that can have an impact on such as: out of stock, bankruptcy, climate issues.
• Stakeholder Management – (level 2 - Capable) Ability to identify and then understand the motivations and behaviours of anyone who can affect what you are trying to achieve on a project; then developing relevant strategies to influence outcomes.
• Strategic Partnerships – (level 3 - Intermediate) Ability to join forces with like-minded strategic partners to reach objectives that would be unattainable if going solo. Ability to adopt a deliberate approach to ensure the planned benefits of the relationship are achieved. This includes:and regularly refreshing and adapting your approach to the strategic relationshipensuring a strong governance, monitoring, and evaluation of the strategic relationshipdefining a clear strategy & plan for the strategic relationshipobtaining a deep analytical understanding of your strategic partner and the relationshipdeveloping and maintaining strong individual relationships with your strategic partner and its stakeholders
• Collaboration – (level 3 - Intermediate) Enables people within an organization or outside an organization to engage with each other productively and efficiently.
• Program Management (level 2 - Capable) Lead the planning and implementation of key change programmes.

Additional Skills

• Cost Models (level 2 - Capable)
• Contract Management (level 2 - Capable) Ensure contracts and procurement documentation are maintained.
• Supplier Relationship Management (level 3 - Intermediate)
• Service Risk Management (level 2 - Capable)
• Digital Dexterity (level 2 - Capable) AI literacy (level 2 - Capable), Excel (level 3 – intermediate), Microsoft packages (level 3-intermediate)
• Data Driven Decision Making (level 2 - Capable)
• Effective Communication (level 3 - Intermediate) Good communication and stakeholder management.
• Change Management (level 2 - Capable) Ability to manage multiple priorities and work collaboratively.
• Strategic Influencing (level 3 - Intermediate)
• Critical Thinking (level 2 - Capable) Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail.
• Business Acumen (level 3 - Intermediate) Strong analytical and numerical skills.
• Finance acumen (level 3 – intermediate) Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, SAP, or similar tools.
• R&D formulation cost management (level 2 - intermediate)
• Provide procurement support to project teams and business stakeholders.
• Knowledge of the Fragrance portfolio is not a skill, but it is essential to be effective in a Raw Materials role.

Unilever core behaviours are expected to focus upon:

Care Deeply
Focus on What Counts
Stay Three Steps Ahead Care
Deeply Deliver with Excellence

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

jobs.title: Executive Director, Global Client Delivery Biotech
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp is hiring a hybrid Executive Director, Global Client Delivery Biotech to join our team at 8211 Scicor Drive, Indianapolis, Indiana, with the flexibility of a hybrid work schedule!

Work Schedule

Monday – Friday, day shift

Job Responsibilities:

Primary areas of focus:

• People: Provide an environment where people can build their careers, thrive, and continuously develop new skills and capabilities.
• Process: Drive a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence through the adoption of technology, automation, data-driven decision making, and process innovation. Contribute to ongoing and sustainable improvements in quality, speed, and service delivery for the GSM, SDL, and RSC functions while ensuring alignment with the broader PM organization (Study Management, Maintenance, and Setup).
• Client: Deliver market-leading quality in an environment of increased regulatory scrutiny through a systematic quality program focused on continuous improvement, innovation, and client value creation.
• Technology & Innovation: Champion the evaluation and adoption of technologies, digital capabilities, and new ways of working that simplify processes, reduce manual effort, increase scalability, and enable teams to provide faster, more responsive, and differentiated service to clients.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide leadership and oversight for the Biotech Project Management organization, including the Global Study Manager (GSM), Study Design Lead (SDL), and Regional Study Coordinator (RSC) functions, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives, client expectations, and business growth strategies.
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization by attracting, retaining, and developing top talent. Foster an inclusive, accountable, and engaging culture that supports employee growth, succession planning, and leadership development.
• Drive workforce planning and organizational readiness to support current operations and future growth while ensuring efficient use of resources and adherence to budget commitments.
• Accountable for the overall performance, quality, operational effectiveness, and business outcomes of the Biotech Project Management organization. Establish clear objectives and monitor performance metrics.
• Lead strategic resource planning and allocation to ensure optimal delivery performance, client satisfaction, and achievement of service level commitments across the portfolio.
• Ensure consistent governance, standardization, and continuous evolution of project management processes, procedures, and operating models to support scalability, quality, and operational excellence.
• Partner with senior leadership to develop and execute organizational strategies, business plans, and transformation initiatives that strengthen competitive advantage and support long-term growth.
• Champion Project Management excellence across Labcorp by advancing PM capabilities, promoting best practices, and strengthening collaboration across business units and project management disciplines.
• Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence. Leverage data, performance insights, and employee feedback to identify opportunities to improve quality, productivity, efficiency, and the overall client experience.
• Lead the evaluation, adoption, and optimization of technology, automation, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and create faster, more effective ways of serving clients. Act as a change leader to drive technology adoption and maximize business value from transformation initiatives.
• Identify and advance business growth opportunities, service enhancements, and strategic initiatives that strengthen client relationships, differentiate Labcorp in the marketplace, and contribute to revenue growth and operational performance.
• Create a client-centric culture that focuses on delivering consistent, high-quality outcomes through proactive risk management, continuous service enhancement, and operational excellence. Partner across the organization to remove barriers, accelerate issue resolution, and implement scalable solutions that strengthen client relationships and long-term business growth.
• Serve as a senior leader and trusted partner across Central Labs, Commercial, Partnership Solutions, Operations, Technology, and other Labcorp business units to influence decisions, align priorities, and deliver integrated solutions that meet evolving client and market needs.
• Represent the Project Management organization with executive stakeholders internally and externally, providing thought leadership, driving organizational alignment, and advocating for investments that enhance client outcomes, operational effectiveness, and business growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Four (4) year degree
• 7 or more years in people leadership, leading leaders
• 7 or more years experience in central lab services, large pharma or biotech industry
• 5 or more years experience in change management
• 5 or more years experience in client relationship building

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master Degree
• 5 or more years experience in project management within a central lab environment
• 3 or more years of experience in driving technology transformation (automation, AI, process optimization)

Additional Job Standards:

• Demonstrated strong customer service skills.
• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
• Strong planning, organizational, and problem solving skills.
• Demonstrated ability to interact with, influence and inspire staff at all levels of the organization
• Inclusive and engaging presentation and communication skills
• Demonstrated leadership development capabilities
• emonstrated a high degree of initiative and ability to work collaboratively.
• Proven ability to inspire effective teamwork and motivate staff in a multi-regional matrixed environment
• Proven record of setting strategic goals for large organizations and driving implementation to achieve these goals.
• Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical or laboratory settings
• Strong negotiation skills to facilitate, guide and influence a unified approach within a global, cross-functional environment
• Proven strength in planning, problem solving and organization
• Consistent track record of driving continuous improvement and achieving results through leadership
• Up to 30% international travel

The Executive Director, Global Client Delivery Biotech plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of biotech client delivery by defining and executing a forward-looking vision and strategy for the Global Study Manager (GSM), Study Design Lead (SDL), and Regional Study Coordinator (RSC) functions. Operating in close alignment with the broader Global Project Management strategy, this leader will drive organizational excellence, elevate client experiences, and position the business as a trusted partner to the biotech industry.

As a key member of the leadership team, the Executive Director will inspire, develop, and lead a high-performing global organization, ensuring the successful delivery of complex programs while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous growth. This role is responsible for advancing operational performance through scalable processes, clear performance measures, and innovative ways of working that consistently deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

The Executive Director will champion cross-functional integration across Global Project Management, business units, and supporting functions, creating a seamless and client-centric delivery model. With a strong focus on transformation and innovation, this leader will harness emerging technologies, automation, data-driven insights, and process optimization to enhance efficiency, accelerate execution, and strengthen competitive advantage. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence, they will ensure the organization remains agile and responsive to the evolving needs of pharmaceutical and biotech clients worldwide.

Application Window: Application window will close September 25, 2026.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Employees regularly scheduled to work less than 20 hours, Casual, Intern, and Temporary employees are only eligible to participate in the 401(k) Plan. For more detailed information, please click here.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To support the day-to-day operations of the Chief Security Office, providing insights and expertise that help support the vision and mission of the business area.

Accountabilities

• Collaboration with experts across teams to help reduce risk, protect our customer and clients, and provide a world class service for our business.
• Identification of opportunities for us to improve and maximise agility and develop an agile and intelligence led approach to security delivery.
• Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business projects and initiatives.
• Identification of opportunities for us to improve, and clearly articulating to drive positive change across the function.

Analyst Expectations

• To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
• Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
• Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
• They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
• OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.

• Partner with other functions and business areas.
• Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
• Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
• Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
• Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
• Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
• Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
• Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
• Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
• Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Explore the world of Barclays as a Summer Intern

Spend 10 weeks diving into real projects, gaining hands-on experience, and shaping your future. You’ll receive full support, take on meaningful responsibilities, and build lasting connections—all while discovering what makes our culture unique

If you're in your penultimate year and ready to grow, learn, and make an impact, this is your opportunity to belong and thrive.

Why the Technology Cyber and Security programme?

Cyber and Security teams help protect Barclays, our customers and our colleagues. You’ll learn how technology, controls, threat intelligence and secure engineering come together to manage risk and keep services resilient. This is an opportunity to build technical skills while contributing to work that matters across the bank.

To be considered for this opportunity, you must be in your penultimate year of university. You must be graduating in 2028.

You’ll also bring a genuine interest in technology, strong problem-solving skills and the drive to deliver innovative solutions.

The location for this role is indicated in the job title, and you will be based at that location. If you are successful in receiving a return offer to our graduate programme, your location will be the same as it was during your internship.

Barclays will accept applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the UK and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet the Home Office’s eligibility criteria for a skilled worker visa.

Successful applicants who are not eligible to receive a skilled worker visa, and who we are therefore unable to secure a skilled worker visa for, will be required to have their own legal right to work in the UK on a full-time basis from June 2027 to August 2027.

Working In Knutsford

Set in 64 acres of gardens and centred around the historic Radbroke Hall, our Knutsford campus blends heritage with innovation. We’re redeveloping the site into a world-class, sustainable workspace that fosters collaboration and wellbeing.

Colleagues enjoy a vibrant community with clubs and activities ranging from yoga and running to beekeeping and boardgames. With free shuttle buses from nearby transport hubs and onsite parking, getting here is easy too.

jobs.title: 2027 Technology Analyst Degree Apprenticeship Programme Knutsford
jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To participate in the day to day operations of the technology function, working across a range of technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

• Participation in design and innovation of products using the newest technologies.
• Cross-functional collaboration with the business to understand their needs and convey them to the broader development team, ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
• Development of change and innovative solutions.
• Collaboration with peers and promote a culture of knowledge sharing.

Analyst Expectations

• To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
• Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard
• No people leadership roles at this grade.
• Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.
• Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.
• Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.
• Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.
• Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.
• Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.
• Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.
• Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits
Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?
You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Digital & Technology Solutions Professional Degree Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Technology Analyst Apprenticeship programme?
Technology powers Barclays. As a Technology Analyst apprentice, you’ll help shape digital solutions, analyse requirements, work with stakeholders and support delivery teams as they improve systems used across the bank.

Are you eligible?
First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need a minimum of 104 points at A2 (grades BCC) or an equivalent, e.g. BTEC DMM, plus GCSE Mathematics and English Language (grade A*-C / 9-4) or equivalent.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/  for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions).  To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In Knutsford
Set in 64 acres of gardens and centred around historic Radbroke Hall, our Knutsford campus blends heritage with innovation. Colleagues enjoy a vibrant community with clubs, activities, shuttle buses and onsite parking.

What happens once you apply?
Step 1 - We'll review your application
Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments
Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility
Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)
Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

jobs.description:
Our Company

Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.

We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.

The Opportunity

Do you have an interest in automating workflows and expanding your skills in Quality Engineering (QE) automation development? Do you enjoy working on a fun and collaborative team? Are you passionate about digital photography? If you answered "yes" to these questions, you should consider joining the Adobe Lightroom mobile iOS QE team as we build upon a very successful product that millions of passionate customers use worldwide!

Our Lightroom ecosystem is an industry standard among photographers around the world. To take our mobile app to greater heights, we are looking for an iOS Quality Engineering Developer / Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET). This person should have a passion for mobile photography and join our dedicated and focused team.

What You'll Do

• Collaborate with fellow QE Developers to build automation tests for various features in Lightroom using XCUITest Automation framework and streamline automation workflows.
• Partner with passionate QE Developers, QE and Developers to enhance automation for our feature workflows.
• Implement and support end-to-end automated solutions, delivering a positive impact on product quality.
• Improve developer and QE efficiency with continuous improvement of automated tooling and processes.
• Analyze automation test results to identify potential issues, then work with the team to drive those issues to resolution.
• Build, maintain, and improve automated test labs and environments.
• Perform ad-hoc test runs on code changes for early detection of feature issues.
• Develop high-performance, reliable, testable, and maintainable code.
• Participate in all aspects of software development, including design, coding, code review, testing, bug fixing, and code/API documentation.
• Demonstrate leadership skills and increase your scope of impact by reaching beyond the product area across the team to improve automation methods or processes.
• Engage with engineers through daily or weekly stand-ups and meetings.
• Grow with the support of your team and help others on the team grow by providing thoughtful feedback and uplifting those around you.
• Work both independently and collaboratively within a fast-paced development team, with clear, positive, and constructive communication.
• Advocate for outstanding quality and usability on behalf of our customers.

What You Need to Succeed

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum of 1 year of experience as a QE Developer or Software developer.
• Strong knowledge of Swift or JavaScript and at least one other language, such as Java, Python, C#, Ruby, or PHP.
• Familiarity with languages and technologies like Xcode, Swift, XCUITest, UI Automation and Full-stack web development

• Photography and/or Lightroom experience is a bonus.
• Customer-focused and has a real passion for quality and engineering excellence at scale.
• Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The West Point Quality organization ensures our products are manufactured, processed, tested, packaged, stored, and distributed aligned with our incredibly high standards of quality and meets all regulatory requirements.

The Associate Director, Inspections lead will be a core member of the West Point Quality Assurance Leadership Team and serves as a quality leader accountable for the quality oversight and management of the Quality team overseeing Regulatory Inspections and Health Authority reporting supporting the West Point Manufacturing and Quality Control laboratories. The position will be responsible to ensure site’s compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards and Quality Management Systems. The incumbent will be responsible for developing, implementing and leading a group of compliance professionals through the deployment of compliance programs, monitor compliance efforts and advise site senior management on compliance related matters. The role involves serving as the lead for regulatory agency inspection coordination and collaborating with other departments to address compliance issues. The responsibilities of this role will additionally include sustainment through continuous improvement of the organization at the site.

Primary activities include, but are not limited to:

• Develop and implement comprehensive compliance program for the site to ensure Permanent Inspection Readiness (PIR), which includes Health Authority Reporting and inspection readiness team.
• Track and Interpret changes in regulations, industry standards and ensure proactive awareness and PIR at the site.
• Conduct regular compliance risk assessments, identify potential risks and develop strategies to mitigate the risks. Identify and address compliance issues, develop corrective action plans and implement improvements to compliance programs
• Act as a liaison and/or SME to present operational compliance to Health Authorities and regulatory agencies on relevant topics.
• Lead a team of professionals who serve as contact for regulatory agencies during inspections, responding to inspectional or regulatory agency inquiries, providing information and addressing compliance concerns.
• Serve as Manager to the lead for the team coordinating Health Authority reporting, Market action events, and complaint process management for the site.
• Provide training and guidance to employees on compliance related matters, ensuring a robust PIR at the site.
• Provide expertise in developing strategies for inspection readiness including working with Regulatory with relevant submissions for new product launches
• Skills in engaging and collaborating with various functional teams (e.g., Operations, Technology, Automation, Regulatory, Research).
• Ability to build relationships and work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
• Engage and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the site to drive simplification and standardization.

Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge:

• Applicable experience, strong understanding and knowledge of relevant quality systems expectations in the biotechnology or vaccine industry.
• Expert knowledge of cGMP relevant to the biotechnology or vaccine industry including knowledge of the local and international GMP regulations.
• In-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements and guidelines (e.g. 21 CFR part 11, Annex 11).
• Ability to work independently while fostering collaboration in team settings and matrix organizations to achieve common goals.
• Highly skilled in listening to diverse perspectives, developing impactful solutions, and advocating for effective positions through influence.
• Strong working knowledge of Quality Management Systems, and associated business processes.
• Excellent communication, leadership, technical writing and problem-solving skills
• Ability to cultivate positive, transparent, and productive relationships across various stakeholders.
• A team player with high initiative, demonstrated planning skills, proven performance in problem-solving, team building and staff development.
• Experience in working with cross functional teams as well as good leadership skills in a matrix organization
• Experience in managing cross-functional initiatives or programs

Minimum Education Requirements and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree (BS) or Master’s degree (MS) with Ten (10) years applied professional work experience in one of the following pharmaceutical work areas: quality assurance, compliance, manufacturing operations, technical operations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience leading regulatory inspection readiness and Health Authority inspections in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or vaccine environment
• Strong knowledge of quality systems, compliance oversight, and CAPA management
• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives in a matrix environment
• Experience interacting with regulatory agencies and senior leadership
• Strong understanding of health authority reporting, complaint management, and market action processes
• Ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical site-level actions
• Proven leadership, coaching, and team development skills
• Excellent communication, influence, and relationship-building skills
• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset
• Experience driving simplification, standardization, and process improvement across a site #EBRG's #VetJobs

Required Skills:

Change Management, Computer System Validation (CSV), Decision Making, Driving Continuous Improvement, GMP Laboratory, People Leadership, Performance Qualification (PQ), Quality Auditing, Quality Control Documentation, Quality Management Standards, Quality Management Systems (QMS), Quality Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality Management, Training and Development
