jobs.title: Dir, Enterprise Marketing Finance
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director, Enterprise Marketing Finance is a senior strategic finance leader embedded within Adobe’s Enterprise Marketing organization, serving as the primary finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team. This role is at the intersection of data-driven decision making and go-to-market strategy for Adobe’s largest customer segment—Fortune 500 and mid-market enterprise accounts.

Combining rigorous financial stewardship with deep marketing effectiveness expertise, this role owns the Enterprise Marketing budget, leads investment prioritization, and builds the frameworks that connect marketing spend to pipeline, revenue, and customer lifetime value. This is a true business partner role—you won’t just track spend; you’ll shape strategy, challenge assumptions, and directly influence how Adobe reaches and engages enterprise customers at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership & Data-Informed Decision Making

• Serve as the dedicated finance business partner to the Enterprise CMO and her senior leadership team, providing strategic financial guidance across all Enterprise Marketing functions including field marketing, account-based marketing (ABM), events, and digital programs.
• Act as a proactive thought partner to marketing leadership, shifting discussions from reporting results to understanding performance drivers, implications, and forward-looking actions.
• Evaluate performance across acquisition, pipeline generation, conversion, retention, and engagement initiatives to inform investment prioritization and resource allocation decisions.
• Build executive-ready analyses and presentations that translate complex financial and marketing data into clear narratives and confident, data-backed recommendations for senior partners.
• Lead and contribute to quarterly business reviews and executive reporting, surfacing key trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions for the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team.
• Guide cross-functional alignment on investment priorities across Enterprise Marketing, Sales Finance, Product Marketing, and Finance leadership teams.

2. Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization

• Build and maintain sophisticated Return On Investment (ROI) measurement frameworks and attribution models that connect marketing investments to pipeline generation, revenue outcomes, and customer lifetime value.
• Proactively identify diminishing returns, underperforming programs, and budget reallocation opportunities to improve marketing efficiency across the enterprise funnel (CAC, LTV, funnel economics).
• Partner with Marketing Operations, Analytics, and Sales Finance teams to ensure consistent, integrated reporting across the customer journey.
• Build and maintain an executive-level Marketing ROI scorecard providing ongoing visibility into program performance and spend efficiency for Enterprise Marketing leadership.
• Drive operational improvements and automation in planning, forecasting, and reporting workflows to increase speed of insight generation.

3. Budget Management & Financial Planning

• Own end-to-end financial management of the Enterprise Marketing budget, including annual planning, quarterly forecasting, risk and opportunity assessments, and scenario planning.
• Build a defensible, strategically aligned annual budget in close partnership with the Enterprise CMO and her leadership team.
• Establish investment guardrails, approval workflows, and re-forecast protocols that balance financial rigor with the agility that modern enterprise marketing demands.
• Translate Enterprise Marketing strategies into financial models and forecasts, identifying optimization opportunities throughout the planning cycle.

4. Leadership & Team Development

• Lead and develop a strong marketing finance team, fostering analytical rigor, business insight, and a culture of continuous improvement.
• Mentor junior finance team members, building capabilities in marketing analytics, financial modeling, and executive communication.
• Represent Enterprise Marketing Finance in cross-functional leadership forums, including with the FP&A Leadership, Enterprise Marketing leadership meetings, and Sales Finance reviews.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

• 10+ years of progressive finance experience, with at least 5 years in marketing finance, FP&A, or commercial finance roles within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology companies.
• Demonstrated expertise in marketing analytics including multi-touch attribution, marketing mix modeling, CAC/LTV analysis, funnel economics, and multi-channel investment analysis.
• Proven track record as a strategic finance business partner to senior marketing or commercial leadership, influencing decisions through data-driven storytelling.
• Advanced financial modeling and forecasting capabilities; proficiency in Excel and planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, SAP).
• Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce).
• Proven ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments while knowing when to collaborate and call out appropriately.
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related quantitative field.

Preferred

• MBA or advanced degree.
• Experience supporting enterprise B2B marketing organizations and familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) investment frameworks.
• Track record of leading financial capability-building and process transformation within marketing finance or FP&A environments.

Strengths You'll Need

• Strategic Influence: Builds credibility through high-quality insights and trusted business partnership with senior marketing leadership.
• Analytical Courage: Willing to challenge marketing investment decisions when supported by data; comfortable presenting difficult findings to executive audiences.
• Cross-functional Partnership: Builds authentic, trust-based relationships across marketing, sales, analytics, and technology teams.
• Executive Communication: Translates complex financial and performance data into concise, compelling recommendations for senior partners.
• Bias Toward Action: Strategic approach balanced with attention to detail and a drive to move quickly from insight to decision.
• Continuous Improvement: Consistently seeks more efficient, scalable, and predictive approaches to planning, measurement, and investment optimization.

• Design and develop distributed services that are resilient, highly available, and scalable.

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer – Adobe Real-Time Customer Data Platform

Drive the Evolution of Real-Time Data and AI Personalization

At Adobe, innovation means reimagining how the world experiences digital at scale. Our Real-Time Customer Data Platform (RTCDP) processes trillions of events, resolving identities and driving hyper-personalized interactions within milliseconds.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) team, you will architect and scale systems that power global digital experiences, with an emphasis on ultra-low-latency pipelines, intelligent decisioning, and AI-driven personalization.

What You will Build and Drive

• Architect Distributed Data Systems: Design and deliver globally distributed solutions for real-time identity resolution, consent management, and accurate customer profiles at massive scale.
• AI & ML Personalization: Integrate cutting-edge Generative AI/ML into RTCDP for next-gen segmentation, recommendations, and live decisioning.
• Low-Latency Data Pipelines: Engineer resilient, high-throughput data flows with Kafka, Spark, Java/Scala to guarantee SLAs across diverse user journeys.
• Microservices at Scale: Build and maintain mission-critical, cloud-native microservices supporting trillions of queries and activations.
• Leadership & Ownership: Lead project delivery from design through production, ensuring rigorous quality, performance, and measurable business results.
• Mentorship: Coach and mentor junior engineers and code reviewers, fostering engineering excellence across the team.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product managers, designers, and data scientists to deliver privacy-first, customer-centric solutions that align with regulatory standards.

About Your Technical Playground

At Adobe RTCDP, you'll work with a modern stack built for scale, speed, and intelligence:

• Languages: Java, Scala
• Frameworks: Spring Boot, Apache Spark, Apache Flink

jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/02/2026

MEET THE TEAM
The CX Marketing organization is a high-energy, collaborative team dedicated to driving the visual storytelling behind Cisco's Customer Experience portfolio. We function as a creative engine, bridging the gap between technical production and strategic messaging to amplify our most critical updates. Our team consists of content strategists, editors, and creative leads who work in tight alignment to produce engaging content for internal sites, social channels, and global stages. We are most excited by the opportunity to transform complex executive messaging into professional, high-impact visuals that resonate with our global audience. Joining our group means working at the intersection of technology and art to shape the future of the CX brand.

YOUR IMPACT
Produce end-to-end video content to translate complex technical portfolio updates into compelling visual narratives. Elevate executive presence by providing expert remote A/V coaching for the CX On Message series to capture authentic and impactful performances. Drive social media engagement through high-energy b-roll, kinetic typography, and platform-optimized edits tailored for YouTube, LinkedIn, and Cisco.com. Power global flagship events by partnering with the Events team to deliver cutting-edge visual experiences that reach thousands of stakeholders worldwide. Maintain visual brand standards across all assets to ensure consistent quality and alignment with the overarching CX strategy.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Film, Video Production, Marketing, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in end-to-end video production, including scriptwriting, recording, and post-production.
• Advanced technical proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop).
• Demonstrated project management experience handling high-volume assets and tight review cycles.
• A professional portfolio showcasing advanced narrative storytelling, motion graphics, and editorial pacing.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Proven ability to provide A/V coaching to senior leadership to ensure comfortable and authentic on-camera performance.
• Familiarity with production and collaboration tools such as Riverside Studio, Descript, and Frame.io.
• Strong interpersonal communication skills to effectively navigate feedback from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
• Experience in vendor management, including briefing and overseeing external creative partners or agencies.
• Proven ability to maintain creative quality and professional composure under pressure during shifting schedules.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Regional Head of Social Impact & Sustainability, North America
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Job Description

Why this is important to Visa

Visa understands that operating a successful company includes driving business growth, delivering strong shareholder returns and expanding digital commerce in support of local economies.

The Social Impact & Sustainability (SIS) team executes on this belief every day, connecting our shared communities within and outside of Visa. We strive to place Visa at the forefront to power the future of commerce for everyone through inclusive financial products, innovative and impactful solutions, and responsible corporate leadership. Our team works to leverage Visa’s assets, business model and global scale to drive business growth and economic growth, with a focus on communities where we do business. We aim to achieve this by building purpose-driven partnerships and delivering programs that have societal and business benefit, with a particular emphasis on supporting the financial success of small and micro businesses (SMBs).

What a Regional Head of Social Impact and Sustainability does at Visa:

• Dual-report to the SVP/Global Head of Social Impact & Sustainability (SIS) and SVP/Regional Head of Government Affairs for North America; serve on SIS Senior Leadership Team
• Lead Visa’s North America Social Impact & Sustainability team to drive Objectives and deliver Key Results (OKRs) aligned with market priorities and the Visa 2030 business strategy, including:Expanding entrepreneurship and empowering small businesses with digital tools, knowledge, access, and security, including advancing the Visa & Main program with guidance and support from the VP, SIS Global Head of Programs and Partnerships as well as Government Affairs, Communications, and other business colleaguesProviding financial education as a foundation for economic inclusion and developmentEnhancing the security of digital commerce for allDemonstrating Visa’s long-term commitment to supporting the communities where we work and whom we serve
• Drive the go-to-market and sell-in of social impact products to North American clients, delivering a unique value proposition while securing revenue, in partnership with VAS (VCA, Marketing Services and other Visa business colleagues as appropriate)
• Ensure Visa is a strong corporate citizen by proactively engaging our employees and the communities where we live and work
• Manage North America executive and client charitable contributions, ensuring all donations meet compliance obligations and strengthen local relationships
• Partner closely with Visa Foundation, global colleagues, and North America Government Affairs & Communications teams to develop and oversee implementation of: an overarching narrative illustrating Visa’s purpose and contributions,impact initiatives in markets across the region, andthe embedding of social impact and sustainability into key client relationships and government engagements to drive impact and advance commercial outcomes
• Build deep and lasting relationships with external stakeholders to drive long-term value and enhance the company’s reputation with decision makers across the United States and Canada
• Coordinate Visa’s humanitarian relief and resilience and sustainability efforts in conjunction with relevant functional and business leaders
• Oversee measurement & reporting of social and business outcomes in line with OKRs

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

• 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/MBA /JD/MD), or a minimum of 5 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications

• 15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD), PhD with 9+ years of experience
• Minimum 12 years’ experience across some combination of public, private, and civil sectors. Experience in working in the technology and/or financial services sectors preferred; as well as government, politics, communications, and/or economic development is a plus.
• Outstanding people leadership and management experience building and growing teams; recruiting, developing, and advancing talent in line with organizational evolution and changing business needs.
• Proven track record of creating, implementing, and scaling public-private partnerships in emerging markets with clear positive outcomes for the local community as well as the company’s reputation and business strategy.
• Extensive experience developing and deploying comprehensive public affairs campaigns centered around the company’s contributions to the local community and economic development.
• Demonstrated success in building long-term partnerships with leading organizations in the public and civil sectors.
• Previous experience navigating complex corporate environments and translating global strategies into regional and country approaches.
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Ability to influence both global and regional/country stakeholders to develop regional/market SIS strategies, roadmaps and initiatives that encompass all priorities (social impact and business)
• Strong understanding of financial inclusion, SMB needs, and sustainability
• Understanding of the intersection between social impact, sustainability, government/regulatory affairs and communications
• Global mindset but knowledgeable of different cultural ecosystem landscapes and ability to connect to Visa business goals
• Passion for and ability to create impact

jobs.title: Branch Manager Sunnyside DeNovo
jobs.description:
Why Wells Fargo:

Are you looking for more? Find it here. At Wells Fargo, we're more than a financial services leader – we’re a global trailblazer committed to driving innovation, empowering communities, and helping our customers succeed. We believe that a meaningful career is much more than just a job – it’s about finding all of the elements to help you thrive, in one place. Living the Well Life means you’re supported in life, not just work. It means having robust benefits, competitive compensation, and programs designed to help you find work-life balance and well-being. You’ll be rewarded for investing in your community, celebrated for being your authentic self, and empowered to grow. And we’re recognized for it – Wells Fargo once again ranked in the top five on the 2026 LinkedIn Top Companies list of best workplaces “to grow your career” in the U.S. Join us!

About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking accomplished, people‑focused leaders interested in a Branch Manager career within the National Branch Network. This opportunity is designed for experienced managers who bring a strong foundation in branch leadership and are looking to apply their expertise within the Wells Fargo environment.

As a Branch Manager, you will serve as the sales leader of the branch, accountable for acquiring, deepening and retaining customer relationships to drive consistent growth in primary checking, deposits, lending, credit cards and investments through disciplined execution, strong coaching, and effective performance management. You will lead, coach, and develop a team to consistently execute behaviors and improve banker productivity. You will foster an engaged, accountable culture focused on uncovering customer financial needs and recommending Wells Fargo solutions that deepen relationships and drive long‑term value. You will balance growth objectives with strong operational risk management to protect customers, employees, and the company.

Your onboarding starts with participation in the Branch Manager Readiness Program which is intended to offer a structured and supportive transition into leadership at Wells Fargo. Participants gain hands-on experience through guidance, mentorship, job shadowing, and practical learning opportunities in day-to-day branch operations. The program provides foundational knowledge, real-world practice, and leadership readiness needed to effectively lead a team and make an impact from day one. Successful completion of the Branch Manager Readiness program is required to transition into a Branch Manager position.  Branch assignment is based on business need and branch availability at the time of placement. While in training, this position is an interim, nonexempt role. Employees currently serving in a Branch Manager role at Wells Fargo are not required to complete the program.

In this role you will:

• Provide strong, inclusive leadership to build and retain a high‑performing team, establishing clear expectations, and managing performance through targeted coaching to deliver sales, service, and operational excellence.
• Lead a branch team to proactively identify customer financial needs and deliver tailored consumer and business solutions that drive both customer value and business outcomes.
• Use branch manager routines to build individual capability, confidence, and productivity, delivering consistent, high‑impact coaching through observation, feedback, and follow‑up while holding the team accountable to behaviors and outcomes aligned to Wells Fargo priorities.
• Partner closely with internal sales partners to provide customers a comprehensive, coordinated Wells Fargo experience across Wealth & Investment Management, Business Banking, and Home Lending to maximize relationship depth, customer value, and branch performance.
• Identify opportunities for making banking easier for customers through education and demonstration of available digital options.
• Leverage reporting and employee observations to gain insight into strengths and opportunities, taking decisive action to improve team performance and expand primary bank relationships and wallet share.
• Demonstrate ownership by balancing growth, operational soundness, and talent decisions while proactively managing risk, resolving issues, and modeling behaviors that protect customers, employees, and the company.

Required Qualifications:

• 5+ years of banking, financial services, or Branch Network experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

jobs.title: Senior Lead Business Execution Consultant - Branch Formats & Experience Strategy
jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Business Execution Consultant to serve as the Branch Customer Intelligence & Insights subject-matter expert within Branch Channel Management.

This role serves as the primary research and insights partner supporting the future evolution of branch formats across the network. The individual will identify emerging customer behaviors, forecast long-term shifts in branch usage, analyze customer interaction patterns, and translate customer and employee insights into recommendations regarding branch formats, space allocation, staffing models, service delivery, and experience design.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in customer analytics, market research, forecasting, strategic planning, and executive storytelling. This role will help senior leaders understand how customer behavior is expected to evolve over the next 5 to 10 years and what those changes mean for the future design and operation of the branch network. Through customer intelligence, behavioral modeling, and market insights, the consultant will influence strategic decisions impacting branch investments, staffing, technology deployment, customer engagement, and network transformation.

In this role, you will:

• Serve as the branch customer intelligence and insights subject-matter expert within Branch Channel Management.
• Influence branch network strategy through data-driven insights and long-term customer forecasting.
• Partner with cross-functional teams and executive leaders to shape future branch experiences, formats, and service delivery models.
• Deliver clear, actionable recommendations that support strategic investment and operational decisions across the branch network.

• Lead research initiatives to understand evolving customer needs, behaviors, and branch interaction patterns.
• Develop long-term forecasts of branch customer activity, including teller transactions, banker interactions, self-service adoption, digital migration, and advisory engagement.
• Quantify the impact of technology, automation, artificial intelligence, and changing customer expectations on branch service models and utilization.
• Build behavioral models that estimate future customer interaction volumes, staffing needs, banker capacity, service demand, and branch utilization.
• Develop and maintain customer segmentation, archetype, and behavioral intelligence frameworks that support branch network strategy.
• Analyze customer, transactional, demographic, household, market, and competitive datasets to identify emerging trends and opportunities.
• Evaluate customer behaviors across markets, branch formats, wealth segments, and interaction channels.
• Lead analysis of customer and employee feedback, survey results, complaints, open-text responses, and research findings.
• Translate complex analysis into executive-ready recommendations, scenarios, insights, and business cases.
• Identify customer behavior trends that should influence branch investments, staffing strategies, technology deployment, and format decisions.
• Support future-state branch strategy through evidence-based assumptions about customer engagement models, branch sizing, and network evolution.
• Develop customer intelligence tools, dashboards, research repositories, and scalable insight capabilities.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

• 5+ years of experience analyzing complex customer, behavioral, operational, and market datasets and synthesizing qualitative and quantitative findings.
• 5+ years of experience developing strategic recommendations, forecasts, or business cases that support senior-level decisions.
• 5+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving analytics, strategy, customer experience, research, or business transformation.
• 5+ years of experience applying problem-solving, facilitation, executive communication, and storytelling skills to influence business decisions and drive outcomes.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience forecasting customer behavior, transaction trends, channel migration, service demand, workforce capacity, or branch usage patterns.
• Experience developing customer segmentation, archetype, persona, or behavioral intelligence frameworks.
• Experience with Voice of Customer programs, survey analytics, open-text analysis, ethnographic research, or mixed-method research approaches.
• Experience with customer journey mapping, service design, human-centered design, or experience measurement methodologies.
• Knowledge of retail banking, branch operations, branch network strategy, customer engagement models, or location intelligence.
• Experience with product ownership, including roadmap development, requirements gathering, prioritization, adoption, and performance measurement.
• Experience utilizing analytical and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, SAS, Power BI, Tableau, GIS, or comparable technologies.
• Ability to simplify complex findings and present concise, persuasive recommendations to executive leadership.
